children.text: Chapter 1
evaṃ mayā śrutam
children.translated_text: Thus have I heard.

children.text: ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdhamardhatrayodaśabhirbhikṣuśataiḥ sarvairarhadbhiḥ kṣīṇāsravairniḥkleśairvaśībhūtaiḥ suvimuktacittaiḥ suvimuktaprajñair ājñair ājāneyair mahānāgaiḥ kṛtakṛtyaiḥ kṛtakaraṇīyairapahṛtabhārairanuprāptasvakārthaiḥ parikṣīṇabhavasaṃyojanaiḥ samyagājñāsuvimuktacittaiḥ sarvacetovaśiparamapāramiprāptairekaṃ pudgalaṃ sthāpayitvā yaduta āyuṣmantamānandam ||
children.translated_text: At one time the Blessed One was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>, on <s>Gṛdhrakūṭa</s> mountain, together with a great community of monks, twelve hundred and fifty monks in all, all of them arhats, with their corrupting outflows exhausted, free from afflictions, self-mastered, well liberated in mind and well liberated through wisdom, wise, noble thoroughbreds, great nāgas, having done what had to be done and accomplished what had to be accomplished, having laid down the burden, having attained their own goal, with the fetters of becoming fully destroyed, their minds rightly liberated through knowledge, having reached supreme mastery over every state of mind, except for one person, namely the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>.

children.text: tatra khalu bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtiṃ sthaviramāmantrayate sma pratibhātu te subhūte bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitāmārabhya yathā bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ prajñāpāramitā niryāyuriti ||
children.translated_text: There the Blessed One addressed the elder venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Let it become clear to you, <s>Subhūti</s>, with regard to the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (perfection of wisdom) of bodhisattvas, great beings, how bodhisattvas, great beings, should go forth in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmataḥ śāriputrasyaitadabhavat kimayamāyuṣmān subhūtiḥ sthavira ātmīyena svakena prajñāpratibhānabalādhānena svakena prajñāpratibhānabalādhiṣṭhānena bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitāmupadekṣyati utāho buddhānubhāveneti
children.translated_text: Then this occurred to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "Will this elder venerable <s>Subhūti</s> teach the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> of bodhisattvas, great beings, by the force and support of his own wisdom and eloquence, or rather through the Buddha's power?"

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbuddhānubhāvena āyuṣmataḥ śāriputrasya imamevaṃrūpaṃ cetasaiva cetaḥparivitarkamājñāya āyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat yatkiṃcidāyuṣman śāriputra bhagavataḥ śrāvakā bhāṣante deśayanti upadiśanti udīrayanti prakāśayanti saṃprakāśayanti sa sarvastathāgatasya puruṣakāro veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, through the Buddha's power, knew in his own mind this very thought passing through the mind of the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, and said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "Whatever, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, the disciples of the Blessed One say, teach, instruct, utter, reveal, and make fully clear, all that should be understood as the work of the Tathāgata.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yo hi tathāgatena dharmo deśitaḥ tatra dharmadeśanāyāṃ śikṣamāṇāste tāṃ dharmatāṃ sākṣātkurvanti dhārayanti tāṃ dharmatāṃ sākṣātkṛtya dhārayitvā yadyadeva bhāṣante yadyadeva deśayanti yadyadeva upadiśanti yadyadevodīrayanti yadyadeva prakāśayanti yadyadeva saṃprakāśayanti sarvaṃ taddharmatayā aviruddham
children.translated_text: Why is that? For whatever dharma has been taught by the Tathāgata, while training in that teaching of dharma they directly realize that dharmatā (true nature) and hold it fast. Having directly realized and held fast that dharmatā, whatever they say, whatever they teach, whatever they instruct, whatever they utter, whatever they reveal, whatever they make fully clear, all that is not contrary to dharmatā.

children.text: tathāgatadharmadeśanāyā eva āyuṣman śāriputra eṣa niṣyandaḥ yatte kulaputrā upadiśantastāṃ dharmatāṃ dharmatayā na virodhayanti ||
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, this is precisely the outflow of the Tathāgata's teaching of dharma: when noble sons instruct, they do not contradict that dharmatā by means of dharmatā."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbuddhānubhāvena bhagavantametadavocat yadbhagavānevamāha pratibhātu te subhūte bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitāmārabhya yathā bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ prajñāpāramitāṃ niryāyuriti
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, through the Buddha's power, said this to the Blessed One: "Since the Blessed One has said, 'Let it become clear to you, <s>Subhūti</s>, with regard to the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> of bodhisattvas, great beings, how bodhisattvas, great beings, should go forth in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>,'

children.text: bodhisattvo bodhisattva iti yadidaṃ bhagavannucyate katamasyaitadbhagavan dharmasyādhivacanaṃ yaduta bodhisattva iti nāhaṃ bhagavaṃstaṃ dharmaṃ samanupaśyāmi yaduta bodhisattva iti
children.translated_text: Blessed One, as to this expression 'bodhisattva, bodhisattva' that is spoken, Blessed One, of what dharma is this a designation, namely 'bodhisattva'? Blessed One, I do not perceive that dharma, namely 'bodhisattva.'

children.text: tamapyahaṃ bhagavan dharmaṃ na samanupaśyāmi yaduta prajñāpāramitā nāma
children.translated_text: Blessed One, I also do not perceive that dharma which is called <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: so 'haṃ bhagavan bodhisattvaṃ vā bodhisattvadharmaṃ vā avindan anupalabhamāno 'samanupaśyan prajñāpāramitām apyavindan anupalabhamāno 'samanupaśyan katamaṃ bodhisattvaṃ katamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāmavavadiṣyāmi anuśāsiṣyāmi api tu khalu punarbhagavan sacedevaṃ bhāṣyamāṇe deśyamāne upadiśyamāne bodhisattvasya cittaṃ nāvalīyate na saṃlīyate na viṣīdati na viṣādamāpadyate nāsya vipṛṣṭhībhavati mānasam na bhagnapṛṣṭhībhavati nottrasyati na saṃtrasyati na saṃtrāsamāpadyate eṣa eva bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāmanuśāsanīyaḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore, Blessed One, since I do not find, apprehend, or perceive either a bodhisattva or a bodhisattva-dharma, and since I do not find, apprehend, or perceive <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> either, what bodhisattva shall I advise and instruct, and in what <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? And yet, Blessed One, if while this is being spoken, taught, and explained, a bodhisattva's mind does not sink down, does not shrink, does not become despondent, does not fall into despondency, if his thought does not turn away, if his back is not broken, if he is not frightened, not terrified, and does not fall into terror, precisely that bodhisattva, that great being, is to be instructed in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: eṣaivāsya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya prajñāpāramitā veditavyā
children.translated_text: This itself should be known as that bodhisattva, great being's, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: eṣo 'vavādaḥ prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: This is the instruction in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sacedevaṃ tiṣṭhati eṣaivāsyāvavādānuśāsanī ||
children.translated_text: If he remains in this way, this itself is his advice and instruction.

children.text: punaraparaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caratā prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāvayatā evaṃ śikṣitavyaṃ yathā asau śikṣyamāṇastenāpi bodhicittena na manyeta
children.translated_text: Furthermore, Blessed One, a bodhisattva, a great being, who is practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and cultivating <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should train in such a way that, while training, he does not take pride even in that thought of awakening.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi taccittamacittam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For that mind is no-mind.

children.text: prakṛtiścittasya prabhāsvarā ||
children.translated_text: And the nature of mind is luminous."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat kiṃ punarāyuṣman subhūte asti taccittaṃ yaccittamacittam evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat kiṃ punarāyuṣman śāriputra yā acittatā tatra acittatāyāmastitā vā nāstitā vā vidyate vā upalabhyate vā śāriputra āha na hyetadāyuṣman subhūte
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "But, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, does that mind exist which is no-mind?" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "But, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, in that no-mindedness, in no-mindedness, is existence or nonexistence found or apprehended?" <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "No indeed, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>."

children.text: subhūtirāha sacedāyuṣman śāriputra tatra acittatāyāmastitā vā nāstitā vā na vidyate vā nopalabhyate vā api nu te yukta eṣa paryanuyogo bhavati yadāyuṣmān śāriputra evamāha asti taccittaṃ yaccittamacittamiti evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat kā punareṣā āyuṣman subhūte acittatā subhūtirāha avikārā āyuṣman śāriputra avikalpā acittatā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: "If, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, in that no-mindedness neither existence nor nonexistence is known or apprehended, is this inquiry of yours fitting, when the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> says, 'Does that mind exist which is no-mind?'" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "But what, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is this no-mindedness?" <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, no-mindedness is unaltered and free from conceptual construction."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmate subhūtaye sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhvāyuṣman subhūte
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> applauded the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Good, good, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: yathāpi nāma tvaṃ bhagavatā araṇāvihāriṇām agratāyāṃ nirdiṣṭo nirdiśasi
children.translated_text: Just as you were designated by the Blessed One as foremost among those who dwell without contention, so indeed you teach.

children.text: ataś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'vinivartanīyo 'nuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodher upaparīkṣitavyaḥ avirahitaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyā veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: For this reason a bodhisattva, a great being, should be examined as irreversible from unsurpassed complete awakening, and the bodhisattva, the great being, should be known as not separated from <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: śrāvakabhūmāv api śikṣitukāmena iyameva prajñāpāramitā śrotavyā udgrahītavyā dhārayitavyā vācayitavyā paryavāptavyā pravartayitavyā
children.translated_text: Even one who wishes to train on the ground of the disciples should listen to this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, and set it forth.

children.text: ihaiva prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣitavyaṃ yogam āpattavyam
children.translated_text: One should train right here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; one should apply oneself to the discipline.

children.text: pratyekabuddhabhūmāv api śikṣitukāmena iyameva prajñāpāramitā śrotavyā udgrahītavyā dhārayitavyā vācayitavyā paryavāptavyā pravartayitavyā
children.translated_text: Even one who wishes to train on the ground of the pratyekabuddhas should listen to this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, and set it forth.

children.text: ihaiva prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣitavyaṃ yogamāpattavyam
children.translated_text: One should train right here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; one should apply oneself to the discipline.

children.text: bodhisattvabhūmāv api śikṣitukāmena iyameva prajñāpāramitā śrotavyā udgrahītavyā dhārayitavyā vācayitavyā paryavāptavyā pravartayitavyā
children.translated_text: Even one who wishes to train on the ground of the bodhisattvas should listen to this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, and set it forth.

children.text: ihaiva prajñāpāramitāyām upāyakauśalyasamanvāgatena sarvabodhisattvadharmasamudāgamāya yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ
children.translated_text: Right here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, endowed with skill in means, one should exert oneself for the full acquisition of all bodhisattva-dharmas.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ ihaiva hi prajñāpāramitāyāṃ vistareṇa sarvabodhisattvadharmā upadiṣṭāḥ yatra bodhisattvena mahāsattvena śikṣitavyaṃ yogamāpattavyam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For right here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> all bodhisattva-dharmas are taught in detail, where a bodhisattva, a great being, should train and should apply himself to the discipline.

children.text: anuttarāyām api samyaksaṃbodhau śikṣitukāmena iyameva prajñāpāramitā śrotavyā udgrahītavyā dhārayitavyā vācayitavyā paryavāptavyā pravartayitavyā
children.translated_text: Even one who wishes to train in unsurpassed complete awakening should listen to this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, and set it forth.

children.text: ihaiva prajñāpāramitāyām upāyakauśalyasamanvāgatena sarvabuddhadharmasamudāgamāya yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ
children.translated_text: Right here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, endowed with skill in means, one should exert oneself for the full acquisition of all buddha-dharmas.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ ihaiva hi prajñāpāramitāyāṃ vistareṇa sarvabuddhadharmā upadiṣṭāḥ yatra bodhisattvena mahāsattvena śikṣitavyaṃ yogamāpattavyam ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For right here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> all buddha-dharmas are taught in detail, where a bodhisattva, a great being, should train and should apply himself to the discipline."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat yo 'haṃ bhagavan etadeva bodhisattvanāmadheyaṃ na vedmi nopalabhe na samanupaśyāmi prajñāpāramitām api na vedmi nopalabhe na samanupaśyāmi
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, I do not know, do not apprehend, and do not perceive even this very name 'bodhisattva'; nor do I know, apprehend, or perceive <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: so 'haṃ bhagavan etadeva bodhisattvanāmadheyam avindan anupalabhamāno 'samanupaśyan prajñāpāramitām api avindan anupalabhamāno 'samanupaśyan katamaṃ bodhisattvaṃ katamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāmavavadiṣyāmi anuśāsiṣyāmi etadeva bhagavan kaukṛtyaṃ syāt yo 'haṃ vastvavindan anupalabhamāno 'samanupaśyan nāmadheyamātreṇa āyavyayaṃ kuryāṃ yaduta bodhisattva iti
children.translated_text: Blessed One, since I do not find, apprehend, or perceive even this very name 'bodhisattva,' and since I do not find, apprehend, or perceive <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> either, what bodhisattva shall I advise and instruct, and in what <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? Blessed One, this alone would be a cause for remorse: that, not finding, apprehending, or perceiving the real thing, I should make coming and going with a mere name, namely 'bodhisattva.'

children.text: api tu khalu punarbhagavaṃstad api nāmadheyaṃ na sthitaṃ nāsthitaṃ na viṣṭhitaṃ nāviṣṭhitam
children.translated_text: But again, Blessed One, even that name is neither fixed nor unfixed, neither established apart nor not established apart.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ avidyamānatvena tasya nāmadheyasya
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because that name does not exist.

children.text: evaṃ tannāmadheyaṃ na sthitaṃ nāsthitaṃ na viṣṭhitaṃ nāviṣṭhitam
children.translated_text: Thus that name is neither fixed nor unfixed, neither established apart nor not established apart.

children.text: sacedbodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya evaṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyāṃ cittaṃ nāvalīyate na saṃlīyate na viṣīdati na viṣādamāpadyate nāsya vipṛṣṭhībhavati mānasam na bhagnapṛṣṭhībhavati nottrasyati na saṃtrasyati na saṃtrāsamāpadyate
children.translated_text: If, when such deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, and explained, the mind of a bodhisattva, a great being, does not sink down, does not shrink, does not become despondent, does not fall into despondency, if his mind does not turn away, if it is not broken-backed, if he is not frightened, not terrified, and does not fall into terror,

children.text: adhimucyate 'dhyāśayena avirahito bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyā veditavyaḥ sthito 'vinivartanīyāyāṃ bodhisattvabhūmau susthito 'sthānayogena
children.translated_text: but he is resolved by his inner disposition, then the bodhisattva, the great being, should be known as not separated from <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, as standing on the irreversible bodhisattva-ground, firmly established by a discipline that has no fixed basis.

children.text: punaraparaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caratā prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāvayatā na rūpe sthātavyaṃ na vedanāyāṃ na saṃjñāyāṃ na saṃskāreṣu na vijñāne sthātavyam
children.translated_text: Furthermore, Blessed One, a bodhisattva, a great being, who is practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and cultivating <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should not stand in form, nor should he stand in feeling, perception, formations, or consciousness.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sacedrūpe tiṣṭhati rūpābhisaṃskāre carati na carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: Why is that? If he stands in form, he practices the conditioning of form; he does not practice in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ sacedvedanāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ saṃskāreṣu
children.translated_text: So too, if he stands in feeling, perception, or formations,

children.text: sacedvijñāne tiṣṭhati vijñānābhisaṃskāre carati na carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: or if he stands in consciousness, he practices the conditioning of consciousness; he does not practice in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ na hi abhisaṃskāre caran prajñāpāramitāṃ parigṛhṇāti nāpi prajñāpāramitāyāṃ yogamāpadyate nāpi prajñāpāramitāṃ paripūrayate
children.translated_text: For what reason? For one who courses in formations does not take up <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (perfection of wisdom), nor does he enter into discipline in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, nor does he fulfill <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: aparipūryamāṇaḥ prajñāpāramitāṃ na niryāsyati sarvajñatāyām aparigṛhītaṃ parigṛhṇan
children.translated_text: Not fulfilling <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, he will not issue forth into omniscience, while taking up what has not been taken up.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ rūpaṃ hi aparigṛhītaṃ prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: For what reason? For form is not taken up in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ hi aparigṛhītaṃ prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: For consciousness is not taken up in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yaś ca rūpasyāparigrahaḥ na tadrūpam
children.translated_text: And that non-taking-up of form is not form.

children.text: evaṃ yo vedanāyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃskārāṇām
children.translated_text: So too that non-taking-up of feeling, perception, and formations

children.text: yo vijñānasyāparigrahaḥ na tadvijñānam
children.translated_text: and that non-taking-up of consciousness is not consciousness.

children.text: sāpi prajñāpāramitā aparigṛhītā
children.translated_text: That <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> too is not taken up.

children.text: evaṃ hyatra bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caritavyam
children.translated_text: Thus indeed, in this matter, a bodhisattva, a great being, should course in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ ca bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya sarvadharmāparigṛhīto nāma samādhirvipulaḥ puraskṛtaḥ apramāṇaniyato 'sādhāraṇaḥ
children.translated_text: And this is the bodhisattva, the great being's, samādhi called 'not taking up any <s>dharma</s>'; it is vast, set foremost, immeasurably fixed, and not shared

children.text: sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaiḥ sāpi sarvajñatā aparigṛhītā na hi nimittato grahītavyā
children.translated_text: with all disciples and solitary buddhas. That omniscience too is not taken up, for it is not to be grasped by way of a mark.

children.text: sacennimittato grahītavyā abhaviṣyat na ceha śreṇikaḥ parivrājakaḥ śraddhām alapsyata
children.translated_text: If it were to be grasped by way of a mark, then here the wanderer <s>Śreṇika</s> would not have obtained faith.

children.text: tatra hi śreṇikaḥ parivrājakaḥ sarvajñajñāne adhimucya śraddhānusārī prādeśikena jñānenāvatīrṇaḥ
children.translated_text: For there the wanderer <s>Śreṇika</s>, having resolved upon the knowledge of omniscience and being one who follows through faith, entered by means of partial knowledge.

children.text: so 'vatīrya na rūpaṃ parigṛhṇīte
children.translated_text: Having entered, he does not take up form.

children.text: evaṃ na vedanāṃ na saṃjñāṃ na saṃskārān
children.translated_text: So too he does not take up feeling, perception, or formations.

children.text: na vijñānaṃ parigṛhṇīte
children.translated_text: He does not take up consciousness.

children.text: nāpi tatra prītisukhena tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: Nor does he behold that knowledge there through joy and happiness.

children.text: nādhyātmaṃ rūpasya tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: He does not behold that knowledge internally with respect to form.

children.text: na bahirdhā rūpasya tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: He does not behold that knowledge externally with respect to form.

children.text: nādhyātmabahirdhā rūpasya tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: He does not behold that knowledge internally and externally with respect to form.

children.text: nāpyanyatra rūpāttajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: Nor does he behold that knowledge elsewhere apart from form.

children.text: evaṃ nādhyātmaṃ vedanāyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃskārāṇām
children.translated_text: So too he does not behold it internally with respect to feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: nādhyātmaṃ vijñānasya tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: He does not behold that knowledge internally with respect to consciousness.

children.text: na bahirdhā vijñānasya tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: He does not behold that knowledge externally with respect to consciousness.

children.text: nādhyātmabahirdhā vijñānasya tajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: He does not behold that knowledge internally and externally with respect to consciousness.

children.text: nāpyanyatra vijñānāttajjñānaṃ samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: Nor does he behold that knowledge elsewhere apart from consciousness.

children.text: atra padaparyāye śreṇikaḥ parivrājako 'dhimuktaḥ
children.translated_text: In this mode of words the wanderer <s>Śreṇika</s> had confidence.

children.text: so 'tra sarvatra śraddhānusārī sarvajñajñāne dharmatāṃ pramāṇīkṛtya evamadhimukta iti
children.translated_text: In this, everywhere, as one who follows through faith, he had confidence in the knowledge of omniscience by taking <s>dharmatā</s> (true nature) as authoritative.

children.text: tena na kaściddharmaḥ parigṛhītaḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore no <s>dharma</s> at all was taken up by him.

children.text: nāpi sa kaściddharmo ya upalabdhaḥ yaṃ gṛhṇīyānmuñcedvā
children.translated_text: Nor was there any <s>dharma</s> that was found, which he might grasp or release.

children.text: sa nirvāṇam api na manyate
children.translated_text: He does not even conceive nirvāṇa.

children.text: iyam api bhagavan bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya prajñāpāramitā veditavyā yadrūpaṃ na parigṛhṇīte
children.translated_text: This too, Blessed One, should be known as the bodhisattva, the great being's, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>: that he does not take up form.

children.text: evaṃ yadvedanāṃ saṃjñāṃ saṃskārān
children.translated_text: So too, that he does not take up feeling, perception, and formations,

children.text: yadvijñānaṃ na parigṛhṇīte
children.translated_text: that he does not take up consciousness,

children.text: na cāntarā parinirvāti aparipūrṇair daśabhistathāgatabalaiś caturbhis tathāgatavaiśāradyair aṣṭādaśabhiś ca āveṇikairbuddhadharmaiḥ
children.translated_text: and that he does not attain final nirvāṇa in the meantime, before the ten powers of a Tathāgata, the four confidences of a Tathāgata, and the eighteen special dharmas of a Buddha have been fulfilled.

children.text: tasmādiyam api bhagavan bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya prajñāpāramitā veditavyā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore this too, Blessed One, should be known as the bodhisattva, the great being's, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: punaraparaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caratā prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāvayatā evam upaparīkṣitavyam evam upanidhyātavyam katamaiṣā prajñāpāramitā kasya caiṣā prajñāpāramitā kiṃ yo dharmo na vidyate nopalabhyate sā prajñāpāramiteti sacedevam upaparīkṣamāṇaḥ evamupanidhyāyan nāvalīyate na saṃlīyate na viṣīdati na viṣādamāpadyate nāsya vipṛṣṭhībhavati mānasam na bhagnapṛṣṭhībhavati nottrasyati na saṃtrasyati na saṃtrāsamāpadyate avirahito bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitayā veditavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Furthermore, Blessed One, a bodhisattva, a great being, who courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and cultivates <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should examine in this way and contemplate in this way: 'What is this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? Whose is this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? Is that <s>dharma</s> which does not exist and is not found, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?' If, while examining in this way and contemplating in this way, he does not sink down, does not shrink, does not become despondent, does not fall into despondency, if his mind does not turn away, if his back is not broken, if he is not frightened, not terrified, and does not fall into terror, then that bodhisattva, that great being, should be known as not separated from <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat kiṃ kāraṇamāyuṣman subhūte avirahito bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitayā veditavyaḥ yadā rūpameva virahitaṃ rūpasvabhāvena evaṃ yadā vedanaiva saṃjñaiva saṃskārā eva yadā vijñānameva virahitaṃ vijñānasvabhāvena yadā prajñāpāramitaiva virahitā prajñāpāramitāsvabhāvena yadā sarvajñataiva virahitā sarvajñatāsvabhāvena ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'For what reason, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, should a bodhisattva, a great being, be known as not separated from <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, when form itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of form, when feeling itself, perception itself, and formations themselves are likewise, when consciousness itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of consciousness, when <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, and when omniscience itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of omniscience?'

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat etametadāyuṣman śāriputra evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: 'So it is, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: rūpamevāyuṣman śāriputra virahitaṃ rūpasvabhāvena
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, form itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of form.

children.text: evaṃ vedanaiva saṃjñaiva saṃskārā eva
children.translated_text: So too feeling itself, perception itself, and formations themselves.

children.text: vijñānamevāyuṣman śāriputra virahitaṃ vijñānasvabhāvena
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, consciousness itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of consciousness.

children.text: prajñāpāramitaiva āyuṣman śāriputra virahitā prajñāpāramitāsvabhāvena
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sarvajñataiva āyuṣman śāriputra virahitā sarvajñatāsvabhāvena
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, omniscience itself is separated from the intrinsic nature of omniscience.

children.text: prajñāpāramitālakṣaṇenāpi prajñāpāramitā virahitā
children.translated_text: <s>Prajñāpāramitā</s> is also separated from the defining mark of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: lakṣaṇasvabhāvenāpi lakṣaṇaṃ virahitam
children.translated_text: A mark too is separated from the intrinsic nature of a mark.

children.text: lakṣyasvabhāvenāpi lakṣyaṃ virahitam
children.translated_text: What is marked too is separated from the intrinsic nature of what is marked.'

children.text: svabhāvalakṣaṇenāpi svabhāvo virahitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even by the defining mark of intrinsic nature, intrinsic nature is devoid.

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat kiṃ punarāyuṣman subhūte yo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'tra śikṣiṣyate sa niryāsyati sarvajñatāyām āyuṣmān subhūtirāha evametadāyuṣman śāriputra evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "But, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, will the bodhisattva, the great being, who trains here go forth into omniscience?" The venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said: "So it is, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: yo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'tra śikṣiṣyate sa niryāsyati sarvajñatāyām
children.translated_text: The bodhisattva, the great being, who trains here will go forth into omniscience.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ ajātā hyanirjātā hyāyuṣman śāriputra sarvadharmāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For all dharmas, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, are unborn and have not come forth.

children.text: evaṃ carata āyuṣman śāriputra bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya sarvajñatā āsannībhavati
children.translated_text: For the bodhisattva, the great being, who practices in this way, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, omniscience comes near.

children.text: yathā yathā sarvajñatā āsannībhavati tathā tathā sattvaparipācanāya kāyacittapariśuddhirlakṣaṇapariśuddhiḥ buddhakṣetraśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: In whatever way omniscience comes near, in that same way there is purity of body and mind, purity of the marks, and purification of the buddhafield for the ripening of beings.

children.text: buddhaiś ca samavadhānaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: And there is encounter with Buddhas.

children.text: evaṃ ca punarāyuṣman śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran sarvajñatāyā āsannībhavati ||
children.translated_text: Thus, moreover, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> comes near to omniscience."

children.text: punaraparamāyuṣmān subhūtir bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvamārabhyaivamāha sacedrūpe carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: Furthermore, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, with reference to the bodhisattva, the great being, said this: "If he practices in form, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedrūpanimitte carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the sign of form, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedrūpaṃ nimittamiti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'Form is a sign,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: sa cedrūpasyotpāde carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the arising of form, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedrūpasya nirodhe carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the cessation of form, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedrūpasya vināśe carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the destruction of form, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedrūpaṃ śūnyamiti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'Form is empty,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: ahaṃ carāmīti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'I practice,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: ahaṃ bodhisattva iti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'I am a bodhisattva,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: ahaṃ bodhisattva iti hyupalambha eva sa carati
children.translated_text: For if he practices thinking, 'I am a bodhisattva,' he practices in apprehension itself.

children.text: evaṃ saced vedanāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ saṃskāreṣu
children.translated_text: So too, if he practices in feeling, in perception, or in formations,

children.text: sacedvijñāne carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: if he practices in consciousness, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedvijñānanimitte carati nimitte carati sacedvijñānaṃ nimittamiti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the sign of consciousness, he practices in a sign; if he practices thinking, 'Consciousness is a sign,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedvijñānasyotpāde carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the arising of consciousness, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedvijñānasya nirodhe carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the cessation of consciousness, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedvijñānasya vināśe carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices in the destruction of consciousness, he practices in a sign.

children.text: sacedvijñānaṃ śūnyamiti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'Consciousness is empty,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: ahaṃ carāmīti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'I practice,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: ahaṃ bodhisattva iti carati nimitte carati
children.translated_text: If he practices thinking, 'I am a bodhisattva,' he practices in a sign.

children.text: ahaṃ bodhisattva iti hyupalambha eva sa carati
children.translated_text: For if he practices thinking, 'I am a bodhisattva,' he practices in apprehension itself.

children.text: sacetpunarasyaivaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ carati sa prajñāpāramitāyāṃ carati sa prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāvayatīti nimitta eva sa carati
children.translated_text: If, moreover, it occurs to him, 'One who practices in this way practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; he cultivates <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>,' then he practices in a sign itself.

children.text: ayaṃ bodhisattvo 'nupāyakuśalo veditavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This bodhisattva should be understood as not skilled in means."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat kathaṃ punarāyuṣman subhūte caran bodhisattvo mahāsattvaścarati prajñāpāramitāyām evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat sacedāyuṣman śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo na rūpe carati na rūpanimitte carati na rūpaṃ nimittamiti carati na rūpasyotpāde carati na rūpasya nirodhe carati na rūpasya vināśe carati na rūpaṃ śūnyamiti carati nāhaṃ carāmīti carati nāhaṃ bodhisattva iti carati
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "How, then, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, does a bodhisattva, a great being, practice when practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "If, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, does not practice in form, does not practice in the sign of form, does not practice thinking, 'Form is a sign,' does not practice in the arising of form, does not practice in the cessation of form, does not practice in the destruction of form, does not practice thinking, 'Form is empty,' does not practice thinking, 'I practice,' and does not practice thinking, 'I am a bodhisattva,'

children.text: evaṃ sacenna vedanāyāṃ na saṃjñāyāṃ na saṃskāreṣu
children.translated_text: so too, if he does not practice in feeling, in perception, or in formations,

children.text: sacenna vijñāne carati na vijñānanimitte carati na vijñānaṃ nimittamiti carati na vijñānasyotpāde carati na vijñānasya nirodhe carati na vijñānasya vināśe carati na vijñānaṃ śūnyamiti carati nāhaṃ carāmīti carati nāhaṃ bodhisattva iti carati
children.translated_text: if he does not practice in consciousness, does not practice in the sign of consciousness, does not practice thinking, 'Consciousness is a sign,' does not practice in the arising of consciousness, does not practice in the cessation of consciousness, does not practice in the destruction of consciousness, does not practice thinking, 'Consciousness is empty,' does not practice thinking, 'I practice,' and does not practice thinking, 'I am a bodhisattva,'

children.text: sacetpunarnāsyaivaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ carati sa prajñāpāramitāyāṃ carati sa prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāvayatīti
children.translated_text: and if, moreover, it does not occur to him, 'One who practices in this way practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; he cultivates <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>,'

children.text: evaṃ caran bodhisattvo mahāsattvaścarati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: then, practicing in this way, the bodhisattva, the great being, practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sa hi caraṃścarāmīti nopaiti na carāmīti nopaiti carāmi ca na carāmi ceti nopaiti naiva carāmi na na carāmīti nopaiti cariṣyāmīti nopaiti na cariṣyāmīti nopaiti cariṣyāmi ca na cariṣyāmi ceti nopaiti naiva cariṣyāmi na cariṣyāmīti nopaiti
children.translated_text: For while practicing he does not approach the thought 'I practice'; he does not approach 'I do not practice'; he does not approach 'I both practice and do not practice'; he does not approach 'I neither practice nor do not practice'; he does not approach 'I will practice'; he does not approach 'I will not practice'; he does not approach 'I both will practice and will not practice'; he does not approach 'I neither will practice nor will not practice.'

children.text: tatkasya hetor nopaiti sarvadharmā hyanupagatā anupāttāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? He does not approach, because all dharmas are unapproached and unappropriated.

children.text: ayamucyate sarvadharmānupādāno nāma samādhirbodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya vipulaḥ puraskṛto 'pramāṇaniyato 'sādhāraṇaḥ sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaiḥ
children.translated_text: This is called the bodhisattva, the great being's, samādhi named non-appropriation of all dharmas, vast, set in the forefront, immeasurable, determinate, and not shared by all śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas.

children.text: anenaiva samādhinā viharan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ kṣipramanuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhyate ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling in this very samādhi, a bodhisattva, a great being, quickly awakens to unsurpassed complete perfect awakening."

children.text: buddhānubhāvena āyuṣmān subhūtiḥ sthavira evamāha vyākṛto 'yaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ pūrvakaistathāgatairarhadbhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhairanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau yo 'nena samādhinā viharati
children.translated_text: By the Buddha's power the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, the elder, spoke thus: "Blessed One, this bodhisattva, this great being, who dwells in this samādhi has been predicted for unsurpassed complete perfect awakening by former Tathāgatas, arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas.

children.text: sa tam api samādhiṃ na samanupaśyati na ca tena samādhinā manyate ahaṃ samāhitaḥ ahaṃ samādhiṃ samāpatsye ahaṃ samādhiṃ samāpadye ahaṃ samādhisamāpannaḥ iti evaṃ tasya sarveṇa sarvaṃ sarvathā sarvaṃ na saṃvidyate ||
children.translated_text: He does not perceive even that <s>samādhi</s> (meditative absorption), nor does he think by means of that <s>samādhi</s>, "I am concentrated; I will enter <s>samādhi</s>; I am entering <s>samādhi</s>; I have entered <s>samādhi</s>." Thus for him, in every respect, entirely and in every way, none of this is apprehended.

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat katamenāyuṣman subhūte samādhinā viharan bodhisattvo mahāsattvastathāgatairarhadbhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhairvyākriyate 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau śakyaḥ sa samādhirdarśayitum subhūtirāha no hīdamāyuṣman śāriputra
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, while dwelling in what <s>samādhi</s> is a bodhisattva, a great being, predicted by the Tathāgatas, arhats, perfectly awakened ones, to unsurpassed perfect awakening? Can that <s>samādhi</s> be shown?" <s>Subhūti</s> said: "No indeed, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>."

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tam api hi sa kulaputraḥ samādhiṃ na jānāti na saṃjānīte
children.translated_text: Why is that? For that noble son does not know even that <s>samādhi</s>, nor does he apprehend it.

children.text: āyuṣmān śāriputra āha na jānāti na saṃjānīte ityāyuṣman subhūte vadasi āyuṣmān subhūtirāha na jānāti na saṃjānīte ityāyuṣman śāriputra vadāmi
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, are you saying, 'He does not know it and does not apprehend it'?" The venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, I am saying, 'He does not know it and does not apprehend it.'"

children.text: tatkasya hetorna jānāti na saṃjānīte avidyamānatvena tasya samādhestaṃ samādhiṃ na jānāti na saṃjānīte
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because that <s>samādhi</s> does not exist, he does not know that <s>samādhi</s> and does not apprehend it.

children.text: atha khalu bhagavān āyuṣmate subhūtaye sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu subhūte
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One gave his approval to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Good, good, <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: yathāpi nāma tathāgatānubhāvena te pratibhāti tathāgatādhiṣṭhānenopadiśasi
children.translated_text: Just as it appears to you through the power of the Tathāgata, so you teach through the support of the Tathāgata.

children.text: evaṃ cātra bodhisattvena mahāsattvena śikṣitavyam
children.translated_text: And in just this way a bodhisattva, a great being, should train here.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ evaṃ hi śikṣamāṇo bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣate ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way trains in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (the perfection of wisdom)."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat evaṃ śikṣamāṇo bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣate evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat evaṃ śikṣamāṇaḥ śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣate ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, does a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way train in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way trains in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>."

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat evaṃ śikṣamāṇo bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ katamasmin dharme śikṣate evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat evaṃ śikṣamāṇaḥ śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo na kasmiṃściddharme śikṣate
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, in what dharma does a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way train?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way trains in no dharma whatsoever."

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ na hi te śāriputra dharmāstathā saṃvidyante yathā bālapṛthagjanā aśrutavanto 'bhiniviṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Śāriputra</s>, those dharmas are not apprehended in the way that foolish, uninstructed ordinary people are attached to them.

children.text: āyuṣmān śāriputra āha kathaṃ tarhi te bhagavan saṃvidyante bhagavānāha yathā śāriputra na saṃvidyante tathā saṃvidyante evamavidyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "Then how, Blessed One, are they apprehended?" The Blessed One said: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, they are apprehended in the very way that they are not apprehended: thus they are nonexistent.

children.text: tenocyante avidyeti
children.translated_text: For that reason they are called ignorance.

children.text: tān bālapṛthagjanā aśrutavanto 'bhiniviṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: Foolish, uninstructed ordinary people are attached to them.

children.text: tair asaṃvidyamānāḥ sarvadharmāḥ kalpitāḥ
children.translated_text: By them all dharmas, though not apprehended, are imagined.

children.text: te tān kalpayitvā dvayorantayoḥ saktāḥ tān dharmānna jānanti na paśyanti
children.translated_text: Having imagined them, they cling to two extremes, and they neither know nor see those dharmas.

children.text: tasmātte 'saṃvidyamānān sarvadharmān kalpayanti
children.translated_text: Therefore they imagine all dharmas that are not apprehended.

children.text: kalpayitvā dvāvantāvabhiniviśante abhiniviśya tannidānamupalambhaṃ niśritya atītān dharmān kalpayanti anāgatān dharmān kalpayanti pratyutpannān dharmān kalpayanti te kalpayitvā nāmarūpe 'bhiniviṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: Having imagined them, they become attached to two extremes. Having become attached, on that account and relying on apprehension, they imagine past dharmas, they imagine future dharmas, and they imagine present dharmas. Having imagined them, they are attached to name-and-form.

children.text: tair asaṃvidyamānāḥ sarvadharmāḥ kalpitāḥ
children.translated_text: By them all dharmas, though not apprehended, are imagined.

children.text: te tān asaṃvidyamānān sarvadharmān kalpayanto yathābhūtaṃ mārgaṃ na jānanti na paśyanti
children.translated_text: While imagining all those dharmas that are not apprehended, they do not know and do not see the path as it really is.

children.text: yathābhūtaṃ mārgam ajānanto 'paśyanto na niryānti traidhātukāt na budhyante bhūtakoṭim
children.translated_text: Not knowing and not seeing the path as it really is, they do not escape from the three realms and they do not awaken to the limit of reality.

children.text: tena te bālā iti saṃjñāṃ gacchanti
children.translated_text: Therefore they come to be designated as foolish.

children.text: te satyaṃ dharmaṃ na śraddadhati
children.translated_text: They do not trust the true dharma.

children.text: na khalu punaḥ śāriputra bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ kaṃciddharmamabhiniviśante ||
children.translated_text: But bodhisattvas, great beings, <s>Śāriputra</s>, do not become attached to any dharma at all."

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat evaṃ śikṣamāṇo bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvajñatāyāṃ śikṣate bhagavānāha evaṃ śikṣamāṇaḥ śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvajñatāyām api na śikṣate
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, does a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way train in omniscience?" The Blessed One said: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way does not train even in omniscience.

children.text: evaṃ śikṣamāṇaḥ śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvadharmeṣu śikṣate
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way trains in all dharmas.

children.text: evaṃ śikṣamāṇaḥ śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvajñatāyāṃ śikṣate sarvajñatāyā āsannībhavati sarvajñatāyāṃ niryāsyati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, training in this way trains in omniscience, comes near to omniscience, and will go forth into omniscience."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat yo bhagavan evaṃ paripṛcchet kimayaṃ māyāpuruṣāḥ sarvajñatāyāṃ śikṣiṣyate sarvajñatāyā āsannībhaviṣyati sarvajñatāyāṃ niryāsyatīti tasya bhagavan evaṃ paripṛcchataḥ kathaṃ nirdeṣṭavyaṃ syāt evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat tena hi subhūte tvāmevātra pratiprakṣyāmi
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, if someone were to ask in this way, 'Will this illusory person train in omniscience, come near to omniscience, and go forth into omniscience?' Blessed One, how should one explain matters to the person asking in this way?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Therefore, <s>Subhūti</s>, I will ask you about this very point in return.

children.text: yathā te kṣamate tathā vyākuryāḥ
children.translated_text: Answer as seems fitting to you."

children.text: sādhu bhagavannityāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīt
children.translated_text: "Good, Blessed One," the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> replied to the Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavānetadavocat tatkiṃ manyase subhūte anyā sā māyā anyattadrūpam anyā sā māyā anyā sā vedanā
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said this: "What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s>? Is that illusion one thing and that form another? Is that illusion one thing and that feeling another?

children.text: anyā sā saṃjñā anye te saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: Is that perception another, and are those formations another?

children.text: anyā sā māyā anyattadvijñānam subhūtirāha na hyetadbhagavan
children.translated_text: Is that illusion one thing and that consciousness another?" <s>Subhūti</s> said, "No indeed, Blessed One.

children.text: na hi bhagavan anyā sā māyā anyattadrūpam
children.translated_text: For, Blessed One, that illusion is not one thing and that form another.

children.text: rūpameva bhagavan māyā māyaiva rūpam
children.translated_text: Form itself, Blessed One, is illusion; illusion itself is form.

children.text: na hi bhagavan anyā sā māyā anyā sā vedanā anyā sā saṃjñā anye te saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: For, Blessed One, that illusion is not one thing, feeling another, perception another, and those formations another.

children.text: vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārā eva bhagavan māyā māyaiva vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: Feeling, perception, and formations themselves, Blessed One, are illusion; illusion itself is feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: na bhagavan anyā sā māyā anyattadvijñānam
children.translated_text: Blessed One, that illusion is not one thing and that consciousness another.

children.text: vijñānameva bhagavan māyā māyaiva vijñānam ||
children.translated_text: Consciousness itself, Blessed One, is illusion; illusion itself is consciousness."

children.text: bhagavānāha tatkiṃ manyase subhūte atraiṣāṃ saṃjñā samajñā prajñaptirvyavahāraḥ pañcasūpādānaskandheṣu yaduta bodhisattva iti evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat evametadbhagavan evametatsugata
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s>? Here, with regard to these five aggregates of appropriation, is this name, designation, concept, and conventional expression, namely 'bodhisattva'?" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "So it is, Blessed One; so it is, Sugata.

children.text: tena hi bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣamāṇena māyāpuruṣeṇeva śikṣitavyaṃ bhavatyanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau
children.translated_text: Therefore, Blessed One, a bodhisattva, a great being, who is training in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should train for unsurpassed complete perfect awakening as if he were an illusory person.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sa eva hi bhagavan māyāpuruṣo dhārayitavyo yaduta pañcopādānaskandhāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, Blessed One, that very illusory person is to be held to be, namely, the five aggregates of appropriation.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi bhagavan māyopamaṃ rūpamuktaṃ bhagavatā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For thus, Blessed One, form has been said by the Blessed One to be like illusion.

children.text: yacca rūpaṃ tatṣaḍindriyaṃ te pañca skandhāḥ
children.translated_text: And whatever is form, that is the six sense faculties; these are the five aggregates.

children.text: tathā hi bhagavan māyopamā vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārā uktāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, Blessed One, feeling, perception, and formations have been said to be like illusion.

children.text: tathā hi bhagavan māyopamaṃ vijñānamuktaṃ bhagavatā
children.translated_text: Thus, Blessed One, consciousness has been said by the Blessed One to be like illusion.

children.text: yacca vijñānaṃ tatṣaḍindriyaṃ te pañca skandhāḥ
children.translated_text: And whatever is consciousness, that is the six sense faculties; these are the five aggregates.

children.text: mā bhagavan navayānasamprasthitā bodhisattvā mahāsattvā imaṃ nirdeśaṃ śrutvā uttrasiṣuḥ saṃtrasiṣuḥ saṃtrāsamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: May newly set-out bodhisattvas, great beings, Blessed One, after hearing this instruction, not be frightened, terrified, or fall into terror."

children.text: bhagavānāha yadi subhūte navayānasamprasthitā bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ pāpamitrahastagatā bhaviṣyanti uttrasiṣyanti saṃtrasiṣyanti saṃtrāsamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "If, <s>Subhūti</s>, newly set-out bodhisattvas, great beings, have fallen into the hands of bad friends, they will be frightened, terrified, and fall into terror.

children.text: atha cetsubhūte navayānasamprasthitā bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ kalyāṇamitrahastagatā bhaviṣyanti nottrasiṣyanti na saṃtrasiṣyanti na saṃtrāsamāpatsyante ||
children.translated_text: But if, <s>Subhūti</s>, newly set-out bodhisattvas, great beings, have fallen into the hands of good friends, they will not be frightened, will not be terrified, and will not fall into terror."

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat kāni punarbhagavan bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya kalyāṇamitrāṇi veditavyāni bhagavānāha ya enaṃ pāramitāsu avavadanti anuśāsati
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Which, then, Blessed One, should be known as the good friends of a bodhisattva, a great being?" The Blessed One said, "Those who advise and instruct him in the perfections,

children.text: ye 'smai mārakarmāṇyupadiśanti
children.translated_text: those who point out to him the deeds of <s>Māra</s>:

children.text: evaṃ māradoṣā boddhavyāḥ ime māradoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: 'Thus the faults of <s>Māra</s> should be understood; these are the faults of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: evaṃ mārakarmāṇi boddhavyāni imāni mārakarmāṇi
children.translated_text: Thus the deeds of <s>Māra</s> should be understood; these are the deeds of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: tāni tvayā buddhvā vivarjayitavyānīti
children.translated_text: Having understood them, you should avoid them.'

children.text: imāni subhūte bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddhasya mahāyānasamprasthitasya mahāyānasamārūḍhasya kalyāṇamitrāṇi veditavyāni
children.translated_text: These, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be known as the good friends of a bodhisattva, a great being, who is armed with the great armor, set out in the great vehicle, and mounted upon the great vehicle."

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat yadbhagavānevamāha imāni subhūte bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddhasya mahāyānasamprasthitasya mahāyānasamārūḍhasya kalyāṇamitrāṇi veditavyānīti
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, as the Blessed One says, 'These, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be known as the good friends of a bodhisattva, a great being, who is armed with the great armor, set out in the great vehicle, and mounted upon the great vehicle,'

children.text: yacca bodhisattvo mahāsattva iti bhagavannucyate tatra bodhisattva iti bhagavan kaḥ padārtha evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat apadārthaḥ subhūte bodhisattvapadārthaḥ
children.translated_text: and as it is said, Blessed One, 'bodhisattva, great being,' what is the meaning of the word 'bodhisattva' there, Blessed One?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "<s>Subhūti</s>, the meaning of the word 'bodhisattva' is no meaning.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ hi subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'saktatāyāṃ śikṣate
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Subhūti</s>, the bodhisattva, the great being, trains in non-attachment to all dharmas.

children.text: sarvadharmāṇāṃ hi subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nubodhanārthena asaktatāyāmanuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhyate
children.translated_text: For, <s>Subhūti</s>, for the sake of fully awakening to all dharmas, the bodhisattva, the great being, fully awakens to unsurpassed complete perfect awakening in non-attachment.

children.text: bodhyarthena tu subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattva ityucyate
children.translated_text: But, <s>Subhūti</s>, he is called a bodhisattva, a great being, for the sake of awakening."

children.text: subhūtirāha yatpunarbhagavānevamāha bodhisattvo mahāsattva iti kena kāraṇena bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattva ityucyate bhagavānāha mahataḥ sattvarāśermahataḥ sattvanikāyasya agratāṃ kārayiṣyati tenārthena bodhisattvo mahāsattva ityucyate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said, "As the Blessed One further says, 'bodhisattva, great being,' for what reason, Blessed One, is he called a bodhisattva, a great being?" The Blessed One said, "He will bring a great mass of beings, a great community of beings, to foremost rank; in that sense he is called a bodhisattva, a great being."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat mamāpi bhagavan pratibhāti yenārthena bodhisattvo mahāsattva ityucyate
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, it also occurs to me in what sense he is called a bodhisattva, a great being."

children.text: bhagavānāha pratibhātu te śāriputra yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "Let it occur to you, <s>Śāriputra</s>, if you think this is the time."

children.text: āyuṣmān śāriputra āha mahatyā ātmadṛṣṭyāḥ sattvadṛṣṭyāḥ jīvadṛṣṭyāḥ pudgaladṛṣṭyāḥ bhavadṛṣṭyāḥ vibhavadṛṣṭyāḥ ucchedadṛṣṭyāḥ śāśvatadṛṣṭyāḥ svakāyadṛṣṭyāḥ etāsāmevamādyānāṃ dṛṣṭīnāṃ prahāṇāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyatīti tenārthena bodhisattvo mahāsattva ityucyate
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said, "He will teach the dharma for the abandoning of a great view of self, a view of beings, a view of life, a view of a person, a view of existence, a view of nonexistence, a view of annihilation, a view of permanence, a view of one's own body, and other such views. In that sense he is called a bodhisattva, a great being."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat mamāpi bhagavan pratibhāti yenārthena bodhisattvo mahāsattva ityucyate
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, it also occurs to me in what sense he is called a bodhisattva, a great being."

children.text: bhagavānāha pratibhātu te subhūte yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "Let it be clear to you, <s>Subhūti</s>, if you think that now is the time."

children.text: subhūtirāha bodhisattvo mahāsattva iti bhagavannucyate
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Blessed One, it is called a bodhisattva, a great being.

children.text: yad api tadbhagavan bodhicittaṃ sarvajñatācittamanāsravaṃ cittamasamaṃ cittaṃ asamasamaṃ cittamasādhāraṇaṃ sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaiḥ tatrāpi citte asakto 'paryāpannaḥ
children.translated_text: And that <s>bodhicitta</s> (mind of awakening), Blessed One, the mind of omniscience, the uncontaminated mind, the unequaled mind, the mind equal to the unequaled, the mind not shared with all śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas: even with regard to that mind he is unattached and not contained in it.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi tatsarvajñatācittam anāsravam aparyāpannaṃ tat yad api tatsarvajñatācittam anāsravam aparyāpannam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For that mind of omniscience is uncontaminated and not contained; and as for that mind of omniscience which is uncontaminated and not contained,

children.text: tatrāpi citte asakto 'paryāpannaḥ
children.translated_text: even with regard to that mind he is unattached and not contained in it.

children.text: tenārthena bodhisattvo mahāsattva iti saṃkhyāṃ gacchati ||
children.translated_text: In this sense he is counted as a bodhisattva, a great being."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat kena kāraṇena āyuṣman subhūte tatrāpi citte asakto 'paryāpannaḥ subhūtirāha acittatvādāyuṣman śāriputra tatrāpi citte asakto 'paryāpannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "For what reason, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is he unattached and not contained even with regard to that mind?" <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Because of its being no mind, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, he is unattached and not contained even with regard to that mind."

children.text: śāriputra āha kiṃ punarāyuṣman subhūte asti taccittaṃ yaccittamacittam subhūtirāha kiṃ punarāyuṣman śāriputra tatra acittatāyāmastitā vā nāstitā vā vidyate vā upalabhyate vā śāriputra āha no hīdamāyuṣman subhūte
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "But, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, does that mind exist which is no mind?" <s>Subhūti</s> said: "But, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, in that absence of mind is existence or nonexistence found or apprehended?" <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "No indeed, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>."

children.text: subhūtirāha tadyadi āyuṣman śāriputra tatra acittatāyāmastitā vā nāstitā vā na vidyate vā nopalabhyate vā tatkatham āyuṣmān śāriputra evamāha asti taccittaṃ yaccittamacittamiti śāriputra āha sādhu sādhu āyuṣman subhūte
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Then if, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, in that absence of mind neither existence nor nonexistence is found or apprehended, how then does the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> say, 'Does that mind exist which is no mind?'" <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "Good, good, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: yathāpi nāma tvaṃ bhagavatā araṇāvihāriṇāmagratāyāṃ nirdiṣṭo nirdiśasi ||
children.translated_text: You teach just as you, who were designated by the Blessed One as foremost among those who dwell without contention, do teach."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān pūrṇo maitrāyaṇīputro bhagavantametadavocat mahāsattvo mahāsattva iti yadidaṃ bhagavannucyate mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddhaḥ sa sattvaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa Maitrāyaṇīputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Great being, great being: this, Blessed One, is what is said. That being is armed with the great armor.

children.text: mahāyānasamprasthito mahāyānasamārūḍhaś ca sa sattvaḥ
children.translated_text: That being has set out in the <s>Mahāyāna</s> (great vehicle) and has mounted the <s>Mahāyāna</s>.

children.text: tasmātsa mahāsattvo mahāsattva iti saṃkhyāṃ gacchati ||
children.translated_text: Therefore he is counted as a great being, a great being."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddho mahāyānasaṃnaddha iti yadidaṃ bhagavannucyate kiyatā bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddho bhavati bhagavānāha iha subhūte bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasyaivaṃ bhavati aprameyā mayā sattvāḥ parinirvāpayitavyā iti
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Armed with the great armor, armed for the <s>Mahāyāna</s>: this, Blessed One, is what is said. To what extent, Blessed One, is a bodhisattva, a great being, armed with the great armor?" The Blessed One said: "Here, <s>Subhūti</s>, it occurs to the bodhisattva, the great being, 'Immeasurable beings are to be brought by me to final nirvāṇa.'

children.text: asaṃkhyeyā mayā sattvāḥ parinirvāpayitavyā iti
children.translated_text: 'Incalculable beings are to be brought by me to final nirvāṇa.'

children.text: na ca te santi yairye parinirvāpayitavyā iti
children.translated_text: And yet those do not exist by whom those beings are to be brought to final nirvāṇa.

children.text: sa tāṃstāvataḥ sattvān parinirvāpayati
children.translated_text: He brings that many beings to final nirvāṇa,

children.text: na ca sa kaścitsattvo yaḥ parinirvṛto yena ca parinirvāpito bhavati
children.translated_text: and yet there is no being at all who has attained final nirvāṇa, nor anyone by whom he has been brought to final nirvāṇa.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ dharmataiṣā subhūte dharmāṇāṃ māyādharmatāmupādāya syāt
children.translated_text: Why is that? This is the nature of dharmas, <s>Subhūti</s>, because dharmas have the nature of an illusion.

children.text: yathāpi nāma subhūte dakṣo māyākāro vā māyākārāntevāsī vā caturmahāpathe mahāntaṃ janakāyamabhinirmimīte
children.translated_text: For example, <s>Subhūti</s>, a skilled magician or a magician's apprentice might create a great crowd of people at a great crossroads.

children.text: abhinirmāya tasyaiva mahato janakāyasyāntardhānaṃ kuryāt
children.translated_text: Having created it, he might make that very great crowd of people disappear.

children.text: tatkiṃ manyase subhūte api nu tatra kenacitkaściddhato vā mṛto vā nāśito vā antarhito vā subhūtirāha no hīdaṃ bhagavan
children.translated_text: What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s>? Has anyone there been struck, killed, destroyed, or made to vanish by anyone?" <s>Subhūti</s> said: "No indeed, Blessed One."

children.text: bhagavānāha evameva subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'prameyānasaṃkhyeyān sattvān parinirvāpayati
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "In just this way, <s>Subhūti</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, brings immeasurable, incalculable beings to final nirvāṇa,

children.text: na ca sa kaścitsattvo yaḥ parinirvṛto yena ca parinirvāpito bhavati
children.translated_text: and yet there is no being at all who has attained final nirvāṇa, nor anyone by whom he has been brought to final nirvāṇa.

children.text: sacedbodhisattvo mahāsattva imaṃ nirdeśamevaṃ nirdiśyamānaṃ śrutvā nottrasyati na saṃtrasyati na saṃtrāsamāpadyate iyatā ayaṃ subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddho veditavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: If a bodhisattva, a great being, hearing this teaching being taught in this way, is not alarmed, not frightened, and does not fall into terror, to this extent, <s>Subhūti</s>, that bodhisattva, that great being, should be understood as armed with the great armor."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat yathāhaṃ bhagavan bhagavato bhāṣitasyārthamājānāmi tathā asaṃnāhasaṃnaddho batāyaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "As I understand the meaning of the Blessed One's speech, Blessed One, this bodhisattva, this great being, should indeed be understood as armed with no armor."

children.text: bhagavānāha evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: asaṃnāhasaṃnaddho batāyaṃ bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: This bodhisattva, this great being, should indeed be understood as armed with no armor.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ akṛtā hi subhūte sarvajñatā avikṛtā anabhisaṃskṛtā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For omniscience, <s>Subhūti</s>, is unmade, unaltered, and unconditioned.

children.text: te 'pi sattvā akṛtā avikṛtā anabhisaṃskṛtāḥ yeṣāṃ sattvānāmarthāya ayaṃ saṃnāhasaṃnaddhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those beings too are unmade, unaltered, and unconditioned, for whose sake this one is armed with armor."

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat evametadbhagavan evametatsugata
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "So it is, Blessed One; so it is, Sugata.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi bhagavan rūpamabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For form, Blessed One, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: tathā hi bhagavan vijñānamabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: For consciousness, Blessed One, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: rūpatathatāpi bhagavan abaddhā amuktā
children.translated_text: The suchness of form too, Blessed One, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: evaṃ vedanātathatāpi saṃjñātathatāpi saṃskāratathatāpi
children.translated_text: So too the suchness of feeling, the suchness of perception, and the suchness of formations.

children.text: vijñānatathatāpi bhagavan abaddhā amuktā ||
children.translated_text: The suchness of consciousness too, Blessed One, is not bound and not freed."

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān pūrṇo maitrāyaṇīputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat rūpamāyuṣman subhūte abaddhamamuktamiti vadasi
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Pūrṇa Maitrāyaṇīputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, you say that form is not bound and not released.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānamāyuṣman subhūte abaddhamamuktamiti vadasi
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, you say that consciousness is not bound and not released.

children.text: rūpatathatāpi āyuṣman subhūte abaddhā amukteti vadasi
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, you say that the suchness of form also is not bound and not released.

children.text: evaṃ vedanātathatāpi saṃjñātathatāpi saṃskāratathatāpi
children.translated_text: So too also the suchness of feeling, the suchness of perception, and the suchness of formations.

children.text: vijñānatathatāpyāyuṣman subhūte abaddhā amukteti vadasi
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, you say that the suchness of consciousness also is not bound and not released.

children.text: atha katamattadāyuṣman subhūte rūpaṃ yadrūpamabaddhamamuktamiti vadasi evaṃ katamā sā vedanā katamā sā saṃjñā katame te saṃskārāḥ katamattadāyuṣman subhūte vijñānaṃ yadvijñānamabaddhamamuktamiti vadasi katamā sā āyuṣman subhūte rūpatathatā yā rūpatathatāpyabaddhā amukteti vadasi evaṃ katamā sā vedanātathatā saṃjñātathatā saṃskāratathatā katamā sā āyuṣman subhūte vijñānatathatā yā vijñānatathatāpyabaddhā amukteti vadasi evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirāyuṣmantaṃ pūrṇaṃ maitrāyaṇīputrametadavocat yadāyuṣman pūrṇa māyāpuruṣasya rūpaṃ tadabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: Then what, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is that form of which you say, 'Form is not bound and not released'? So too, what is that feeling? What is that perception? What are those formations? What, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is that consciousness of which you say, 'Consciousness is not bound and not released'? What, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is that suchness of form of which you say, 'The suchness of form also is not bound and not released'? So too, what is that suchness of feeling, that suchness of perception, that suchness of formations? What, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, is that suchness of consciousness of which you say, 'The suchness of consciousness also is not bound and not released'?" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the venerable <s>Pūrṇa Maitrāyaṇīputra</s>: "Venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, whatever form belongs to an illusory person, that is not bound and not released.

children.text: evaṃ yā māyāpuruṣasya vedanā yā māyāpuruṣasya saṃjñā ye māyāpuruṣasya saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too, whatever feeling belongs to an illusory person, whatever perception belongs to an illusory person, and whatever formations belong to an illusory person,

children.text: yadāyuṣman pūrṇa māyāpuruṣasya vijñānaṃ tadabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, whatever consciousness belongs to an illusory person, that is not bound and not released.

children.text: yā āyuṣman pūrṇa māyāpuruṣasya rūpatathatā sā abaddhā amuktā
children.translated_text: Venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, whatever suchness of form belongs to an illusory person, that is not bound and not released.

children.text: evaṃ yā māyāpuruṣasya vedanātathatā saṃjñātathatā saṃskāratathatā
children.translated_text: So too, whatever suchness of feeling, suchness of perception, and suchness of formations belong to an illusory person,

children.text: yā āyuṣman pūrṇa māyāpuruṣasya vijñānatathatā sā abaddhā amuktā
children.translated_text: venerable <s>Pūrṇa</s>, whatever suchness of consciousness belongs to an illusory person, that is not bound and not released.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ asadbhūtatvādabaddhā amuktā viviktatvādabaddhā amuktā anutpannatvādabaddhā amuktā
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because it is not a real thing, it is not bound and not released; because it is isolated, it is not bound and not released; because it is unarisen, it is not bound and not released.

children.text: ayaṃ sa bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddhasya mahāyānasamprasthitasya mahāyānasamārūḍhasya mahāsaṃnāho 'saṃnāhaḥ
children.translated_text: This is the great armor that is no armor for a bodhisattva, a great being, who is armed with the great armor, set out in the Mahāyāna, and mounted upon the Mahāyāna.

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān pūrṇo maitrāyaṇīputrastūṣṇīmabhūt ||
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Pūrṇa Maitrāyaṇīputra</s> became silent.

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat evaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddhaḥ san mahāyānasamprasthito mahāyānasamārūḍho bhavati
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "In this way, Blessed One, a bodhisattva, a great being, being armed with the great armor, has set out in the Mahāyāna and has mounted upon the Mahāyāna.

children.text: katamacca tanmahāyānam kathaṃ vā tatsamprasthito veditavyaḥ kuto vā tanmahāyānaṃ niryāsyati kena vā tanmahāyānaṃ samprasthitam kva vā tanmahāyānaṃ sthāsyati ko vā anena mahāyānena niryāsyati evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat mahāyānamiti subhūte aprameyatāyā etadadhivacanam
children.translated_text: But what is that Mahāyāna? And how is one to know that he has set out in it? From where will that Mahāyāna go forth? By what has that Mahāyāna set out? Where will that Mahāyāna stand? Who will go forth by this Mahāyāna?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "'Mahāyāna,' <s>Subhūti</s>, is a designation for immeasurability.

children.text: aprameyamiti subhūte apramāṇatvena
children.translated_text: 'Immeasurable,' <s>Subhūti</s>, because it is without measure.

children.text: yad api subhūte evaṃ vadasi kathaṃ vā tatsamprasthito veditavyaḥ kuto vā tanmahāyānaṃ niryāsyati kena vā tanmahāyānaṃ samprasthitam kva vā tanmahāyānaṃ sthāsyati ko vā anena mahāyānena niryāsyatīti pāramitābhiḥ samprasthitaḥ
children.translated_text: And as for what you say, <s>Subhūti</s>, 'How is one to know that he has set out in it? From where will that Mahāyāna go forth? By what has that Mahāyāna set out? Where will that Mahāyāna stand? Who will go forth by this Mahāyāna?' He has set out by means of the perfections.

children.text: traidhātukānniryāsyati
children.translated_text: He will go forth from the three realms.

children.text: yenārambaṇaṃ tena samprasthitam
children.translated_text: By whatever is the object of support, by that it has set out.

children.text: sarvajñatāyāṃ sthāsyati
children.translated_text: It will stand in omniscience.

children.text: bodhisattvo mahāsattvo niryāsyati api tu khalu punarna kutaścinniryāsyati
children.translated_text: A bodhisattva, a great being, will go forth; but then again, he will not go forth from anywhere.

children.text: na kenāpi samprasthitam
children.translated_text: It has not set out by anything.

children.text: na kvacitsthāsyati
children.translated_text: It will not stand anywhere.

children.text: api tu sthāsyati sarvajñatāyām asthānayogena
children.translated_text: But it will stand in omniscience by the mode of non-standing.

children.text: nāpi kaścittena mahāyānena niryāto nāpi niryāsyati nāpi niryāti
children.translated_text: Nor has anyone gone forth by that Mahāyāna, nor will anyone go forth, nor is anyone going forth.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yaś ca niryāyāt yena ca niryāyāt ubhāvetau dharmau na vidyete nopalabhyete
children.translated_text: Why is that? The one who would go forth and that by which he would go forth: these two dharmas do not exist and are not apprehended.

children.text: evamavidyamāneṣu sarvadharmeṣu katamo dharmaḥ katamena dharmeṇa niryāsyati evaṃ hi subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo mahāyānasaṃnaddho mahāyānasamprasthito mahāyānasamārūḍho bhavati ||
children.translated_text: When all dharmas are nonexistent in this way, what dharma will go forth by what dharma? Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, a bodhisattva, a great being, is armed with the Mahāyāna, has set out in the Mahāyāna, and has mounted upon the Mahāyāna."

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat mahāyānaṃ mahāyānamiti bhagavannucyate
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "'Mahāyāna, Mahāyāna,' Blessed One, it is said.

children.text: sadevamānuṣāsuraṃ lokamabhibhavanniryāsyati ākāśasamatayā atimahattayā tanmahāyānam
children.translated_text: Surpassing the world with its gods, humans, and asuras, it will go forth. Because it is equal to space and because of its exceedingly great magnitude, that is the Mahāyāna.

children.text: yathā ākāśe aprameyāṇāmasaṃkhyeyānāṃ sattvānāmavakāśaḥ evameva bhagavan asmin yāne aprameyāṇāmasaṃkhyeyānāṃ sattvānāmavakāśaḥ
children.translated_text: Just as in space there is room for immeasurable, incalculable beings, so too, Blessed One, in this vehicle there is room for immeasurable, incalculable beings.

children.text: anena bhagavan paryāyeṇa mahāyānamidaṃ bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānām
children.translated_text: In this manner, Blessed One, this is the Mahāyāna of bodhisattvas, great beings.

children.text: naivāsyāgamo dṛśyate naivāsya nirgamo dṛśyate nāpyasya sthānaṃ saṃvidyate
children.translated_text: No coming of it is seen; no going out of it is seen; nor is any standing-place of it found.

children.text: evamasya bhagavan mahāyānasya naiva pūrvānta upalabhyate nāpyaparānta upalabhyate nāpi madhya upalabhyate
children.translated_text: Thus, Blessed One, no prior limit of this Mahāyāna is apprehended, nor is any later limit apprehended, nor is any middle apprehended.

children.text: atha samaṃ bhagavaṃstadyānam
children.translated_text: Thus, Blessed One, that vehicle is equal.

children.text: tasmānmahāyānaṃ mahāyānamityucyate
children.translated_text: Therefore it is called 'Mahāyāna, Mahāyāna.'"

children.text: atha khalu bhagavānāyuṣmate subhūtaye sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu subhūte
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One gave his approval to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "Good, good, <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is."
