children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: More merit than that, <s>Kauśika</s>, is produced by the son of good family or daughter of good family who, having faith in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, accepting it, believing in it, and being clear-minded, has generated the mind for awakening and, with earnest intention, listens to it, takes it up, retains it, recites it, masters it, sets it forth, teaches it, instructs in it, proclaims it, studies it, explains it in detail to others, makes its meaning clear, examines it mentally, and enters into investigation of it with the highest wisdom available, and who, even at least by putting it into a book, preserves it and establishes it for the long abiding of the true Dharma, thinking: May the guide of the Buddhas not be cut off; may the true Dharma not disappear.

children.text: bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ ca anugrahopasaṃhāraḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati netryavaikalyeneti
children.translated_text: The favor and support of bodhisattvas, great beings, will have been accomplished, because the guide will not be impaired.

children.text: tāṃ caināṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ satkuryādgurukuryānmānayet pūjayedarcayed apacāyet puṣpair dhūpair gandhairmālyair vilepanaiścūrṇairvastraiśchatrairdhvajairghaṇṭābhiḥ patākābhiḥ samantācca dīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca pūjābhiḥ pūjayet ayameva tataḥ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati ||
children.translated_text: And if he honors this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, reveres it, respects it, worships it, venerates it, and pays homage to it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, garments, parasols, banners, bells, and flags, with rows of lamps all around, and with many kinds of offerings, then that very son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces more merit than that on this account.

children.text: evam ukte śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat evametadbhagavan evametatsugata
children.translated_text: When this had been said, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: So it is, Blessed One; so it is, <s>Sugata</s>.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāṃ hi bhagavan satkurvatā gurukurvatā mānayatā pūjayatā arcayatā apacāyatā kulaputreṇa vā kuladuhitrā vā atītānāgatapratyutpannā buddhā bhagavanto buddhajñānaparijñāteṣu sarvalokadhātuṣu atyantatayā satkṛtā gurukṛtā mānitāḥ pūjitā arcitā apacāyitāś ca bhavanti
children.translated_text: For, Blessed One, when a son of good family or daughter of good family honors, reveres, respects, worships, venerates, and pays homage to the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, the Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, past, future, and present, in all world-systems comprehended by Buddha-knowledge, are completely honored, revered, respected, worshipped, venerated, and paid homage to.

children.text: tiṣṭhantu khalu punarbhagavan anena paryāyeṇa trisāhasramahāsāhasre lokadhātau sarvasattvāḥ ye 'pi te bhagavan gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sarvasattvāḥ tatra ekaikaḥ sattvaḥ ekaikaṃ saptaratnamayaṃ tathāgatadhātugarbhaṃ stūpaṃ kārayet ekaikaś ca sattvastān sarvān stūpān kārayet kārayitvā ca tān pratiṣṭhāpya kalpaṃ vā kalpāvaśeṣaṃ vā sarvavādyaiḥ sarvagītaiḥ sarvanṛtyaiḥ sarvatūryatālāvacarairdivyaiḥ sarvapuṣpaiḥ sarvadhūpaiḥ sarvagandhaiḥ sarvamālyaiḥ sarvavilepanaiḥ sarvacūrṇaiḥ sarvavastrairdivyābhiḥ sarvacchatradhvajaghaṇṭāpatākābhiḥ samantācca sarvadīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca divyamānuṣikībhiḥ sarvapūjābhiḥ satkuryādgurukuryānmānayet pūjayedarcayedapacāyet ayameva tebhyaḥ sa bhagavan sarvasattvebhyaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmabhiśraddadhadavakalpayannadhimucya prasannacitto bodhāya cittamutpādya adhyāśayataḥ śṛṇuyādudgṛhṇīyāddhārayedvācayet paryavāpnuyāt pravartayeddeśayedupadiśeduddiśet svādhyāyet parebhyaś ca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayet arthamasyā vivṛṇuyāt manasānvavekṣeta yathādhikayā ca prajñayā atra parimīmāṃsāmāpadyeta antaśaḥ pustakagatām api kṛtvā dhārayetsthāpayetsaddharmacirasthitihetoḥ mā buddhanetrīsamucchedo bhūt mā saddharmāntardhānam
children.translated_text: Let alone, then, Blessed One, all the beings in this great three-thousand great-thousand world-system by this account. Blessed One, suppose that among the beings in great three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Gaṅgā</s>, each single being were to have made a single <s>stūpa</s>, made of the seven precious substances and containing the relic-chamber of a <s>Tathāgata</s>; and that each single being were to have all those <s>stūpas</s> made. After having had them made and established, for an aeon or the remainder of an aeon he were to honor, revere, esteem, worship, venerate, and pay homage to them with all instruments, all songs, all dances, all divine music with cymbals, all flowers, all incenses, all perfumes, all garlands, all unguents, all powders, all garments, all divine parasols, banners, bells, and flags, with rows of lamps all around, and with many kinds of divine and human offerings. Blessed One, that son of good family or daughter of good family who, having faith in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, accepting it, trusting it, with a serene mind, having generated the mind directed to awakening, would hear it with deep intention, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, recite it aloud, study it, make it known in detail to others, explain its meaning, examine it mentally, and enter into investigation of it with whatever wisdom he has; and who, at least, having made it into a book, would preserve it and establish it for the sake of the long abiding of the <s>saddharma</s>, thinking, 'May the <s>buddhanetrī</s> not be cut off; may the <s>saddharma</s> not disappear,' produces still more merit than all those beings.

children.text: bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ ca anugrahopasaṃhāraḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati netryavaikalyeneti
children.translated_text: and thinking, 'Assistance and support for bodhisattvas, great beings, will have been accomplished through the unimpairedness of the guide.'

children.text: tāṃ caināṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ satkuryādgurukuryānmānayet pūjayedarcayedapacāyet puṣpairdhūpairgandhairmālyair vilepanaiścūrṇairvastraiśchatrair dhvajairghaṇṭābhiḥ patākābhiḥ samantācca dīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca pūjābhiḥ pūjayet ||
children.translated_text: And he should honor, revere, esteem, worship, venerate, and pay homage to this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; he should worship it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, unguents, powders, garments, parasols, banners, bells, flags, with rows of lamps all around, and with many kinds of offerings.

children.text: atha khalu bhagavān śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat evametatkauśika evam etat
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "So it is, <s>Kauśika</s>; so it is.

children.text: bahutaraṃ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces still more merit on that account.

children.text: aprameyaṃ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces immeasurably still more merit on that account.

children.text: asaṃkhyeyaṃ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces incalculably still more merit on that account.

children.text: acintyaṃ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces inconceivably still more merit on that account.

children.text: atulyaṃ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces incomparably still more merit on that account.

children.text: aparimāṇaṃ sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, produces boundlessly still more merit on that account.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ prajñāpāramitānirjātā hi kauśika tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ sarvajñatā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Kauśika</s>, the omniscience of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, is born from the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sarvajñatānirjātā ca tathāgataśarīrāṇāṃ pūjā
children.translated_text: And from omniscience is born the worship of the bodies of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>.

children.text: tasmāttarhi kauśika yaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmabhiśraddadhadavakalpayannadhimucya prasannacitto bodhāya cittamutpādya adhyāśayataḥ śṛṇuyādudgṛhṇīyāddhārayedvācayet paryavāpnuyātpravartayeddeśayed upadiśeduddiśet svādhyāyet parebhyaś ca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayet arthamasyā vivṛṇuyāt manasānvavekṣeta yathādhikayā ca prajñayā atra parimīmāṃsāmāpadyeta antaśaḥ pustakagatām api kṛtvā dhārayetsthāpayetsaddharmacirasthitihetoḥ mā buddhanetrīsamucchedo bhūt mā saddharmāntardhānam
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Kauśika</s>, a son of good family or daughter of good family who, having faith in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, accepting it, trusting it, with a serene mind, having generated the mind directed to awakening, would hear it with deep intention, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, recite it aloud, study it, make it known in detail to others, explain its meaning, examine it mentally, and enter into investigation of it with whatever wisdom he has; and who, at least, having made it into a book, would preserve it and establish it for the sake of the long abiding of the <s>saddharma</s>, thinking, 'May the <s>buddhanetrī</s> not be cut off; may the <s>saddharma</s> not disappear,'

children.text: bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ ca anugrahopasaṃhāraḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati netryavaikalyeneti
children.translated_text: and thinking, 'Assistance and support for bodhisattvas, great beings, will have been accomplished through the unimpairedness of the guide,'

children.text: tāṃ caināṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ satkuryādgurukuryānmānayet pūjayedarcayedapacāyet puṣpairdhūpairgandhairmālyair vilepanaiścūrṇairvastraiśchatrair dhvajairghaṇṭābhiḥ patākābhiḥ samantācca dīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca pūjābhiḥ pūjayet asya kauśika puṇyābhisaṃskārasya asau pūrvakastathāgatadhātugarbhaḥ saptaratnamayaḥ stūpasaṃskārajapuṇyābhisaṃskāraḥ śatatamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti sahasratamīmapi śatasahasratamīmapi koṭītamīmapi koṭīśatatamīmapi koṭīsahasratamīmapi koṭīśatasahasratamīmapi koṭīniyutaśatasahasratamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti
children.translated_text: and who should honor, revere, esteem, worship, venerate, and pay homage to this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; who should worship it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, unguents, powders, garments, parasols, banners, bells, flags, with rows of lamps all around, and with many kinds of offerings: <s>Kauśika</s>, compared with this accumulation of merit, that former accumulation of merit from having <s>stūpas</s> made, made of the seven precious substances and containing relic-chambers of <s>Tathāgatas</s>, does not approach even a hundredth part, nor a thousandth, nor a hundred-thousandth, nor a ten-millionth, nor a hundred ten-millionth, nor a thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand ten-millionth, nor even a hundred-thousand niyutas of ten-millions' part.

children.text: saṃkhyām api kalām api gaṇanām api upamām api aupamyam api upanisām api upaniṣadam api na kṣamate ||
children.translated_text: It does not admit even of number, even of fraction, even of calculation, even of comparison, even of analogy, even of approximation, even of a hidden reckoning.

children.text: atha khalu yāni tāni catvāriṃśaddevaputrasahasrāṇi śakreṇa devānāmindreṇa sārdhaṃ saṃnipatitāni tasyāmeva parṣadi saṃnipatitānyabhūvan tāni śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocan udgṛhṇīṣva mārṣa prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Then the forty thousand sons of gods who had assembled together with <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, and had gathered in that very assembly, said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "Take up, sir, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: udgrahītavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be taken up.

children.text: dhārayitavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be retained.

children.text: vācayitavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be recited.

children.text: paryavāptavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be mastered.

children.text: pravartayitavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be set forth.

children.text: deśayitavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be taught.

children.text: upadeṣṭavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be instructed in.

children.text: uddeṣṭavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be proclaimed.

children.text: svādhyātavyā mārṣa prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sir, is to be studied."

children.text: atha khalu bhagavān śakraṃ devānāmindramāmantrayate sma udgṛhāṇa tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One addressed <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "Take up, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: dhāraya tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Retain, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: vācaya tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Recite, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: paryavāpnuhi tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Master, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: pravartaya tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Set forth, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: deśaya tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Teach, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: upadiśa tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Instruct in, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: uddiśaya tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Proclaim, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: svādhyāya tvaṃ kauśika prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Study, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetor yadā hi kauśika asurāṇāmevaṃrūpāḥ samudācārā utpatsyante devāṃstrāyastriṃśān yodhayiṣyāma iti devaistrāyastriṃśaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃgrāmayiṣyāma iti tadā tvaṃ kauśika imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ samanvāhareḥ svādhyāyeḥ evaṃ teṣāmasurāṇāṃ te samudācārāḥ punarevāntardhāsyanti ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For when, <s>Kauśika</s>, activities of this sort arise among the asuras: 'We shall wage war on the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> gods; we shall fight a battle with the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> gods,' then, <s>Kauśika</s>, you should bring this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind and study it. In this way those activities of those asuras will disappear again."

children.text: evamukte śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat mahāvidyeyaṃ bhagavan yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: When this had been said, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: "This, Blessed One, is a great <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge-spell), namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: apramāṇeyaṃ bhagavan vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is an immeasurable <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: aparimāṇeyaṃ bhagavan vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a boundless <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: niruttareyaṃ bhagavan vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a <s>vidyā</s> with none higher, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: anuttareyaṃ bhagavan vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the unsurpassed <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: asameyaṃ bhagavan vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the unequalled <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: asamasameyaṃ bhagavan vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the <s>vidyā</s> equal to the unequalled, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>."

children.text: evamukte bhagavān śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat evametatkauśika evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "So it is, <s>Kauśika</s>; so it is.

children.text: mahāvidyeyaṃ kauśika yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is a great <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: apramāṇeyaṃ kauśika vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is an immeasurable <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: aparimāṇeyaṃ kauśika vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is a boundless <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: niruttareyaṃ kauśika vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is a <s>vidyā</s> with none higher, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: anuttareyaṃ kauśika vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is the unsurpassed <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: asameyaṃ kauśika vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is the unequalled <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: asamasameyaṃ kauśika vidyā yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: This, <s>Kauśika</s>, is the <s>vidyā</s> equal to the unequalled, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ imāṃ hi kauśika vidyāmāgamya paurvakāstathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhā anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbuddhāḥ yaduta prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Why is that? For by resorting to this <s>vidyā</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>, the former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, awakened to unsurpassed perfect awakening, namely by resorting to the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: ye 'pi te kauśika bhaviṣyantyanāgate 'dhvani tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāḥ anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbhotsyante te 'pi kauśika imāmeva vidyāmāgamya anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbhotsyante yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: And those <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas who will exist in the future time and will awaken to unsurpassed perfect awakening, they too, <s>Kauśika</s>, will awaken to unsurpassed perfect awakening by resorting to this very <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: ye 'pi kecitkauśika etarhi aprameyeṣvasaṃkhyeyeṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu buddhā bhagavanto 'nuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhyante te 'pi kauśika imāmeva vidyāmāgamya anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhyante yaduta prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: And whatever Buddhas, Blessed Ones, are at present awakening to unsurpassed perfect awakening in immeasurable, incalculable great three-thousand great-thousand world-systems, they too, <s>Kauśika</s>, awaken to unsurpassed perfect awakening by resorting to this very <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: aham api kauśika imāmeva vidyāmāgamya anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbuddho yaduta prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: I too, <s>Kauśika</s>, awakened to unsurpassed perfect awakening by resorting to this very <s>vidyā</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: imāmeva kauśika vidyāmāgamya daśa kuśalāḥ karmapathā loke prabhāvyante catvāri dhyānāni bodhyaṅgasamprayuktāni loke prabhāvyante catvāryapramāṇāni bodhyaṅgasamprayuktāni loke prabhāvyante catasra ārūpyasamāpattayo bodhyaṅgaparigṛhītā loke prabhāvyante ṣaḍabhijñā bodhyaṅgasamprayuktā loke prabhāvyante saptatriṃśadbodhipakṣā dharmā loke prabhāvyante saṃkṣepeṇa caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasrāṇi loke prabhāvyante buddhajñānaṃ svayaṃbhūjñānamacintyajñānaṃ loke prabhāvyante imāmeva kauśika vidyāmāgamya yaduta prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: By resorting to this very <s>vidyā</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>, namely the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, the ten wholesome paths of action are made manifest in the world; the four <s>dhyānas</s> connected with the factors of awakening are made manifest in the world; the four immeasurables connected with the factors of awakening are made manifest in the world; the four formless attainments embraced by the factors of awakening are made manifest in the world; the six higher knowledges connected with the factors of awakening are made manifest in the world; the thirty-seven dharmas belonging to awakening are made manifest in the world; in brief, the eighty-four thousand aggregates of Dharma are made manifest in the world; Buddha-knowledge, self-born knowledge, and inconceivable knowledge are made manifest in the world."

children.text: yadāpi kauśika tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhā loke notpadyante tadāpi kauśika bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ pūrvaśrutena prajñāpāramitāniṣyandena ye upāyakauśalyasamanvāgatā bhavanti te 'pi kauśika sattvānāmanukampakāḥ anukampāmupādāya imaṃ lokamāgamya daśa kuśalān karmapathān loke prabhāvayanti catvāri dhyānāni bodhyaṅgaviprayuktāni loke prabhāvayanti catvāryapramāṇāni bodhyaṅgaviprayuktāni loke prabhāvayanti
children.translated_text: Even when, <s>Kauśika</s>, <s>Tathāgatas</s>, arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas do not arise in the world, then too, <s>Kauśika</s>, those bodhisattvas, great beings, who through what they have heard before, through the outflow of the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, are endowed with skillful means, are compassionate toward beings. Taking up compassion, they come into this world and make the ten wholesome paths of action prevail in the world; they make the four <s>dhyānas</s>, apart from the factors of awakening, prevail in the world; they make the four immeasurables, apart from the factors of awakening, prevail in the world.

children.text: catasra ārūpyasamāpattīrbodhyaṅgaviyuktā loke prabhāvayanti
children.translated_text: They make the four formless attainments, not connected with the factors of awakening, prevail in the world.

children.text: pañcābhijñā bodhyaṅgaviprayuktā loke prabhāvayanti
children.translated_text: They make the five superknowledges, apart from the factors of awakening, prevail in the world.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma kauśika candramaṇḍalamāgamya sarvā oṣadhīḥ tārā yathābalaṃ yathāsthāmam avabhāsayanti nakṣatrāṇi ca yathābalaṃ yathāsthāmam avabhāsayanti evameva kauśika tathāgatasyārhataṃ samyaksaṃbuddhasya atyayena saddharmasyāntardhāne tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāmanutpādāt yā kāciddharmacaryā samacaryā asamacaryā kuśalacaryā loke prajñāyate prabhāvyate sarvā sā bodhisattvanirjātā bodhisattvaprabhāvitā bodhisattvopāyakauśalyapravartitā
children.translated_text: Just as, <s>Kauśika</s>, when the disk of the moon has arisen, all herbs and the stars shine according to their power and according to their strength, and the constellations too shine according to their power and according to their strength, so too, <s>Kauśika</s>, after the passing of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha, when the true Dharma has disappeared and because <s>Tathāgatas</s>, arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas do not arise, whatever practice of Dharma, even conduct, uneven conduct, or wholesome conduct is known and made effective in the world, all of it has arisen from bodhisattvas, has been made effective by bodhisattvas, and has been set in motion by the bodhisattvas' skillful means.

children.text: tacca bodhisattvānāmupāyakauśalyaṃ prajñāpāramitānirjātaṃ veditavyam ||
children.translated_text: And that skillful means of the bodhisattvas should be understood as born from the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: punaraparaṃ kauśika imāṃ prajñāpāramitām udgṛhṇatāṃ dhārayatāṃ vācayatāṃ paryavāpnuvatāṃ pravartayatāṃ deśayatāmupadiśatāmuddiśatāṃ svādhyāyatāṃ likhatāṃ manasi kurvatāṃ samanvāharatāṃ ca kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ vā tannidānaṃ bahavo dṛṣṭadhārmikā guṇāḥ pratikāṅkṣitavyāḥ
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Kauśika</s>, many benefits visible in this very life should be expected on that account for sons of good family and daughters of good family who take up this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, write it, attend to it mentally, and bring it to mind.

children.text: evamukte śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat katamaiḥ punarbhagavan dṛṣṭadhārmikairguṇaiḥ samanvāgatāste kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraś ca bhaviṣyanti bhagavānāha na te kauśika kulaputrā vā kuladuhitaro vā viṣamāparihāreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti na viṣeṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti na śastreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti nāgninā kālaṃ kariṣyati nodakena kālaṃ kariṣyanti na daṇḍena kālaṃ kariṣyanti na paripakrameṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti
children.translated_text: When this had been said, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: 'Blessed One, with what benefits visible in this very life will those sons of good family and daughters of good family be endowed?' The Blessed One said: 'Those sons of good family or daughters of good family, <s>Kauśika</s>, will not die through misfortune; they will not die from poison; they will not die by the sword; they will not die by fire; they will not die by water; they will not die by a club; they will not die by assault.

children.text: utpannotpannāścaiṣāmupadravā rājato vā rājaputrato vā rājamantrito vā rājamahāmātrato vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ samanvāharatāṃ vā svādhyāyatāṃ vā punarevāntardhāsyanti
children.translated_text: And whatever dangers arise for them from a king, or from a prince, or from a royal minister, or from a high royal official, while they are bringing this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind or studying it, those dangers will disappear again.

children.text: teṣāṃ ca enāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ punaḥ punaḥ samanvāharatāṃ vā svādhyāyatāṃ vā ye tatropasaṃkrāmeyuravatāraprekṣiṇo 'vatāragaveṣiṇo rājāno vā rājaputrā vā rājamantriṇo vā rājamahāmātrā vā na te 'vatāraṃ lapsyante yathāpi nāma prajñāpāramitāparigṛhītatvāt
children.translated_text: And when they bring this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind again and again or study it, if kings, princes, royal ministers, or high royal officials should approach them there looking for an opening, seeking an opportunity, they will not find an opening, precisely because they are embraced by the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: upasaṃkrāntānāṃ ca teṣāṃ rājñāṃ vā rājaputrāṇāṃ vā rājamantriṇāṃ vā rājamahāmātrāṇāṃ vā ālapitukāmatā bhaviṣyati abhibhāṣitukāmatā bhaviṣyati pratisaṃmoditavyaṃ ca te maṃsyante
children.translated_text: And when those kings, princes, royal ministers, or high royal officials have approached, they will wish to converse with them, they will wish to address them, and they will think that friendly greetings should be exchanged.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ iyaṃ hi kauśika prajñāpāramitā sarvasattvānāmantike maitropasaṃhāreṇa maitracittatayā karuṇopasaṃhāreṇa karuṇacittatayā pratyupasthitā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>, stands present near all beings with an approach of friendliness, with a mind of loving-kindness, with an approach of compassion, and with a compassionate mind.

children.text: tasmāttarhi kauśika ye 'pi te vyālasarīsṛpakāntāramadhyagatāḥ teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ vā manuṣyā vā amanuṣyā vā avatāraprekṣiṇo 'vatāragaveṣiṇaḥ te 'pi teṣāṃ kauśika avatāraṃ na lapsyante sthāpayitvā pūrvakarmavipākam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Kauśika</s>, even when those sons of good family or daughters of good family are in the midst of a wilderness of wild beasts and creeping creatures, humans or nonhumans who look for an opening and seek an opportunity against them will not find an opening against them, <s>Kauśika</s>, except for the ripening of former karma.'

children.text: atha khalvanyatīrthyānāṃ parivrājakānām upālambhābhiprāyāṇāṃ śataṃ tasyāṃ velāyāṃ yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāmati sma
children.translated_text: Then, at that time, a hundred wanderers of other sects, intending to find fault, approached the place where the Blessed One was.

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindro dūrata eva āgacchatastānanyatīrthyān parivrājakān dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ cittāni vyavalokya evaṃ cintayāmāsa ime khalu anyatīrthyāḥ parivrājakā upālambhābhiprāyā yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāmanti sma
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, saw from afar those wanderers of other sects coming; and, having examined their minds, he thought: 'These wanderers of other sects are indeed approaching the place where the Blessed One is with the intention of finding fault.

children.text: yannvahaṃ yāvanmātro mayā bhagavato 'ntikādasyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāḥ pradeśa udgṛhītaḥ tāvanmātraṃ smṛtyā samanvāhareyaṃ svādhyāyeyaṃ pravartayeyam yathaite 'nyatīrthāḥ parivrājakā bhagavantaṃ nopasaṃkrāmeyuḥ
children.translated_text: What if I were to bring to mind with mindfulness, study, and set forth just as much of this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> as I have taken up in the presence of the Blessed One, so that these wanderers of other sects would not approach the Blessed One?

children.text: evamasyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyā bhāṣyamāṇāyā nāntarāyaḥ syāditi
children.translated_text: In this way, while this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being taught, there would be no obstruction.'

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindro yāvanmātro bhagavato 'ntikādasyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāḥ pradeśaḥ udgṛhītaḥ tāvanmātraṃ smṛtyā samanvāharati sma svādhyāyati sma pravartayati sma
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, brought to mind with mindfulness, studied, and set forth just as much of this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> as he had taken up in the presence of the Blessed One.

children.text: atha te 'nyatīrthāḥ parivrājakā dūrāddūrataraṃ bhagavantaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tenaiva dvāreṇa tenaiva mārgeṇa punareva niṣkrāntāḥ
children.translated_text: Then those wandering ascetics of other sects, having circumambulated the Blessed One from a very great distance, went out again by that same door and by that same road.

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmataḥ śāriputrasyaitadabhūt kimatra kāraṇaṃ yena ime 'nyatīrthyāḥ parivrājakā dūrāddūrataraṃ bhagavantaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tenaiva dvāreṇa tenaiva mārgeṇa punareva niṣkrāntāḥ atha khalu bhagavānāyuṣmataḥ śāriputrasya imamevaṃrūpaṃ cetasaiva cetaḥparivitarkamājñāya āyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat śakreṇa śāriputra devānāmindreṇa teṣāmanyatīrthyānāṃ parivrājakānām upālambhābhiprāyāṇāṃ cittāni vyavalokya iyaṃ prajñāpāramitā smṛtyā samanvāhṛtā svādhyāyitā pravartitā teṣāmanyatīrthyānāṃ parivrājakānāṃ vigrahītukāmānāṃ vivaditukāmānāṃ virodhayitukāmānāṃ nivartanārtham yathā asyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyā bhāṣyamāṇāyā ete 'nyatīrthyāḥ parivrājakā nopasaṃkrāmeyuriti māntarāyaṃ kārṣuḥ prajñāpāramitāyā bhāṣyamāṇāyā iti
children.translated_text: Then this occurred to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "What is the reason here, that these wandering ascetics of other sects, having circumambulated the Blessed One from a very great distance, have gone out again by that same door and by that same road?" Then the Blessed One, knowing by his own mind this very sort of mental reflection in the mind of the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, having examined the thoughts of those wandering ascetics of other sects who intended to find fault, brought this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind, recited it, and set it forth, for the sake of turning back those wandering ascetics of other sects who wanted to quarrel, dispute, and oppose, thinking, 'While this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being taught, let these wandering ascetics of other sects not approach and make an obstruction while the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being taught.'

children.text: mayā ca śakrasya devānāmindrasyābhyanujñātam
children.translated_text: And I approved what <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, did.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ nāhaṃ śāriputra teṣāmanyatīrthyānāṃ parivrājakānāmekasyāpi śuklaṃ dharmaṃ samanupaśyāmi
children.translated_text: Why is that? <s>Śāriputra</s>, I do not perceive even a single wholesome quality in those wandering ascetics of other sects.

children.text: sarve te śāriputra upālambhābhiprāyāḥ pratihatacittā upasaṃkramitukāmā abhūvan ||
children.translated_text: All of them, <s>Śāriputra</s>, intended to find fault; their minds were obstructed, and they wished to approach. ||

children.text: atha khalu mārasya pāpīyasya etadabhūt imāstathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya catasraḥ parṣadaḥ saṃnipatitāḥ saṃniṣaṇṇāstathāgatasya saṃmukhībhūtāḥ
children.translated_text: Then this occurred to <s>Māra</s> the Evil One: "These four assemblies of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha, have gathered, are seated together, and are present before the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: ime ca kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarāś ca devaputrāḥ saṃmukhībhūtāḥ
children.translated_text: And these sons of the gods belonging to the desire realm and the form realm are present.

children.text: niyatamatra bodhisattvā mahāsattvā vyākariṣyante 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau
children.translated_text: Surely bodhisattvas, great beings, will here be predicted to unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: yannvahamupasaṃkrāmeyaṃ vicakṣuḥkaraṇāyeti
children.translated_text: Suppose I were to approach in order to deprive them of vision."

children.text: atha khalu māraḥ pāpīyāṃścaturaṅgabalakāyamabhinirmāya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāmati sma
children.translated_text: Then <s>Māra</s> the Evil One conjured a fourfold army and approached the Blessed One.

children.text: atha khalu śakrasya devānāmindrasyaitadabhūt māro batāyaṃ pāpīyāṃścaturaṅgabalakāyamabhinirmāya yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāmati sma
children.translated_text: Then this occurred to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "This is surely <s>Māra</s> the Evil One, who has conjured a fourfold army and is approaching the Blessed One.

children.text: yaścāyaṃ caturaṅgasya balakāyasya vyūhaḥ nāyaṃ rājño bimbisārasya caturaṅgasya balakāyasya vyūhaḥ nāpi rājñaḥ prasenajitaścaturaṅgasya balakāyasya vyūhaḥ nāpi śākyānāṃ caturaṅgasya balakāyasya vyūhaḥ nāpi licchavīnāṃ caturaṅgasya balakāyasya vyūhaḥ yo 'yaṃ māreṇa pāpīyasā abhinirmitaḥ
children.translated_text: And this array of a fourfold army is not the array of the fourfold army of King <s>Bimbisāra</s>, nor is it the array of the fourfold army of King <s>Prasenajit</s>, nor is it the array of the fourfold army of the <s>Śākyas</s>, nor is it the array of the fourfold army of the <s>Licchavis</s>; it is this one conjured by <s>Māra</s> the Evil One.

children.text: samanubaddho dīrgharātraṃ māraḥ pāpīyān bhagavato 'vatāraprekṣī avatāragaveṣī sattvānāṃ ca viheṭhanābhiprāyaḥ
children.translated_text: For a long time <s>Māra</s> the Evil One has followed close upon the Blessed One, watching for an opening, seeking an opening, and intending to harass beings.

children.text: yannvahamimāmeva prajñāpāramitāṃ smṛtyā samanvāhareyaṃ svādhyāyeyaṃ pravartayeyamiti
children.translated_text: Suppose I were to bring this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind, recite it, and set it forth."

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindra imāmeva prajñāpāramitāṃ smṛtyā samanvāharati sma svādhyāyati sma pravartayati sma
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, brought this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind, recited it, and set it forth.

children.text: yathā yathā ca śakro devānāmindra imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ smṛtyā samanvāharati sma svādhyāyati sma pravartayati sma tathā tathā māraḥ pāpīyāṃstenaiva mārgeṇa punareva pratyudāvṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And just as <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, brought this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> to mind, recited it, and set it forth, so <s>Māra</s> the Evil One turned back again by that very road. ||

children.text: atha khalu trāyastriṃśatkāyikā devaputrā divyāni māndārapuṣpāṇyabhinirmāya vihāyasā antarīkṣagatā yena bhagavāṃstenābhyavakiranti sma yena bhagavāṃstena tāni divyāni māndāravapuṣpāṇy abhiprakiranti sma evaṃ codānamudānayanti sma cirasya bateyaṃ prajñāpāramitā jāmbūdvīpakānāṃ manuṣyāṇāmupāvṛtteti
children.translated_text: Then the sons of the gods of the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> class conjured divine <s>māndārava</s> flowers, and, moving through the sky in midair, scattered them over the Blessed One and strewed those divine <s>māndārava</s> flowers upon the Blessed One. And they uttered this joyful utterance: "After a long time indeed this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has appeared again among the human beings of <s>Jambūdvīpa</s>."

children.text: punareva ca divyāni māndāravāṇi puṣpāṇi gṛhītvā yena bhagavāṃstenābhyavakiranti sma abhiprakiranti sma
children.translated_text: And again, taking divine <s>māndārava</s> flowers, they scattered and strewed them over the Blessed One.

children.text: evaṃ cāvocan ye kecidbhagavan sattvāḥ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣiṣyante bhāvayiṣyanti prajñāpāramitāyāṃ cariṣyanti na teṣāṃ māro vā mārakāyikā vā devatā avatāraṃ lapsyante
children.translated_text: And they spoke thus: "Blessed One, whatever beings will teach the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, will cultivate the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, and will practice in the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, neither <s>Māra</s> nor deities belonging to <s>Māra</s>'s host will gain an opening against them.

children.text: na te bhagavan sattvā avarakeṇa kuśalamūlena samanvāgatā bhaviṣyanti ye imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti śrutvā codgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyanti upadekṣyanti uddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti
children.translated_text: Blessed One, those beings will not be endowed with any trifling root of good who will hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and, having heard it, will take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: pūrvajinakṛtādhikārāste bhagavan sattvā bhaviṣyanti yeṣāmiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā śrotrāvabhāsamāgamiṣyati
children.translated_text: Blessed One, those beings for whom this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will come within the illumination of hearing will be ones who have performed service under former <s>Jinas</s>.

children.text: kaḥ punarvādo ye enāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyanti upadekṣyanti uddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante tathāgataparyupāsitāste bhagavan sattvā bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: What more need be said of those who will take this up, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, train for suchness, enter upon practice for suchness, and engage in yoga for suchness? Blessed One, those beings will have attended upon the <s>Tathāgatas</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ ato hi sarvajñatā gaveṣitavyā yaduta prajñāpāramitātaḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because omniscience is to be sought from this, namely, from the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan yāni kānicidratnāni mahāratnāni sarvāṇi tāni mahāsamudraprabhāvitāni sarvāṇi tāni mahāsamudrādgaveṣitavyāni evameva bhagavan sarvajñatāmahāratnaṃ tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ prajñāpāramitāmahāsamudrād gaveṣitavyam
children.translated_text: For example, Blessed One, whatever jewels and great jewels there are, all of them are produced by the great ocean, and all of them are to be sought from the great ocean. In just the same way, Blessed One, the great jewel of omniscience of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, is to be sought from the great ocean of the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evamukte bhagavān śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat evametatkauśika evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: So it is, <s>Kauśika</s>; so it is.

children.text: atonirjātaṃ tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ sarvajñatāmahāratnaṃ yaduta prajñāpāramitāmahāsamudrāt ||
children.translated_text: The great jewel of omniscience of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, has arisen from that, namely, from the great ocean of the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmānānando bhagavantametadavocat na bhagavan dānapāramitāyā varṇaṃ bhāṣate na nāmadheyaṃ parikīrtayati
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said this to the Blessed One: Blessed One, you do not speak the praise of the perfection of giving, nor do you proclaim its name;

children.text: na śīlapāramitāyāḥ na kṣāntipāramitāyāḥ na vīryapāramitāyāḥ
children.translated_text: nor of the perfection of morality, nor of the perfection of patience, nor of the perfection of energy;

children.text: na bhagavan dhyānapāramitāyā varṇaṃ bhāṣate na nāmadheyaṃ parikīrtayati
children.translated_text: Blessed One, you do not speak the praise of the perfection of meditation, nor do you proclaim its name.

children.text: api tu prajñāpāramitāyā evaikasyā bhagavān varṇaṃ bhāṣate nāmadheyaṃ ca parikīrtayati
children.translated_text: Rather, the Blessed One speaks the praise of the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> alone, and proclaims its name.

children.text: bhagavānāha evametadānanda evam etat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: So it is, <s>Ānanda</s>; so it is.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāyā evāhamānanda varṇaṃ bhāṣe nāmadheyaṃ ca parikīrtayāmi nānyāsāṃ pāramitānām
children.translated_text: <s>Ānanda</s>, I speak the praise of the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> alone, and proclaim its name, not that of the other perfections.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ prajñāpāramitā hi ānanda pūrvaṃgamā pañcānāṃ pāramitānām
children.translated_text: Why is that? For the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the forerunner of the five perfections.

children.text: tatkiṃ manyase ānanda apariṇāmitaṃ dānaṃ sarvajñatāyāṃ dānapāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhate āyuṣmānānanda āha no hīdaṃ bhagavan
children.translated_text: What do you think, <s>Ānanda</s>? Does giving that has not been dedicated toward omniscience receive the name 'perfection of giving'? The venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said: No indeed, Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavānāha tatkiṃ manyase ānanda apariṇāmitaṃ śīlam apariṇāmitā kṣāntir apariṇāmitaṃ vīryam apariṇāmitaṃ dhyānam tatkiṃ manyase ānanda apariṇāmitā prajñā sarvajñatāyāṃ prajñāpāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhate ānanda āha no hīdaṃ bhagavan
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: What do you think, <s>Ānanda</s>? Does morality that has not been dedicated, patience that has not been dedicated, energy that has not been dedicated, or meditation that has not been dedicated receive that name? What do you think, <s>Ānanda</s>? Does wisdom that has not been dedicated toward omniscience receive the name '<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>'? <s>Ānanda</s> said: No indeed, Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavānāha tatkiṃ manyase tvamānanda acintyā sā prajñā yā kuśalamūlāni sarvajñatāpariṇāmena pariṇāmayati ānanda āha evametadbhagavan evametatsugata
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: What do you think, <s>Ānanda</s>? Is that wisdom inconceivable which dedicates wholesome roots by dedication toward omniscience? <s>Ānanda</s> said: So it is, Blessed One; so it is, <s>Sugata</s>.

children.text: acintyā sā bhagavan prajñā paramācintyā sā bhagavan prajñā yā kuśalamūlāni sarvajñatāpariṇāmena pariṇāmayati bhagavānāha tasmāttarhi ānanda paramatvātsā prajñā pāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhate yayā sarvajñatāyāṃ pariṇāmitāni kuśalamūlāni pāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhante
children.translated_text: Blessed One, that wisdom is inconceivable; Blessed One, that wisdom is supremely inconceivable, which dedicates wholesome roots by dedication toward omniscience. The Blessed One said: Therefore, <s>Ānanda</s>, because of its supremacy that wisdom receives the name 'perfection,' and by it wholesome roots dedicated toward omniscience receive the name 'perfections.'

children.text: tasmāttarhi ānanda sarvajñatāpariṇāmitakuśalamūlatvātprajñāpāramitā pañcānāṃ pāramitānāṃ pūrvaṃgamā nāyikā pariṇāyikā
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Ānanda</s>, because it has wholesome roots dedicated toward omniscience, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the forerunner, leader, and guide of the five perfections.

children.text: anena yogena antargatāḥ pañca pāramitāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāmeva ānanda ṣaṭpāramitāparipūrṇādhivacanam etadyaduta prajñāpāramiteti
children.translated_text: In this way the five perfections are included in the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> itself, <s>Ānanda</s>. This term, namely '<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>,' is a designation for the complete fulfillment of the six perfections.

children.text: tasmāttarhi ānanda prajñāpāramitāyāṃ parikīrtitāyāṃ sarvāḥ ṣaṭ pāramitāḥ parikīrtitā bhavanti
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Ānanda</s>, when the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is proclaimed, all six perfections are proclaimed.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma ānanda mahāpṛthivyāṃ bījāni prakīrṇāni sāmagrīṃ labhamānāni virohanti
children.translated_text: For example, <s>Ānanda</s>, seeds scattered on the great earth sprout when they obtain the complete set of conditions.

children.text: mahāpṛthivī ca teṣāṃ bījānāṃ pratiṣṭhā
children.translated_text: And the great earth is the support of those seeds.

children.text: mahāpṛthivīpratiṣṭhitāni ca tāni bījāni virohanti
children.translated_text: Those seeds, established on the great earth, sprout.

children.text: evameva ānanda prajñāpāramitāsaṃgṛhītāḥ pañca pāramitāḥ sarvajñatāyāṃ pratiṣṭhante
children.translated_text: In just the same way, <s>Ānanda</s>, the five perfections, embraced by the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, become established in omniscience.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāpratiṣṭhitāḥ pañca pāramitā virohanti
children.translated_text: The five perfections, established on the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, sprout.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāparigṛhītatvācca pāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhante
children.translated_text: And because they are taken up by the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, they receive the name 'perfections.'

children.text: tasmāttarhi ānanda prajñāpāramitaiva pañcānāṃ pāramitānāṃ pūrvaṃgamā nāyikā pariṇāyakā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Ānanda</s>, the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> itself is the forerunner, leader, and guide of the five perfections.

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat na tāvadime bhagavaṃstathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena prajñāpāramitāyāḥ sarve guṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ yān guṇān sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā parigṛhṇīte prajñāpāramitāmudgṛhya dhārayitvā vācayitvā paryavāpya pravartya deśayitvā upadiśya uddiśya svādhyāyya
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, Arhat, perfectly awakened Buddha has not yet proclaimed all the qualities of the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, the qualities that a son of good family or daughter of good family takes hold of after taking up the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retaining it, reciting it, mastering it, setting it forth, teaching it, instructing in it, proclaiming it, and studying it.

children.text: atha hi mayā yo bhagavato 'ntikādasyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāḥ pradeśa udgṛhītaḥ sa pravartitaḥ
children.translated_text: Rather, I have set forth the portion of this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> that I took up in the presence of the Blessed One.

children.text: bhagavānāha sādhu sādhu kauśika
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: Good, good, <s>Kauśika</s>.

children.text: na khalu punaḥ kauśika kevalaṃ yaḥ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati tasyaiva kevalamamī guṇā bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: But again, <s>Kauśika</s>, these qualities will not belong only to the one who will take up the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: yo 'pi kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ likhitvā pustakagatāṃ kṛtvā dhārayiṣyati sthāpayiṣyati saddharmacirasthitihetoḥ mā buddhanetrīsamucchedo bhūt mā saddharmāntardhānam
children.translated_text: And also, <s>Kauśika</s>, whatever son of good family or daughter of good family, having written this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and made it into a book, will retain it and establish it for the sake of the long endurance of the true Dharma, thinking, "May the Buddha-eye not be cut off; may the true Dharma not disappear;

children.text: bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ cānugrahopasaṃhāraḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati netryavaikalyeneti
children.translated_text: an act of favor and assistance will have been done for the bodhisattvas, great beings, because the guidance is unimpaired."

children.text: tāṃ caināṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ satkariṣyati gurukariṣyati mānayiṣyati pūjayiṣyati arcayiṣyati apacāyiṣyati puṣpairdhūpairgandhairmālyair vilepanaiścūrṇairvastraiśchatrair dhvajairghaṇṭābhiḥ patākābhiḥ samantācca dīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca pūjābhiḥ pūjayiṣyati tasyāpyahaṃ kauśika kulaputrasya vā kuladuhiturvā enān dṛṣṭadhārmikān guṇān vadāmi ||
children.translated_text: And one who will honor this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, respect it, esteem it, worship it, revere it, and venerate it, and will worship it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, cloths, parasols, banners, bells, flags, rows of lamps all around, and many kinds of offerings: for that son of good family or daughter of good family too, <s>Kauśika</s>, I declare these benefits visible in this very life.

children.text: evamukte śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat aham api bhagavaṃstasyāpi kulaputrasya vā kuladuhiturvā rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ saṃvidhāsyāmi ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ likhitvā pustakagatāṃ kṛtvā dhārayiṣyati sthāpayiṣyati saddharmacirasthitihetoḥ mā buddhanetrīsamucchedo bhūt mā saddharmāntardhānam
children.translated_text: When this had been said, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, I too will arrange protection, defense, and guarding for that son of good family or daughter of good family who, having written this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and made it into a book, will retain it and establish it for the sake of the long endurance of the true Dharma, thinking, 'May the Buddha-eye not be cut off; may the true Dharma not disappear;

children.text: bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ cānugrahopasaṃhāraḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati netryavaikalyeneti
children.translated_text: an act of favor and assistance will have been done for the bodhisattvas, great beings, because the guidance is unimpaired.'

children.text: tāṃ caināṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ satkariṣyati gurukariṣyati mānayiṣyati pūjayiṣyati arcayiṣyati apacāyiṣyati puṣpairdhūpairgandhairmālyair vilepanaiścūrṇairvastraiśchatrair dhvajairghaṇṭābhiḥ patākābhiḥ samantācca dīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca pūjābhiḥ pūjayiṣyati
children.translated_text: And one who will honor this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, respect it, esteem it, worship it, revere it, and venerate it, and will worship it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, cloths, parasols, banners, bells, flags, rows of lamps all around, and many kinds of offerings.

children.text: kaḥ punarvādo yaḥ enāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ likhiṣyati udgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati satkariṣyati gurukariṣyati mānayiṣyati pūjayiṣyati arcayiṣyati apacāyiṣyati puṣpairdhūpairgandhairmālyair vilepanaiścūrṇairvastraiśchatrairdhvajairghaṇṭābhiḥ patākābhiḥ samantācca dīpamālābhiḥ bahuvidhābhiś ca pūjābhiḥ pūjayiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: How much more, then, one who will write this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, honor it, respect it, esteem it, worship it, revere it, venerate it, and worship it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, cloths, parasols, banners, bells, flags, rows of lamps all around, and many kinds of offerings."

children.text: bhagavānāha sādhu sādhu kauśika
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "Good, good, <s>Kauśika</s>.

children.text: tasya khalu punaḥ kauśika kulaputrasya kuladuhiturvā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ svādhyāyato bahūni devaputraśatāny upasaṃkramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Kauśika</s>, many hundreds of sons of gods will approach that son of good family or daughter of good family while that person is studying this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: bahūni devaputrasahasrāṇi bahūni devaputraśatasahasrāṇi dharmaśravaṇāyopasaṃkramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Many thousands of sons of gods, many hundreds of thousands of sons of gods, will approach in order to hear the Dharma.

children.text: te ca devaputrā dharmaṃ śṛṇvantastasya dharmabhāṇakasya pratibhānamupasaṃhartavyaṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: And those sons of gods, while hearing the Dharma, will think that eloquence should be supplied to that preacher of Dharma.

children.text: yadāpi sa dharmabhāṇako na jalpitukāmo bhaviṣyati tadāpi tasya te devaputrāstenaiva dharmagauraveṇa pratibhānamupasaṃhartavyaṃ maṃsyante yathā tasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhiturvā bhāṣitumeva chando bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: Even when that preacher of Dharma does not wish to speak, those sons of gods, out of that very reverence for the Dharma, will think that eloquence should be supplied to him, so that the son of good family or daughter of good family will have the desire to speak.

children.text: imam api sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā dṛṣṭadhārmikaṃ guṇaṃ parigṛhṇāti ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati ||
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family also obtains this benefit visible in this very life, <s>Kauśika</s>, who will learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: punaraparaṃ kauśika tasya kulaputrasya kuladuhiturvā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣamāṇasya catasṛṇāṃ parṣadāmagrato nāvalīnacittatā bhaviṣyati mā khalu māṃ kaścitparyanuyuñjīta upālambhābhiprāya iti
children.translated_text: Furthermore, <s>Kauśika</s>, when that son of good family or daughter of good family is teaching this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> before the four assemblies, there will be no faintheartedness, thinking, "May no one question me with the intention of reproach."

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi tasya prajñāpāramitā rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ karoti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> provides that person with protection, defense, and guarding.

children.text: sa upālambhān api prajñāpāramitāvihārī na samanupaśyati upālambhakarān api prajñāpāramitāvihārī na samanupaśyati yo 'pyupālabhyeta tam api na samanupaśyati tām api prajñāpāramitāṃ na samanupaśyati
children.translated_text: Dwelling in the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, that person does not perceive even reproaches; dwelling in the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, that person does not perceive even those who make reproaches; that person does not perceive even the one who might be reproached; that person does not perceive even the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> itself.

children.text: evaṃ prajñāpāramitāparigṛhītasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhiturvā anena paryāyeṇa na kaścitparyanuyogo bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: In this way, for a son of good family or daughter of good family embraced by the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, in this manner there will be no questioning by anyone.

children.text: sa ca nottrasiṣyati na saṃtrasiṣyati na saṃtrāsamāpatsyate
children.translated_text: And that person will not be frightened, will not be terrified, and will not fall into terror.

children.text: imān api sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā dṛṣṭadhārmikān guṇān parigṛhṇāti ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati ||
children.translated_text: That son of good family or daughter of good family also obtains these benefits visible in this very life, <s>Kauśika</s>, who will learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: punaraparaṃ kauśika sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā priyo bhaviṣyati mātāpitṝṇāṃ mitrāmātyajñātisālohitaśramaṇabrāhmaṇānāṃ hitānāṃ ca pratibalaś ca bhaviṣyati śaktaś ca bhaviṣyati utpannotpannānāṃ parapravādināṃ sahadharmeṇa nigrahāya paraiś ca pratyanuyujyamānaḥ pratyanuyogavyākaraṇasamartho bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Kauśika</s>, that son of good family or daughter of good family will be dear to mother and father, to friends, ministers, kinsmen, blood relatives, śramaṇas, brahmins, and benefactors; and they will be capable and able to refute, in accordance with the true Dharma, whatever advocates of other doctrines arise, and, when questioned in return by others, they will be able to answer the counter-question.

children.text: imān api sa kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā dṛṣṭadhārmikān guṇān parigṛhṇāti yaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati ||
children.translated_text: These too, <s>Kauśika</s>, are benefits visible in this very life that the son of good family or daughter of good family obtains who will take up this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: yatra khalu punaḥ kauśika kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ likhitvā pustakagatāṃ kṛtvā pūjāpūrvaṃgamaṃ sthāpayiṣyati pūjayiṣyati tatra kauśika ye keciccāturmahārājakāyikeṣu deveṣu devaputrā anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthitāḥ te 'pi tatra āgantavyaṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: And again, <s>Kauśika</s>, wherever a son of good family or daughter of good family, having written this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and made it into a book, will place it foremost for worship and will worship it, there, <s>Kauśika</s>, whatever divine sons among the gods of the <s>Cāturmahārājakāyika</s> class have set out for unsurpassed perfect awakening, they too will think that they should come there.

children.text: te 'pi tatrāgatya enāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ pustakagatāṃ prekṣiṣyante vandiṣyante namaskariṣyantyudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti
children.translated_text: Having come there, they too will look upon this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> in book form, venerate it, bow to it, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: prekṣya vanditvā namaskṛtya dhārayitvā vācayitvā paryavāpya pravartya deśayitvopadiśyoddiśya svādhyāyya punareva prakramitavyaṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: After looking upon it, venerating it, bowing to it, retaining it, reciting it, mastering it, setting it forth, teaching it, instructing in it, proclaiming it, and studying it, they will think that they should depart again.

children.text: evaṃ ye kecitkauśika trāyastriṃśeṣu deveṣu devaputrā anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthitāḥ te 'pi tatrāgantavyaṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: So too, <s>Kauśika</s>, whatever divine sons among the gods of the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> realm have set out for unsurpassed perfect awakening, they too will think that they should come there.

children.translated_text: And so, <s>Kauśika</s>, that son of good family or daughter of good family should produce this thought: "Whatever <s>devas</s>, <s>nāgas</s>, <s>yakṣas</s>, <s>gandharvas</s>, <s>asuras</s>, <s>garuḍas</s>, <s>kinnaras</s>, <s>mahoragas</s>, humans, and nonhumans there are in immeasurable, incalculable world-systems in the ten directions, may they see the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> from this book; may they honor it, salute it, take it up, retain it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: prekṣya vanditvā namaskṛtyodgṛhya dhārayitvā vācayitvā paryavāpya pravartya deśayitvā upadiśyoddiśya svādhyāyya punareva svabhavanāni gacchantu teṣāmidaṃ dharmadānameva dattaṃ bhavatviti
children.translated_text: Having looked at it, honored it, saluted it, taken it up, retained it, recited it, mastered it, set it forth, taught it, instructed in it, proclaimed it, and studied it, may they then go back to their own abodes. May this very gift of Dharma have been given to them."

children.text: mā te 'tra kauśika evaṃ bhūt ye asmin eva cāturmahādvīpake lokadhātau kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarāś ca devaputrā anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃprasthitāḥ te eva kevalaṃ tatrāgantavyaṃ maṃsyanta iti

children.text: na te kauśika evaṃ draṣṭavyam
children.translated_text: You should not see it in that way, <s>Kauśika</s>.

children.translated_text: Rather, <s>Kauśika</s>, as many desire-realm and form-realm sons of the gods as there are in the three-thousand great-thousand world-system who have set out toward unsurpassed perfect awakening, they too will think that they should come there.
