children.translated_text: Let alone again, <s>Subhūti</s>, all beings in great trichiliocosms as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Gaṅgā</s> who have set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>; having set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, for aeons as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Gaṅgā</s>, living with good bodily conduct, good verbal conduct, and good mental conduct, having undertaken morality while having the perception of apprehension, all the beings, <s>Subhūti</s>, in great trichiliocosms as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Gaṅgā</s> would establish themselves in unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>.

children.text: anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃprasthāya gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpāṃstiṣṭhanto 'nyeṣvanyeṣu gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sarvairekaiko bodhisattva ākruṣṭo 'bhihataḥ paribhāṣitaḥ samāna eva sarve 'pi te upalambhasaṃjñinaḥ kṣāntiṃ samādāya varteran yāvatsarve te bodhisattvāḥ kṣāntiṃ samādāya vartamānāḥ etena paryāyeṇa sarve te bodhisattvā ekaiko bodhisattvo gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpāṃstiṣṭhan gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpānanyeṣvanyeṣu gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sarvairākruṣṭo 'bhihataḥ paribhāṣitaḥ samānaḥ upalambhasaṃjñī kṣāntiṃ samādāya varteta
children.translated_text: Having set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, suppose that, while remaining for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, in still other three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, each and every <s>bodhisattva</s>, though reviled, struck, and abused by all, would, while still having the perception of apprehension, undertake patience and conduct himself accordingly, until all those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, undertaking patience, were conducting themselves in that way; and by this procedure all those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, each single <s>bodhisattva</s>, remaining for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, in still other three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, though reviled, struck, and abused by all, would, while having the perception of apprehension, undertake patience and conduct himself accordingly.

children.text: evaṃ sarve 'pi te sarvairākruṣṭā abhihatāḥ paribhāṣitāḥ samānā upalambhasaṃjñinaḥ kṣāntiṃ samādāya varteran
children.translated_text: Thus all of them too, though reviled, struck, and abused by all, would, while having the perception of apprehension, undertake patience and conduct themselves accordingly.

children.text: yaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nayā prajñāpāramitayā upāyakauśalyena ca parigṛhīto 'tītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ śīlaskandhaṃ samādhiskandhaṃ prajñāskandhaṃ vimuktiskandhaṃ vimuktijñānadarśanaskandhaṃ teṣāṃ ca pratyekabuddhānāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhāṃsteṣāṃ ca śrāvakāṇāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhān sarvasattvānāṃ ca atītānāgatapratyutpannaṃ kuśalamūlaṃ sarvamekato 'bhisaṃkṣipya piṇḍayitvā tulayitvā niravaśeṣya niravaśeṣamanumodate agrayā anumodanayā
children.translated_text: But if a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, embraced by this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and by <s>upāyakauśalya</s> (skill in means), gathers into one, collects, weighs, and without remainder rejoices completely and without remainder in the aggregate of morality, the aggregate of concentration, the aggregate of wisdom, the aggregate of liberation, and the aggregate of knowledge and vision of liberation of the past, future, and present Buddhas, Blessed Ones, and also in the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of those <s>pratyekabuddhas</s>, and also in the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of those <s>śrāvakas</s>, and in all the roots of good of all beings in the past, future, and present, with the foremost rejoicing,

children.text: śreṣṭhayā jyeṣṭhayā varayā pravarayā praṇītayā uttamayā anuttamayā niruttamayā uttarottarayā asamayā asamasamayā apratisamayā acintyayā anumodanayā anumodate
children.translated_text: he rejoices with the best, the highest, the choicest, the most excellent, the sublime, the supreme, the unsurpassed, the unequaled, the ever higher, the incomparable, the equal of the incomparable, the matchless, and the inconceivable rejoicing.

children.text: anumodya anumodanāsahagataṃ puṇyakriyāvastu anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau pariṇāmayati
children.translated_text: Having rejoiced, he dedicates the basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing to unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>.

children.text: asya subhūte anumodanāsahagatasya puṇyakriyāvastuno 'sau paurvakāṇāmaupalambhikānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ kṣāntisahagataḥ puṇyābhisaṃskāraḥ śatatamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti sahasratamīm api śatasahasratamīm api koṭītamīm api koṭīśatatamīm api koṭīsahasratamīm api koṭīśatasahasratamīm api koṭīniyutaśatasahasratamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti saṃkhyām api kalām api gaṇanām api upamām api aupamyam api upanisām api upaniṣadam api na kṣamate
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, compared with this basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing, that earlier formation of merit, accompanied by patience, of the apprehending <s>bodhisattvas</s> does not approach even a hundredth part, nor a thousandth, nor a hundred-thousandth, nor a ten-millionth, nor a hundred ten-millionth, nor a thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand niyuta ten-millionth part; it cannot bear numbering, a fraction, calculation, comparison, likeness, approximation, or ultimate measure.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi te bodhisattvā upalambhasaṃjñinaḥ kṣāntiṃ samādāya vartante
children.translated_text: Why is that? For those <s>bodhisattvas</s> undertake patience and conduct themselves while having the perception of apprehension.

children.text: tiṣṭhantu khalu punaḥ subhūte gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sarvasattvāḥ anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃprasthitāḥ
children.translated_text: Again, let alone, <s>Subhūti</s>, all beings in three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s> who have set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>.

children.text: anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃprasthāya anyeṣvanyeṣu gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sarvairākruṣṭā abhihatāḥ paribhāṣitāḥ samānāḥ upalambhasaṃjñino gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpān kṣāntiṃ samādāya vartamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Having set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, though reviled, struck, and abused by all in still other three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, and while having the perception of apprehension, they would, for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, undertake patience and conduct themselves accordingly.

children.text: ye subhūte gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sattvāḥ te sarve 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthitā bhaveyuḥ anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthāya gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpāṃstiṣṭhantaścaṃkramābhirūḍhā gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpān aviṣīdanto 'nabhībhūtāḥ styānamiddhenopalambhasaṃjñino vīryaṃ samādāya varteran
children.translated_text: Suppose, <s>Subhūti</s>, that whatever beings there are in three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s> were all set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>; and, having set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, while remaining for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, having ascended walking courses for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, not sinking down, not overcome by sloth and torpor, and while having the perception of apprehension, they would undertake vigor and conduct themselves accordingly.

children.text: yaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitopāyakauśalyaparigṛhīto 'tītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhāṃsteṣāṃ ca pratyekabuddhānāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhāṃsteṣāṃ ca śrāvakāṇāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhān sarvasattvānāṃ ca atītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ kuśalamūlābhisaṃskārān sarvānekato 'bhisaṃkṣipya piṇḍayitvā tulayitvā niravaśeṣya niravaśeṣamanumodate agrayā anumodanayā
children.translated_text: But if a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, embraced by <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and <s>upāyakauśalya</s> (skill in means), gathers into one, collects, weighs, and without remainder rejoices completely and without remainder in the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of the past, future, and present Buddhas, Blessed Ones, and also in the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of those <s>pratyekabuddhas</s>, and also in the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of those <s>śrāvakas</s>, and in all the formations of roots of good of all beings in the past, future, and present, with the foremost rejoicing,

children.text: śreṣṭhayā jyeṣṭhayā varayā pravarayā praṇītayā uttamayā anuttamayā niruttarayā uttarottarayā asamayā asamasamayā apratisamayā acintyayā anumodanayā anumodate
children.translated_text: he rejoices with the best, the highest, the choicest, the most excellent, the sublime, the supreme, the unsurpassed, the unequaled, the ever higher, the incomparable, the equal of the incomparable, the matchless, and the inconceivable rejoicing.

children.text: anumodya anumodanāsahagataṃ puṇyakriyāvastu anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau pariṇāmayati
children.translated_text: Having rejoiced, he dedicates the basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing to unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>.

children.text: asya subhūte anumodanāsahagatasya puṇyakriyāvastuno 'sau paurvaka aupalambhikānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ vīryamayaḥ puṇyābhisaṃskāraḥ śatatamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti sahasratamīm api śatasahasratamīm api koṭītamīm api koṭīśatatamīm api koṭīsahasratamīm api koṭīśatasahasratamīm api koṭīniyutaśatasahasratamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti saṃkhyām api kalām api gaṇanām api upamām api aupamyam api upanisām api upaniṣadam api na kṣamate
children.translated_text: Compared with this basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing, <s>Subhūti</s>, that former formation of merit made of vigor by apprehending <s>bodhisattvas</s> does not approach even a hundredth part, nor a thousandth, nor a hundred-thousandth, nor a ten-millionth, nor a hundred ten-millionth, nor a thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand niyuta ten-millionth part; it cannot bear numbering, a fraction, calculation, comparison, likeness, approximation, or ultimate measure.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi te bodhisattvāḥ sarve 'pyupalambhasaṃjñino vīryaṃ samādāya vartante
children.translated_text: Why is that? For all those <s>bodhisattvas</s> undertake and carry on vigor with the perception of apprehension.

children.text: tiṣṭhantu khalu punaḥ subhūte gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sarvasattvā anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthitāḥ anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthāya gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpāṃstiṣṭhantaścaṃkramābhirūḍhā gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpān aviṣīdanto 'nabhibhūtāḥ styānamiddhenopalambhasaṃjñino vīryaṃ samādāya vartamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Again let alone, <s>Subhūti</s>, if all beings in three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s> had set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, and, having set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, standing on walking paths, not sinking down, not overcome by sloth and torpor, undertook and carried on vigor with the perception of apprehension.

children.text: ye 'pi te subhūte gaṅgānadīvālukopameṣu trisāhasramahāsāhasreṣu lokadhātuṣu sattvāḥ te sarve 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthitā bhaveyuḥ
children.translated_text: And suppose, <s>Subhūti</s>, that those beings in three-thousand great-thousand world-systems as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s> all had set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>.

children.text: te sarve 'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau samprasthāya gaṅgānadīvālukopamān kalpānupalambhasaṃjñinaścatvāri dhyānāni samāpadyeran
children.translated_text: Having set out toward unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>, for kalpas as numerous as the sands of the river <s>Ganges</s>, with the perception of apprehension, all of them would enter the four <s>dhyānas</s>.

children.text: yaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nayā prajñāpāramitayā upāyakauśalyena ca parigṛhīto 'tītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ sarveṣāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhāṃsteṣāṃ ca pratyekabuddhānāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhāṃsteṣāṃ ca śrāvakāṇāṃ śīlasamādhiprajñāvimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhān sarvasattvānāṃ ca atītānāgatapratyutpannān kuśalamūlābhisaṃskārān sarvānekato 'bhisaṃkṣipya piṇḍayitvā tulayitvā niravaśeṣya niravaśeṣamanumodate agrayā anumodanayā
children.translated_text: But a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, embraced by this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and by <s>upāyakauśalya</s> (skill in means), having gathered from every side, collected, weighed, and left out nothing at all from the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of all past, future, and present Buddhas, Blessed Ones, and from the aggregates of morality, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation of those <s>pratyekabuddhas</s> and of their <s>śrāvakas</s>, and also from all past, future, and present formations of roots of good of all beings, rejoices in them completely and without remainder with the foremost rejoicing.

children.text: śreṣṭhayā jyeṣṭhayā varayā pravarayā praṇītayā uttamayā anuttamayā niruttarayā uttarottarayā asamayā asamasamayā apratisamayā acintyayā anumodanayā anumodate
children.translated_text: He rejoices with the best, the highest, the choicest, the most excellent, the sublime, the supreme, the unsurpassed, the without-superior, the ever higher, the unequaled, the equal of the unequaled, the incomparable, and the inconceivable rejoicing.

children.text: anumodya anumodanāsahagataṃ puṇyakriyāvastu anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau pariṇāmayati
children.translated_text: Having rejoiced, he dedicates the basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing to unsurpassed perfect <s>saṃbodhi</s>.

children.text: asya subhūte anumodanāsahagatasya puṇyakriyāvastuno 'sau paurvaka aupalambhikānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ caturdhyānamayaḥ puṇyābhisaṃskāraḥ śatatamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti sahasratamīm api śatasahasratamīm api koṭītamīm api koṭīśatatamīm api koṭīsahasratamīm api koṭīśatasahasratamīm api koṭīniyutaśatasahasratamīm api kalāṃ nopaiti saṃkhyām api kalām api gaṇanām api upamām api aupamyam api upanisām api upaniṣadam api na kṣamate
children.translated_text: Compared with this basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing, <s>Subhūti</s>, that former formation of merit made of the four <s>dhyānas</s> by apprehending <s>bodhisattvas</s> does not approach even a hundredth part, nor a thousandth, nor a hundred-thousandth, nor a ten-millionth, nor a hundred ten-millionth, nor a thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand ten-millionth, nor a hundred-thousand niyuta ten-millionth part; it cannot bear numbering, a fraction, calculation, comparison, likeness, approximation, or ultimate measure.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi te bodhisattvā upalambhasaṃjñino dhyānāni samāpadyante iti ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because those <s>bodhisattvas</s> enter the <s>dhyānas</s> with the perception of apprehension. ||

children.text: Chapter 7
atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat sarvajñajñānapariniṣpattirbhagavan prajñāpāramitā sarvajñatvaṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the full accomplishment of the knowledge of all aspects; Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience).

children.text: bhagavānāha evametacchāriputra evametadyathā vadasi
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, "So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is, just as you say."

children.text: śāriputra āha avabhāsakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said, "Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> makes illumination.

children.text: namaskaromi bhagavan prajñāpāramitāyai
children.translated_text: Blessed One, I bow to <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: namaskaraṇīyā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is worthy of homage.

children.text: anupaliptā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unstained.

children.text: sarvalokanirupalepā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unstained by all the world.

children.text: ālokakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> makes light.

children.text: sarvatraidhātukavitimirakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> dispels darkness throughout all the three realms.

children.text: sarvakleśadṛṣṭyandhakārāpanetrī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> removes the darkness of all afflictions and views.

children.text: āśrayaṇīyā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is to be relied upon.

children.text: agrakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā bodhipakṣāṇāṃ dharmāṇām
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> makes the factors of awakening foremost.

children.text: kṣemakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> makes security.

children.text: andhānāṃ sattvānāmālokakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> gives light to blind beings.

children.text: sarvabhayopadravaprahīṇālokakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> gives light, free from all fears and calamities.

children.text: pañcacakṣuḥparigrahaṃ kṛtvā sarvasattvānāṃ mārgadarśayitrī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, having taken up the five eyes, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> shows the path to all beings.

children.text: cakṣurbhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the eye.

children.text: mohatamastimiravikariṇī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> disperses the darkness and gloom of delusion.

children.text: sarvadharmāṇām akaraṇī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the non-maker of all dharmas.

children.text: utpathaprayātānāṃ sattvānāṃ mārgāvatāraṇī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> brings beings who have gone onto the wrong road down onto the path.

children.text: sarvajñataiva bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is simply <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience)."

children.text: sarvakleśajñeyāvaraṇavāsanānusaṃdhiprahīṇatām upādāya anutpādikā bhagavan sarvadharmāṇāṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because of the abandonment of the continuity of the latent impressions of all afflictive and knowable obstructions, Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is non-arising with respect to all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: anirodhikā bhagavan sarvadharmāṇāṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is non-ceasing with respect to all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: anutpannāniruddhā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unarisen and unceased.

children.text: svalakṣaṇaśūnyatāmupādāya mātā bhagavan bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because own-characteristics are empty, Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the mother of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, great beings.

children.text: sarvabuddhadharmaratnadātrītvād daśabalakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because she gives the jewel of all Buddha-<s>dharmas</s>, Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> produces the ten powers.

children.text: anavamardanīyā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> cannot be crushed.

children.text: caturvaiśāradyakarītvād anāthānāṃ sattvānāṃ nāthakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because she produces the four fearlessnesses, Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> makes a protector for beings without a protector.

children.text: saṃsārapratipakṣā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the counteragent to <s>saṃsāra</s>.

children.text: akūṭasthatām upādāya sarvadharmasvabhāvavidarśanī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because she is not fixed in a false standpoint, Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> reveals the own-nature of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: paripūrṇatriparivartadvādaśākāradharmacakrapravartanī bhagavan buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> sets in motion the wheel of Dharma of the Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, complete with its three turnings and twelve aspects.

children.text: kathaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ sthātavyam kathaṃ manasi kartavyā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā kathaṃ bhagavan namaskartavyā prajñāpāramitā evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat yathā śāriputra śāstari tathā prajñāpāramitāyāṃ sthātavyam
children.translated_text: "Blessed One, how should a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, stand in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? Blessed One, how should <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> be brought to mind? Blessed One, how should <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> be venerated?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, just as one should stand toward the Teacher, so should one stand toward <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tathaiva manasi kartavyā śāriputra prajñāpāramitā yathā śāstā
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be brought to mind in just the same way as the Teacher.

children.text: tathaiva namaskartavyā śāriputra prajñāpāramitā yathā śāstā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be venerated in just the same way as the Teacher." ||

children.text: atha khalu śakrasya devānāmindrasyaitadabhūt kuto nu bateyamāryasya śāriputrasya pṛcchā jātā kiṃnidānā bateyamāryasya śāriputrasya pṛcchā jātā atha khalu śakro devānāmindra āyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat kuta iyamāryasya śāriputrasya pṛcchā jātā kiṃnidānā bateyamāryasya śāriputrasya pṛcchā jātā evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputraḥ śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat prajñāpāramitopāyakauśalyaparigṛhītaḥ kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'numodanāsahagataṃ puṇyakriyāvastu sarvajñatāyāṃ pariṇāmayaṃsteṣāṃ paurvakāṇāmaupalambhikānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ yaś ca dānamayaḥ puṇyābhisaṃskāraḥ yaś ca śīlamayo yaś ca kṣāntimayo yaś ca vīryamayo yaś ca dhyānamayaḥ puṇyābhisaṃskāraḥ taṃ sarvamabhibhavatīti
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, thought this: "From what, indeed, has this question of the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> arisen? For what reason, indeed, has this question of the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> arisen?" Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "From what has this question of the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> arisen? For what reason, indeed, has this question of the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> arisen?" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "<s>Kauśika</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, embraced by <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and <s>upāyakauśalya</s> (skill in means), dedicates to <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience) a basis of meritorious action accompanied by rejoicing, and thereby surpasses all the meritorious formation of those earlier apprehending <s>bodhisattvas</s>: what is made of giving, what is made of morality, what is made of patience, what is made of vigor, and what is made of meditation."

children.text: mameyametannidānā pṛcchā jātā
children.translated_text: My question arose for this reason.

children.text: api nu khalu punaḥ kauśika prajñāpāramitaiva pūrvaṃgamā pañcānāṃ pāramitānāṃ sarvajñatāmārgāvatārāya
children.translated_text: And again, <s>Kauśika</s>, is not <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> herself the forerunner of the five <s>pāramitās</s> for entry onto the path to <s>sarvajñatā</s>?

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma kauśika jātyandhānāṃ śataṃ vā sahasraṃ vā śatasahasraṃ vā apariṇāyakamabhavyaṃ mārgāvatārāya abhavyaṃ grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vā nigamaṃ vā gantum evameva kauśika dānaṃ śīlaṃ kṣāntivīryaṃ dhyānaṃ ca prajñāpāramitānāmadheyaṃ labhate
children.translated_text: For example, <s>Kauśika</s>, a hundred, or a thousand, or a hundred thousand persons blind from birth, without a guide, would be unable to enter onto a road and unable to go to a village, city, or market town. In just the same way, <s>Kauśika</s>, giving, morality, patience, vigor, and meditation receive the designation <s>pāramitā</s>.

children.text: jātyandhabhūtaṃ bhavati vinā prajñāpāramitayā apariṇāyakatvāt
children.translated_text: Without <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, because they are without a guide, they become as if blind from birth.

children.text: abhavyaṃ sarvajñatāmārgāvatārāya
children.translated_text: They are unable to enter onto the path to <s>sarvajñatā</s>.

children.text: kutaḥ punaḥ sarvajñatāmanuprāpsyati yadā punaḥ kauśika dānaṃ śīlaṃ kṣāntirvīryaṃ dhyānaṃ ca prajñāpāramitāparigṛhītaṃ bhavati tadā pāramitānāmadheyaṃ pāramitāśabdaṃ labhate
children.translated_text: How then will they attain <s>sarvajñatā</s>? But when, <s>Kauśika</s>, giving, morality, patience, vigor, and meditation are embraced by <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, then they receive the designation <s>pāramitā</s>, the word <s>pāramitā</s>.

children.text: tadā hyāsāṃ cakṣuḥpratilambho bhavati pañcānāṃ pāramitānāṃ sarvajñatāmārgāvatārāya sarvajñatānuprāptaye ||
children.translated_text: Then indeed these five <s>pāramitās</s> obtain the eye for entering onto the path to <s>sarvajñatā</s> and for attaining <s>sarvajñatā</s>. ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat kathaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitā abhinirhartavyā evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat rūpasya śāriputra abhinirhāro draṣṭavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, how should a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, bring forth <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, the bringing forth of form is to be seen.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃskārāṇām
children.translated_text: So too the bringing forth of feeling, perception, and formations is to be seen.

children.text: vijñānasya śāriputra abhinirhāro draṣṭavyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, the bringing forth of consciousness is to be seen.

children.text: yaḥ śāriputra pañcānāṃ skandhānāmabhinirhāraḥ ayaṃ śāriputra prajñāpāramitāyā abhinirhāra ityucyate
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, what is the bringing forth of the five <s>skandhas</s> (aggregates) is called the bringing forth of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evamabhinirhāreṇa pañcānāṃ skandhānāmabhinirhāraḥ prajñāpāramitāyā abhinirhāro 'bhinirhāra ityucyate ||
children.translated_text: By this bringing forth, the bringing forth of the five <s>skandhas</s> is called the bringing forth, the bringing forth of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>." ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat evamabhinirhāreṇa abhinirhṛtā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā katamaṃ dharmamarpayati bhagavānāha evamabhinirhṛtā śāriputra prajñāpāramitā na kaṃciddharmamarpayati
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, when <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been brought forth by this bringing forth, what <s>dharma</s> does it present?" The Blessed One said: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, when <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been brought forth in this way, it presents no <s>dharma</s> at all.

children.text: yadā sā śāriputra na kaṃciddharmamarpayati tadā prajñāpāramiteti saṃkhyāṃ gacchati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, when it presents no <s>dharma</s> at all, then it receives the name <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>." ||

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat kimiyaṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitā sarvajñatām api nārpayati bhagavānāha yatkauśika evaṃ vadasi kimiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā sarvajñatām api nārpayatīti na yathopalambhastathā arpayati na yathā nāma tathārpayati na yathābhisaṃskārastathārpayati
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, does this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> not even deliver <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience)?" The Blessed One said: "<s>Kauśika</s>, when you say, 'Does this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> not even deliver <s>sarvajñatā</s>?', it does not deliver it as it is apprehended; it does not deliver it as it is named; it does not deliver it as it is constructed."

children.text: śakra āha kathaṃ tarhi bhagavannarpayati bhagavānāha yathā kauśika nārpayati tathārpayati
children.translated_text: <s>Śakra</s> said: "How then, Blessed One, does it deliver it?" The Blessed One said: "As, <s>Kauśika</s>, it does not deliver it, so it delivers it."

children.text: śakra āha āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvadiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā na kaṃciddharmamutpādayati na kaṃciddharmaṃ nirodhayati
children.translated_text: <s>Śakra</s> said: "Wonderful, Blessed One, to such an extent this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> does not produce any <s>dharma</s> and does not cause any <s>dharma</s> to cease.

children.text: sarvadharmāṇāmanutpādāya anirodhāya pratyupasthitā anupasthitā prajñāpāramitā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajñāpāramitā</s> is present, and not present, for the non-arising and non-cessation of all <s>dharmas</s>." ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat sacedevam api bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ saṃjñāsyate dūrīkariṣyati imāṃ prajñāpāramitām riktīkariṣyati imāṃ prajñāpāramitām tucchīkariṣyati imāṃ prajñāpāramitām na kariṣyati imāṃ prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, if a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, should conceive even in this way, he will put this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> far away; he will make this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> empty; he will make this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> hollow; he will not practice this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>."

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: astyeṣa subhūte paryāyo yena paryāyeṇa dūrīkariṣyatīmāṃ prajñāpāramitām riktīkariṣyatīmāṃ prajñāpāramitām tucchīkariṣyatīmāṃ prajñāpāramitām na kariṣyatīmāṃ prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: There is this method, <s>Subhūti</s>, by which he will put this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> far away, make this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> empty, make this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> hollow, and not practice this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ hi subhūte paridīpitāyāṃ na rūpaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: Why is that? For when <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is set forth, <s>rūpa</s> (form) is not set forth.

children.text: na vedanā na saṃjñā na saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: Neither <s>vedanā</s> (feeling), nor <s>saṃjñā</s> (perception), nor <s>saṃskāras</s> (formations) are set forth.

children.text: na vijñānaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: <s>Vijñāna</s> (consciousness) is not set forth.

children.text: na srotaāpattiphalaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The fruit of stream-entry is not set forth.

children.text: na sakṛdāgāmiphalaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The fruit of once-returning is not set forth.

children.text: na anāgāmiphalaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: The fruit of non-returning is not set forth.

children.text: nārhattvaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: Arhatship is not set forth.

children.text: na pratyekabuddhatvaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati
children.translated_text: <s>Pratyekabuddha</s>-hood is not set forth.

children.text: na buddhatvaṃ paridīpitaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Buddhahood is not set forth." ||

children.text: sthaviraḥ subhūtirāha mahāpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The elder <s>Subhūti</s> said: "This, Blessed One, is a great <s>pāramitā</s> (perfection), namely <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: bhagavānāha tatkiṃ manyase subhūte katamena paryāyeṇa mahāpāramiteyaṃ yaduta prajñāpāramitā sthaviraḥ subhūtirāha na bhagavan rūpaṃ mahatkaroti nālpīkaroti na rūpaṃ saṃkṣipati na vikṣipati
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s>? By what method is this a great <s>pāramitā</s>, namely <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?" The elder <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Blessed One, it does not make <s>rūpa</s> great, nor does it make it small; it does not contract <s>rūpa</s>, nor does it disperse it.

children.text: evaṃ na vedanāṃ na saṃjñāṃ na saṃskārān
children.translated_text: In the same way, it does not make <s>vedanā</s>, <s>saṃjñā</s>, or <s>saṃskāras</s> great or small, contract them, or disperse them.

children.text: na bhagavan vijñānaṃ mahatkaroti nālpīkaroti na vijñānaṃ saṃkṣipati na vikṣipati
children.translated_text: Blessed One, it does not make <s>vijñāna</s> great, nor does it make <s>vijñāna</s> small; it does not contract <s>vijñāna</s>, nor does it disperse it.

children.text: yāny api tāni tathāgatasya tathāgatabalāni tāny api na balīkaroti na durbalīkaroti na saṃkṣipati na vikṣipati
children.translated_text: And those powers of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, even those it does not make strong or weak; it does not contract them, nor does it disperse them.

children.text: yāpi sā sarvajñatā tām api na mahatkaroti nālpīkaroti na saṃkṣipati na vikṣipati
children.translated_text: And that <s>sarvajñatā</s>, even that it does not make great or small; it does not contract it, nor does it disperse it.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ asaṃkṣiptāvikṣiptā hi bhagavan sarvajñatā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, Blessed One, <s>sarvajñatā</s> is neither contracted nor dispersed.

children.text: sacedevam api bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ saṃjānīte carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: Blessed One, if a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, recognizes even this, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: kiṃ punarevaṃ saṃjānānaḥ evamahaṃ sarvajñajñānasamanvāgataḥ sattvebhyo dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmi evamimān sattvān parinirvāpayiṣyāmīti
children.translated_text: What then if, recognizing thus, he thinks: 'In this way, endowed with the knowledge of <s>sarvajñatā</s>, I will teach the <s>dharma</s> to beings; in this way I will bring these beings to final <s>nirvāṇa</s>'?

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ na hyeṣa prajñāpāramitāniṣyando ya imān sattvān parinirvāpayiṣyāmīti sattvopalambhaḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? This apprehension of beings, namely 'I will bring these beings to final <s>nirvāṇa</s>,' is certainly not an outflow of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: eṣa evāsya mahānupalambhaḥ syāt
children.translated_text: This itself would be his great apprehension.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sattvāsvabhāvajātikā hi prajñāpāramitā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known as having the nature of the absence of own-being in beings.

children.text: sattvāsvabhāvatayā prajñāpāramitāsvabhāvatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the own-beinglessness of beings, the own-beinglessness of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known.

children.text: sattvaviviktatayā prajñāpāramitāviviktatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the separateness of beings, the separateness of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known.

children.text: sattvācintyatayā prajñāpāramitācintyatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the inconceivability of beings, the inconceivability of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known.

children.text: sattvāvināśadharmatayā prajñāpāramitāvināśadharmatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the fact that beings have the nature of non-destruction, the fact that <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has the nature of non-destruction should be known.

children.text: sattvānabhisaṃbodhanatayā prajñāpāramitānabhisaṃbodhanatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the non-awakening of beings, the non-awakening of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known.

children.text: sattvayathābhūtārthānabhisaṃbodhanatayā prajñāpāramitāyathābhūtārthānabhisaṃbodhanatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the non-awakening to the true meaning of beings, the non-awakening to the true meaning of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known.

children.text: sattvabalasamudāgamanatayā tathāgatabalasamudāgamanatā veditavyā
children.translated_text: Through the arising together of the powers of beings, the arising together of the powers of the <s>Tathāgata</s> should be known.

children.text: anena bhagavan paryāyeṇa mahāpāramiteyaṃ yaduta prajñāpāramitā ||
children.translated_text: By this method, Blessed One, this is a great <s>pāramitā</s>, namely <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>." ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat yo bhagavan iha gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'dhimokṣayiṣyati na kāṅkṣiṣyati na vicikitsiṣyati na dhandhāyiṣyati kutaḥ sa bhagavaṃścyuta ihopapanno veditavyaḥ kiyacciracaritāvī ca sa bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmarthataś ca dharmataś ca arthanayataś ca dharmanayataś ca anugamiṣyati anubhotsyate 'nubodhayiṣyati ca evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat sa śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nyebhyo lokadhātubhyaścyuto buddhān bhagavataḥ paryupāsya paripṛcchya ihopapanno veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, if here a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, puts his trust in this profound <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (perfection of wisdom), does not doubt, does not waver, and does not hesitate, from where, Blessed One, should he be understood to have passed away and been reborn here? And for how long, Blessed One, should that <s>bodhisattva</s>, great being, be understood to have practiced, if he follows this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> according to its meaning, according to its dharma, according to the method of its meaning, and according to the method of its dharma, and will understand it and awaken to it?" When this was said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "That <s>bodhisattva</s>, great being, <s>Śāriputra</s>, should be understood to have passed away from other world-systems and been reborn here after attending upon and questioning Buddhas, Blessed Ones.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yaḥ kaścicchāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nyebhyo lokadhātubhyaścyuto buddhān bhagavataḥ paryupāsya paripṛcchya ihopapanno bhavati sa imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāṃ deśyamānām upadiśyamānām uddiśyamānāṃ śṛṇuyāt imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śrutvā atra śāstṛsaṃjñāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāmutpādayet śāstā me saṃmukhībhūt iti śāstā me dṛṣṭa iti cittamutpādayati
children.translated_text: Why is that? <s>Śāriputra</s>, any <s>bodhisattva</s>, great being, who has passed away from other world-systems and has been reborn here after attending upon and questioning Buddhas, Blessed Ones, would hear this profound <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> as it is being spoken, taught, explained, and set forth. Having heard this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, he would produce toward the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> the perception of a teacher; he forms the thought, 'My teacher has become present before me,' and, 'My teacher has been seen by me.'

children.text: prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyām uddiśyamānāyāṃ śrotramavadadhāti satkṛtya śṛṇoti kathāṃ nopacchinatti
children.translated_text: When <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, explained, and set forth, he lends his ear, listens respectfully, and does not interrupt the discourse.

children.text: ciracaritāvī sa śāriputra tathārūpo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Such a <s>bodhisattva</s>, great being, <s>Śāriputra</s>, should be understood to have practiced for a long time.

children.text: bahubuddhaparyupāsitaḥ sa śāriputra tathārūpo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Such a <s>bodhisattva</s>, great being, <s>Śāriputra</s>, should be understood to have attended upon many Buddhas. ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat śakyā punarbhagavan prajñāpāramitā śrotuṃ vā upalakṣayituṃ vā samanvāhartuṃ vā upapādayituṃ vā upadhārayituṃ vā iyaṃ sā prajñāpāramitā iha vā sā prajñāpāramitā amutra vā sā prajñāpāramitā anena vā ākāreṇa liṅgena nimitteneti śakyā nirdeṣṭuṃ vā śrotuṃ vā bhagavānāha no hīdaṃ subhūte
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, is it possible to hear, mark, attend to, establish, or grasp <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> as, 'This is that <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>,' or, 'That <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is here,' or, 'That <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is there,' or, 'It is to be pointed out or heard by this form, characteristic, or sign'?" The Blessed One said, "No indeed, <s>Subhūti</s>."

children.text: neyaṃ subhūte prajñāpāramitā skandhaśo vā dhātuśo vā āyatanaśo vā śakyā nirdeṣṭuṃ vā śrotuṃ vā upalakṣayituṃ vā samanvāhartuṃ vā upapādayituṃ vā upadhārayituṃ vā
children.translated_text: This <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, <s>Subhūti</s>, cannot be pointed out, heard, marked, attended to, established, or grasped in terms of the aggregates, in terms of the elements, or in terms of the sense bases.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sarvadharmaviviktatvātsubhūte atyantaviviktatvātsubhūte sarvadharmāṇāṃ na śakyā prajñāpāramitā nirdeṣṭuṃ vā śrotuṃ vā upalakṣayituṃ vā samanvāhartuṃ vā upapādayituṃ vā upadhārayituṃ vā
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because all dharmas are secluded, <s>Subhūti</s>; because all dharmas are utterly secluded, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> cannot be pointed out, heard, marked, attended to, established, or grasped.

children.text: na cānyatra skandhadhātvāyatanebhyaḥ prajñāpāramitā avaboddhavyā
children.translated_text: And <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is not to be understood apart from the aggregates, elements, and sense bases.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ skandhadhātvāyatanameva hi subhūte śūnyaṃ viviktaṃ śāntam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For the aggregates, elements, and sense bases themselves, <s>Subhūti</s>, are empty, secluded, and peaceful.

children.text: iti hi prajñāpāramitā ca skandhadhātvāyatanaṃ ca advayam etad advaidhīkāraṃ śūnyatvādviviktatvāt
children.translated_text: Thus <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and the aggregates, elements, and sense bases are nondual; this is not a making into two, because they are empty and secluded.

children.text: evaṃ śāntatvānnopalabhyate
children.translated_text: Because they are peaceful in this way, they are not apprehended.

children.text: yo 'nupalambhaḥ sarvadharmāṇām sā prajñāpāramitetyucyate
children.translated_text: The non-apprehension of all dharmas is called <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yadā na bhavati saṃjñā samajñā prajñaptirvyavahāraḥ tadā prajñāpāramitetyucyate ||
children.translated_text: When there is no perception, designation, imputation, or conventional expression, then it is called <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>. ||

children.text: sthaviraḥ subhūtirāha kiyacciracaritāvī sa bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyo ya iha gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ yogamāpatsyate bhagavānāha vibhajya vyākaraṇīyametatsubhūte bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāmindriyādhimātratayā
children.translated_text: The elder <s>Subhūti</s> said, "Blessed One, for how long should that <s>bodhisattva</s>, great being, be understood to have practiced, who here will apply himself to the profound <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?" The Blessed One said, "This should be answered analytically, <s>Subhūti</s>, according to the superior strength of the faculties of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, great beings.

children.text: syātkhalu punaḥ subhūte paryāyo yena paryāyeṇa bodhisattvā bahūni buddhaśatāni bahūni buddhasahasrāṇi bahūni buddhaśatasahasrāṇi dṛṣṭvā teṣāmantike brahmacaryaṃ caritvā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ na śraddadhyurnādhimuñceyuḥ
children.translated_text: There may indeed be a case, <s>Subhūti</s>, in which <s>bodhisattvas</s>, after seeing many hundreds of Buddhas, many thousands of Buddhas, many hundred-thousands of Buddhas, and after practicing the holy life in their presence, still would not have faith in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and would not resolve upon it.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ pūrvam api teṣāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāmantikādasyāṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyām agauravatā abhūt
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because formerly too, when this profound <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> was being spoken, taught, and explained in the presence of those Buddhas, Blessed Ones, they had a lack of respect for it.

children.text: agauravatayā aśuśrūṣaṇatā aśuśrūṣaṇatayā aparyupāsanatā aparyupāsanatayā aparipṛcchanatā aparipṛcchanatayā aśraddadhānatā aśraddadhānatayā tataḥ parṣaddhyo 'pakrāntāḥ te tatonidānaṃ dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyena karmaṇā kṛtena saṃcitena ācitena upacitena etarhy api gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyām apakrāmanti
children.translated_text: Because of lack of respect there was unwillingness to listen; because of unwillingness to listen, failure to attend upon it; because of failure to attend upon it, failure to question; because of failure to question, lack of faith. Because of lack of faith they went away from those assemblies. For that reason, through karma leading to the ruin of dharma, karma done, accumulated, heaped up, and built up, even now, when the profound <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, and explained, they go away.

children.text: agauravatayā aśraddadhānā anadhimuñcanto na kāyena na cittena sāmagrīṃ dadati
children.translated_text: Through lack of respect, not having faith and not resolving upon it, they give concord neither with body nor with mind.

children.text: te sāmagrīm adadānā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ na jānanti na paśyanti na budhyante na vedayante
children.translated_text: Not giving concord, they do not know this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, do not see it, do not awaken to it, and do not understand it.

children.text: evaṃ te prajñāpāramitāṃ na śraddadhati
children.translated_text: Thus they do not have faith in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: aśraddadhānā na śṛṇvanti
children.translated_text: Those who lack faith do not listen.

children.text: aśṛṇvanto na jānanti
children.translated_text: Not listening, they do not know.

children.text: ajānanto na paśyanti
children.translated_text: Not knowing, they do not see.

children.text: apaśyanto na budhyante
children.translated_text: Not seeing, they do not understand.

children.text: abudhyamānā dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyaṃ karma kurvanti saṃcinvanti ācinvanti upacinvanti
children.translated_text: Not understanding, they do, accumulate, heap up, and build up karma that leads to the ruin of <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: te tena dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyena karmaṇā kṛtena saṃcitena ācitena upacitena duṣprajñasaṃvartanīyaṃ karmābhisaṃskariṣyanti
children.translated_text: Through that karma leading to the ruin of <s>dharma</s>, once it has been done, accumulated, heaped up, and built up, they will form karma that leads to poor wisdom.

children.text: tena te duṣprajñasaṃvartanīyena karmaṇā abhisaṃskṛtena saṃcitenācitenopacitena imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāṃ deśyamānāmupadiśyamānāṃ pratyākhyāsyanti pratikṣepsyanti pratikrokṣyanti pratikṣipya ca apakramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Through that karma leading to poor wisdom, once it has been formed, accumulated, heaped up, and built up, when this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, and explained, they will reject it, repudiate it, and denounce it; and having rejected it, they will go away.

children.text: asyāḥ khalu punaḥ subhūte prajñāpāramitāyāḥ pratyākhyānena pratikṣepeṇa pratikrośena atītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ sarvajñatā pratyākhyātā bhavati pratikṣiptā bhavati pratikruṣṭā bhavati
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, by the rejection, repudiation, and denunciation of this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, the omniscience of the past, future, and present Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, is rejected, repudiated, and denounced.

children.text: te svasaṃtānānupahatya dagdhāḥ pareṣām apyalpabuddhikānām alpaprajñānām alpapuṇyānām alpakuśalamūlānāṃ pudgalānāṃ śraddhāmātrakasamanvāgatānāṃ premamātrakasamanvāgatānāṃ prasādamātrakasamanvāgatānāṃ chandamātrakasamanvāgatānām ādikarmikāṇām abhavyarūpāṇāṃ tad api śraddhāmātrakaṃ premamātrakaṃ prasādamātrakaṃ chandamātrakaṃ vicchandayiṣyanti vivecayiṣyanti vivartayiṣyanti nātra śikṣitavyamiti vakṣyanti naitadbuddhavacanamiti vācaṃ bhāṣiṣyante
children.translated_text: Having harmed their own continuums and burned themselves, they will also make other persons of little intelligence, little wisdom, little merit, and few roots of good, persons endowed only with a measure of faith, a measure of affection, a measure of confidence, and a measure of aspiration, beginners who are not fit in character, lose even that measure of faith, affection, confidence, and aspiration; they will separate them from it and turn them away, saying, 'One should not train in this,' and they will utter the words, 'This is not the word of the Buddha.'

children.text: evaṃ te ātmasaṃtānānupahatya vivecya parasaṃtānānapyupahatya vivecya prajñāpāramitāmabhyākhyāsyanti
children.translated_text: Thus, having harmed and estranged their own continuums and also harmed and estranged the continuums of others, they will falsely accuse <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāyām abhyākhyātāyāṃ sarvajñatā abhyākhyātā bhavati
children.translated_text: When <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been falsely accused, omniscience has been falsely accused.

children.text: sarvajñatāyām abhyākhyātāyām atītānāgatapratyutpannā buddhā bhagavanto 'bhyākhyātā bhavanti
children.translated_text: When omniscience has been falsely accused, the past, future, and present Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, have been falsely accused.

children.text: te buddhānāṃ bhagavatāmantikādapakrāntā bhaviṣyanti dharmātparimuktā bhaviṣyanti saṃghāt paribāhyā bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will have departed from the presence of the Buddhas, the Blessed Ones; they will have been released away from the <s>dharma</s>; they will be outside the <s>saṃgha</s>.

children.text: evaṃ teṣāṃ sarveṇa sarvaṃ sarvathā sarvaṃ triratnāt paribāhyabhāvo bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: In this way, for them there will be complete exclusion from the Three Jewels in every respect and altogether.

children.text: te sattvānāṃ hitasukhopacchedakriyayā mahānirayavipākasaṃvartanīyaṃ karma upaceṣyanti
children.translated_text: By the act of cutting off the welfare and happiness of beings, they will build up karma leading to fruition in the great hells.

children.text: te anenaivaṃrūpeṇa karmābhisaṃskāreṇopasthāpitena samutthāpitena dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyena duṣprajñasaṃvartanīyena karmaṇā bahūni varṣaśatāni bahūni varṣasahasrāṇi bahūni varṣaśatasahasrāṇi bahūni varṣakoṭīśatāni bahūni varṣakoṭīsahasrāṇi bahūni varṣakoṭīśatasahasrāṇi bahūni varṣakoṭīniyutaśatasahasrāṇi mahānirayeṣūpapatsyante
children.translated_text: Through just such a karmic formation, set up and brought forth, through karma leading to the ruin of <s>dharma</s> and to poor wisdom, they will be reborn in the great hells for many hundreds of years, many thousands of years, many hundreds of thousands of years, many hundreds of crores of years, many thousands of crores of years, many hundreds of thousands of crores of years, and many hundreds of thousands of crores of niyutas of years.

children.text: te mahānirayānmahānirayaṃ saṃkramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will pass from one great hell to another great hell.

children.text: teṣāṃ tathā suciraṃ mahānirayānmahānirayaṃ saṃkrāmatāṃ tejaḥsaṃvartanī prādurbhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: As they pass for such a very long time from one great hell to another great hell, a fire-destruction will appear for them.

children.text: tejaḥsaṃvartanyāṃ prādurbhūtāyāṃ ye 'nyeṣu lokadhātuṣu mahānirayāḥ tatra te kṣepsyante
children.translated_text: When the fire-destruction has appeared, they will be cast into the great hells that exist in other world-systems.

children.text: te teṣu mahānirayeṣu upapatsyante
children.translated_text: They will be reborn in those great hells.

children.text: te tatra vikṣiptāsteṣu mahānirayeṣūpapannāḥ samānāstatrāpi mahānirayānmahānirayaṃ saṃkramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Cast there and reborn in those great hells, even there they will pass from one great hell to another great hell.

children.text: teṣāṃ tatrāpi mahānirayānmahānirayaṃ saṃkrāmatāṃ tatrāpi punareva tathaiva tejaḥsaṃvartanī prādurbhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: As they pass even there from one great hell to another great hell, there too, once again in just the same way, a fire-destruction will appear.

children.text: te tasyāṃ tejaḥsaṃvartanyāṃ prādurbhūtāyāṃ tataścyutāḥ samānāḥ punareva anyeṣu lokadhātuṣu ye mahānirayāstatra kṣepsyante
children.translated_text: When that fire-destruction has appeared, having fallen away from there, they will again be cast into the great hells that exist in other world-systems.

children.text: te teṣu mahānirayeṣūpapatsyante
children.translated_text: They will be reborn in those great hells.

children.text: te tatrāpi tathaiva mahānirayānmahānirayaṃ saṃkramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: There too, in just the same way, they will pass from one great hell to another great hell.

children.text: teṣāṃ tatrāpi suciraṃ mahānirayānmahānirayaṃ saṃkrāmatāṃ tatrāpi tathaiva tejaḥsaṃvartanī prādurbhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: As they pass there too for a very long time from one great hell to another great hell, there too, in just the same way, a fire-destruction will appear.

children.text: te tasyāṃ tejaḥsaṃvartanyāṃ prādurbhūtāyāṃ punareva tataścyutāstenaiva akṣīṇena sāvaśeṣeṇa karmaṇā ihaiva lokadhātau punaḥ kṣepsyante
children.translated_text: When that fire-destruction has appeared, having fallen away from there once again, by that same karma, not exhausted and still with a residue, they will again be cast back into this very world-system.

children.text: kṣiptāḥ santo mahānirayeṣūpapatsyante
children.translated_text: Having been cast there, they will be reborn in the great hells.

children.text: te punareva tāni mahānirayeṣu mahānti mahānirayaduḥkhāni pratyanubhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: Again they will experience those great sufferings in the great hells.

children.text: tāvatpratyanubhaviṣyanti yāvatpunareva tejaḥsaṃvartanī prādurbhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: They will experience them until once again a fire-destruction appears.

children.text: evaṃ te bahuduḥkhavedanīyaṃ karma pratyanubhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: Thus they will experience karma to be felt as much suffering.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yathāpi nāma durbhāṣitatvādvācaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? It is, for example, because speech has been badly spoken. ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat pañca bhagavan ānantaryāṇi karmāṇi kṛtānyupacitāni asya manoduścaritasya vāgduścaritasya ca na prativarṇikāny api na anurūpāṇy api na pratirūpāṇy api bhavanti
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Blessed One, the five actions of immediate consequence, even when done and built up, are not comparable, not similar, and not equivalent to this mental misconduct and verbal misconduct.'

children.text: bhagavānāha evametacchāriputra evam etat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.'

children.text: pañcānantaryāṇi śāriputra karmāṇi kṛtānyupacitānyasya manoduścaritasya ca vāgduścaritasya ca na prativarṇikānyapi na anurūpāṇy api na pratirūpāṇy api asya karmaṇaḥ kṛtasya saṃcitasya ācitasya upacitasya
children.translated_text: The five deeds of immediate retribution, <s>Śāriputra</s>, even when done and accumulated, are not comparable, not similar, and not equivalent to this bad mental conduct and bad verbal conduct, to this karma that has been done, amassed, heaped up, and accumulated.

children.text: ye kecidimāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāṃ deśyamānām upadiśyamānāmuddiśyamānāṃ pratibādhitavyāṃ maṃsyante pratikṣepsyanti pratikrokṣyanti nātra śikṣitavyamiti vakṣyanti neyaṃ tathāgatabhāṣiteti vācaṃ bhāṣiṣyante tato 'nyān api sattvān vivecayiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Those who, when this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, explained, and recited, will think that it should be opposed, will reject it, will denounce it, will say, 'One should not train in this,' will utter the words, 'This was not spoken by the <s>Tathāgata</s>,' and will also turn other beings away from it,

children.text: te svasaṃtānānupahatya parasaṃtānānupahaniṣyanti
children.translated_text: they will damage their own continua and will damage the continua of others.

children.text: te svasaṃtānān saviṣān kṛtvā parasaṃtānān saviṣān kariṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will make their own continua poisonous and will make the continua of others poisonous.

children.text: svayaṃ naṣṭāḥ parān api nāśayiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Lost themselves, they will also destroy others.

children.text: svayaṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitām ajānānā anavabudhyamānāḥ parān api grāhayiṣyanti nātra śikṣitavyamiti vācaṃ bhāṣiṣyante
children.translated_text: Not knowing and not understanding the deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> themselves, they will also make others accept the notion, and will utter the words, 'One should not train in this.'

children.text: nāhaṃ śāriputra evaṃrūpāṇāṃ pudgalānāṃ darśanamapyabhyanujānāmi kutastaiḥ saha saṃvāsaṃ kuto vā lābhasatkāraṃ kutaḥ sthānam tatkasya hetoḥ dharmadūṣakā hi te śāriputra tathārūpāḥ pudgalā veditavyā iti
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, I do not approve even the sight of persons of such a sort, much less dwelling together with them, much less gain and honor for them, much less being in the same place. Why is that? <s>Śāriputra</s>, persons of such a sort should be known as destroyers of <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: kasambakajātāste śāriputra tathārūpāḥ pudgalā veditavyāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, persons of such a sort should be known as belonging to a refuse class.

children.text: kṛṣṇānirjātikāḥ kṛṣṇāhijātikāste śāriputra tathārūpāḥ pudgalā veditavyāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, persons of such a sort should be known as of a black, base birth, of the breed of black serpents.

children.text: teṣāṃ śāriputra tathārūpāṇāṃ pudgalānāṃ ye śrotavyaṃ maṃsyante sarve te anayena vyasanamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, all those who think that they should listen to persons of such a sort will fall through misfortune into calamity.

children.text: ye ca śāriputra prajñāpāramitāṃ dūṣayanti ime te śāriputra dharmadūṣakāḥ pudgalā veditavyāḥ
children.translated_text: And those, <s>Śāriputra</s>, who disparage <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be known, <s>Śāriputra</s>, as persons who destroy <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: śāriputra āha na bhagavatā tasya pudgalasya tatropapannasya mahānirayagatasyātmabhāvasya pramāṇamākhyātam
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said: The Blessed One has not stated the measure of the body of that person, born there and gone to the great hell.

children.text: bhagavānāha tiṣṭhatu śāriputra tasya pudgalasya tatropapannasya mahānirayagatasyātmabhāvasya pramāṇam
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: Let be, <s>Śāriputra</s>, the measure of the body of that person, born there and gone to the great hell.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ mā tathārūpasya pudgalasya tadātmabhāvasya pramāṇaṃ śrutvā uṣṇaṃ rudhiraṃ mukhādāgacchet maraṇaṃ vā nigacchet maraṇamātrakaṃ vā duḥkham āgāḍhamābādhaṃ spṛśet dahyeta vā śokaśalyo vā asyāviśet mahāprapātaṃ vā prapatet upaśuṣyeta vā mlāyeta vā
children.translated_text: Why is that? Lest, having heard the measure of the body of such a person, hot blood should come from his mouth, or he should meet death, or experience pain equal to death, a severe and intense illness, or burn; or lest a dart of grief should enter him, or he should fall down a great precipice, or dry up, or wither.

children.text: maiva mahāpratibhayaṃ tasyātmabhāvasya pramāṇamaśrauṣīdyasyeme doṣāḥ saṃvidyante ||
children.translated_text: Let him certainly not hear the very greatly terrifying measure of the body in which these faults are present.

children.text: na bhagavānāyuṣmataḥ śāriputrasyāvakāśaṃ karoti iyattasyātmabhāvasya pramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti
children.translated_text: The Blessed One does not give venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> the opportunity, thinking, 'Such will be the measure of his body.'

children.text: dvitīyakam api tṛtīyakamapyāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat ākhyātu me bhagavāṃstasya pudgalasyātmabhāvasya pramāṇam
children.translated_text: For a second and also for a third time, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Let the Blessed One tell me the measure of that person's body.'

children.text: paścimāyā janatāyā ālokaḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati anena vāṅmanaḥkarmaṇā kṛtena saṃcitenopacitenopacitena evaṃ mahāntaṃ mahānirayeṣvātmabhāvaṃ parigṛhṇīteti
children.translated_text: 'A light will have been made for later people: by this deed of speech and mind, done, amassed, and accumulated, one takes on so great a body in the great hells.'

children.text: bhagavānāha eṣa eva śāriputra paścimāyā janatāyā ālokaḥ kṛto bhaviṣyati yadanena vāṅmanoduścaritena akuśalena karmābhisaṃskāreṇa abhisaṃskṛtena saṃcitenācitenopacitena iyacciraduḥkhaṃ pratyanubhaviṣyatīti
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: This itself, <s>Śāriputra</s>, will have been made a light for later people: that through this bad conduct of speech and mind, through this unwholesome karmic formation that has been formed, amassed, heaped up, and accumulated, he will experience suffering for so long.

children.text: yā etasyaiva śāriputra duḥkhasyāprameyatā bahuduḥkhatā vyākhyātā eṣa eva śuklāṃśikasya kulaputrasya kuladuhiturvā saṃvego bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, the very fact that the immeasurability of this suffering and its great abundance of suffering has been explained will be an occasion of urgent dismay for a son or daughter of good family who belongs to the bright side.

children.text: tataḥ sa tebhyo dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyebhyaḥ karmabhyo vinivṛtya puṇyābhisaṃskārameva kuryāt jīvitahetor api saddharmaṃ na pratikṣepsyati mā bhūdasmākam api tādṛśair duḥkhaiḥ samavadhānamiti ||
children.translated_text: Then that person, having turned away from those karmas that lead to disaster for the <s>dharma</s>, would make only a meritorious formation; even for the sake of life he would not reject the <s>saddharma</s> (true Dharma), thinking, 'May there not be for us too an encounter with such sufferings.'

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat susaṃvṛtakāyakarmavākkarmamanaskarmaṇā bhagavan kulaputreṇa vā kuladuhitrā vā bhavitavyam
children.translated_text: Then venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: Blessed One, a son or daughter of good family should have well-restrained action of body, speech, and mind.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yatra hi nāma bhagavan evaṃrūpeṇa vāgdurbhāṣitena iyān mahāpuṇyaskandhaḥ prasūyate
children.translated_text: Why is that? Since, Blessed One, by such badly spoken speech so great a mass of demerit is produced.

children.text: katamena punarbhagavan karmaṇā iyān mahāpuṇyaskandhaḥ prasūyate
children.translated_text: But by what action, Blessed One, is so great a mass of demerit produced?

children.text: bhagavānāha evaṃrūpeṇa subhūte vāgdurbhāṣitena iyān mahāpuṇyaskandhaḥ prasūyate
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: By such badly spoken speech, <s>Subhūti</s>, so great a mass of demerit is produced.

children.text: ihaiva te subhūte mohapuruṣāḥ svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajitā bhaviṣyanti ya imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ dūṣayitavyāṃ maṃsyante pratikṣeptavyāṃ maṃsyante pratibādhitavyāṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: Here, <s>Subhūti</s>, those deluded men will be ones who have gone forth in the well-proclaimed <s>dharmavinaya</s> (Dharma and discipline), who will think that this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be disparaged, should be rejected, and should be opposed.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāyāṃ ca pratibādhitāyāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ buddhabodhiḥ pratibādhitā bhavati
children.translated_text: And when <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been opposed, the Buddha-awakening of the Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, has been opposed.

children.text: buddhabodhau pratibādhitāyām atītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ sarvajñatā pratibādhitā bhavati
children.translated_text: When Buddha-awakening has been opposed, the <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience) of the Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, of the past, future, and present has been opposed.

children.text: sarvajñatāyāṃ pratibādhitāyāṃ saddharmaḥ pratibādhito bhavati
children.translated_text: When <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience) has been opposed, the <s>saddharma</s> (true Dharma) has been opposed.

children.text: saddharme pratibādhite tathāgataśrāvakasaṃghaḥ pratibādhito bhavati
children.translated_text: When the <s>saddharma</s> (true Dharma) is obstructed, the community of the <s>Tathāgata</s>'s disciples is obstructed.

children.text: tathāgataśrāvakasaṃghe 'pi pratibādhite evaṃ tasya sarveṇa sarvaṃ sarvathā sarvaṃ triratnātparibāhyabhāvo bhavati aprameyāsaṃkhyeyataraś ca mahānakuśalakarmābhisaṃskāraḥ parigṛhīto bhavati ||
children.translated_text: And when the community of the <s>Tathāgata</s>'s disciples too is obstructed, in this way for him there is, wholly, altogether, in every respect, complete exclusion from the <s>triratna</s> (Three Jewels), and an immeasurably and incalculably greater formation of unwholesome karma has been taken up. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat ko 'tra bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayo yatsa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ pratibādhitavyāṃ maṃsyate bhagavānāha mārādhiṣṭhito vā subhūte sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, what is the cause here, what is the condition, that that son or daughter of good family will think that this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should be obstructed?" The Blessed One said: "<s>Subhūti</s>, that son or daughter of good family will either be under the influence of <s>Māra</s>,

children.text: duṣprajñasaṃvartanīyena vā karmaṇā gambhīreṣu dharmeṣu nāsya śraddhā nāsya prasādaḥ
children.translated_text: or, because of karma that leads to poor wisdom, in regard to deep <s>dharmas</s> he has no faith and no confidence.

children.text: ābhyāṃ subhūte dvābhyāṃ pāpābhyāṃ dharmābhyāṃ samanvāgataḥ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ pratibādhiṣyate
children.translated_text: Endowed with these two bad <s>dharmas</s>, <s>Subhūti</s>, that son or daughter of good family will obstruct this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: punaraparaṃ subhūte sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā pāpamitrahastagato vā bhaviṣyati anabhiyukto vā bhaviṣyati skandhābhiniviṣṭo vā bhaviṣyati ātmotkarṣī pareṣāṃ paṃsako doṣāntaraprekṣī vā bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, that son or daughter of good family will have fallen into the hands of a bad friend, or will be unpracticed, or will be fixed on the <s>skandhas</s> (aggregates), or will exalt himself, disparage others, and look for faults and openings.

children.text: ebhirapi subhūte caturbhirākāraiḥ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā samanvāgato bhaviṣyati ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāṃ deśyamānāmupadiśyamānāṃ pratibādhitavyāṃ maṃsyate iti ||
children.translated_text: Endowed also with these four modes, <s>Subhūti</s>, will be that son or daughter of good family who thinks that this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, while it is being spoken, taught, and explained, should be obstructed." ||

children.text: Chapter 8
atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat duradhimocā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā anabhiyuktena kuśalamūlavirahitena pāpamitrahastagatena
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is hard to accept for one who is unpracticed, devoid of roots of good, and fallen into the hands of a bad friend."

children.text: bhagavānāha evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: duradhimocā subhūte prajñāpāramitā anabhiyuktena parīttakuśalamūlena durmedhasā anarthikena alpaśrutena hīnaprajñena pāpamitropastabdhena aśuśrūṣaṇāparipṛcchakajātīyena kuśaleṣu dharmeṣvanabhiyuktena ||
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is hard to accept for one who is unpracticed, has few roots of good, is dull-witted, has no concern for the goal, has heard little, has inferior wisdom, is supported by bad friends, is of a kind that does not listen or ask questions, and is not devoted to wholesome <s>dharmas</s>. ||

children.text: subhūtirāha kiyadgambhīrā bateyaṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitā duradhimocatayā bhagavānāha rūpaṃ subhūte abaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: "How very profound, Blessed One, is this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, because it is hard to accept!" The Blessed One said: "Form, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ rūpāsvabhāvatvātsubhūte rūpamabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because form has no intrinsic nature, <s>Subhūti</s>; form is not bound and not freed.

children.text: evaṃ vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ subhūte abaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: Consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ vijñānāsvabhāvatvātsubhūte vijñānamabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because consciousness has no intrinsic nature, <s>Subhūti</s>; consciousness is not bound and not freed.

children.text: rūpasya subhūte pūrvānto 'baddho 'muktaḥ
children.translated_text: The past limit of form, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ pūrvāntāsvabhāvaṃ hi subhūte rūpam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For form, <s>Subhūti</s>, has no intrinsic nature in its past limit.

children.text: rūpasya subhūte aparānto 'baddho 'muktaḥ
children.translated_text: The future limit of form, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ aparāntāsvabhāvaṃ hi subhūte rūpam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For form, <s>Subhūti</s>, has no intrinsic nature in its future limit.

children.text: pratyutpannaṃ subhūte rūpam abaddhamuktam
children.translated_text: Present form, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ pratyutpannāsvabhāvaṃ hi subhūte pratyutpannaṃ rūpam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For present form, <s>Subhūti</s>, has no intrinsic nature in the present.

children.text: evaṃ vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānasya subhūte pūrvānto 'baddho 'muktaḥ
children.translated_text: The past limit of consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ pūrvāntāsvabhāvaṃ hi subhūte vijñānam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, has no intrinsic nature in its past limit.

children.text: vijñānasya subhūte aparānto 'baddho 'muktaḥ
children.translated_text: The future limit of consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ aparāntāsvabhāvaṃ hi subhūte vijñānam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, has no intrinsic nature in its future limit.

children.text: pratyutpannaṃ subhūte vijñānamabaddhamamuktam
children.translated_text: Present consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not bound and not freed.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ pratyutpannāsvabhāvaṃ hi subhūte pratyutpannaṃ vijñānam ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For present consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, has no intrinsic nature in the present." ||

children.text: subhūtirāha duradhimocā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā paramaduradhimocā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā anabhiyuktena anavaropitakuśalamūlena pāpamitrahastagatena māravaśagatena kusīdena hīnavīryeṇa muṣitasmṛtinā duṣprajñena
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is hard to accept; Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is exceedingly hard to accept for one who is unpracticed, who has not planted roots of good, who has fallen into the hands of a bad friend, who has come under the power of <s>Māra</s>, who is lazy, of inferior vigor, with mindfulness stolen away, and of poor wisdom."

children.text: bhagavānāha evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: duradhimocā subhūte prajñāpāramitā paramaduradhimocā subhūte prajñāpāramitā anabhiyuktena anavaropitakuśalamūlena pāpamitrahastagatena māravaśagatena kusīdena hīnavīryeṇa muṣitasmṛtinā duṣprajñena
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is hard to accept; <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is exceedingly hard to accept for one who is unpracticed, who has not planted roots of good, who has fallen into the hands of a bad friend, who has come under the power of <s>Māra</s>, who is lazy, of inferior vigor, with mindfulness stolen away, and of poor wisdom.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yā subhūte rūpaviśuddhiḥ sā phalaviśuddhiḥ yā phalaviśuddhiḥ sā rūpaviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? That purity of form, <s>Subhūti</s>, is purity of the fruit; that purity of the fruit is purity of form.

children.text: iti hi subhūte rūpaviśuddhiś ca phalaviśuddhiś ca advayam etad advaidhīkāram abhinnam achinnam
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, purity of form and purity of the fruit are nondual, without dualization, undivided, and unbroken.

children.text: iti hi subhūte phalaviśuddhito rūpaviśuddhī rūpaviśuddhitaḥ phalaviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, because of purity of the fruit there is purity of form, and because of purity of form there is purity of the fruit.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: yā subhūte vijñānaviśuddhiḥ sā phalaviśuddhiḥ yā phalaviśuddhiḥ sā vijñānaviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: That purity of consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is purity of the fruit; that purity of the fruit is purity of consciousness.

children.text: iti hi subhūte vijñānaviśuddhiś ca phalaviśuddhiś ca advayametad advaidhīkāram abhinnamacchinnam
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, purity of consciousness and purity of the fruit are nondual, without dualization, undivided, and unbroken.

children.text: iti hi subhūte phalaviśuddhito vijñānaviśuddhir vijñānaviśuddhitaḥ phalaviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, because of purity of the fruit there is purity of consciousness, and because of purity of consciousness there is purity of the fruit.

children.text: punaraparaṃ subhūte yā rūpaviśuddhiḥ sā sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ yā sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ sā rūpaviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, that purity of form is purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience); that purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> is purity of form.

children.text: iti hi subhūte rūpaviśuddhiś ca sarvajñatāviśuddhiś ca advayametad advaidhīkāram abhinnam achinnam
children.translated_text: Thus indeed, <s>Subhūti</s>, the purity of form and the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> are nondual, without making a duality, undivided and unbroken.

children.text: iti hi subhūte sarvajñatāviśuddhito rūpaviśuddhiḥ rūpaviśuddhitaḥ sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus indeed, <s>Subhūti</s>, from the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> comes the purity of form, and from the purity of form comes the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: yā subhūte vijñānaviśuddhiḥ sā sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: That purity of consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s>.

children.text: yā sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ sā vijñānaviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: That purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> is the purity of consciousness.

children.text: iti hi subhūte vijñānaviśuddhiś ca sarvajñatāviśuddhiś ca advayametad advaidhīkāram abhinnam achinnam
children.translated_text: Thus indeed, <s>Subhūti</s>, the purity of consciousness and the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> are nondual, without making a duality, undivided and unbroken.

children.text: iti hi subhūte sarvajñatāviśuddhito vijñānaviśuddhiḥ vijñānaviśuddhitaḥ sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus indeed, <s>Subhūti</s>, from the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s> comes the purity of consciousness, and from the purity of consciousness comes the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s>. ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat gambhīrā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Profound, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha avabhāsakarī bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, 'Illuminating, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha āloko bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, 'A light, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'
