children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha apratisaṃdhirbhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, 'Without reconnection, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha asaṃkleśo bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, 'Without defilement, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha aprāptiranabhisamayo bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, 'It is no attainment and no realization, Blessed One, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha anabhinirvṛttir bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, 'It is non-production, Blessed One, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha atyantānupapattirbhagavan prajñāpāramitā kāmadhāturūpadhātvārūpyadhātuṣu
children.translated_text: He said, 'The utmost non-arising, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> in the desire realm, the form realm, and the formless realm.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha na jānāti na saṃjānīte bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said, '<s>Prajñāpāramitā</s>, Blessed One, does not know and does not cognize.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha kiṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitā na jānāti na saṃjānīte bhagavānāha rūpaṃ śāriputra prajñāpāramitā na jānāti na saṃjānīte
children.translated_text: He said, 'What, Blessed One, does <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> not know and not cognize?' The Blessed One said, 'Form, <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> does not know and does not cognize.'

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ śāriputra prajñāpāramitā na jānāti na saṃjānīte
children.translated_text: Consciousness, <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> does not know and does not cognize.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.

children.text: āha prajñāpāramitā bhagavan sarvajñatāyā nāpakāraṃ karoti nopakāraṃ karoti bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: He said, '<s>Prajñāpāramitā</s>, Blessed One, does neither harm nor help <s>sarvajñatā</s>.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: āha prajñāpāramitā bhagavan na kaṃciddharmaṃ parigṛhṇāti na parityajati bhagavānāha viśuddhatvācchāriputra
children.translated_text: He said, '<s>Prajñāpāramitā</s>, Blessed One, neither takes up nor abandons any <s>dharma</s>.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its purity, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat ātmaviśuddhito bhagavan rūpaviśuddhiḥ bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Blessed One, through the purity of self there is the purity of form.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ātmaviśuddhito bhagavan vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskāraviśuddhiḥ
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, through the purity of self there is the purity of feeling, perception, and formations.'

children.text: ātmaviśuddhito bhagavan vijñānaviśuddhiḥ bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: 'Blessed One, through the purity of self there is the purity of consciousness.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ātmaviśuddhito bhagavan phalaviśuddhiḥ bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, through the purity of self there is the purity of the fruit.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ātmaviśuddhito bhagavan sarvajñatāviśuddhiḥ bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, through the purity of self there is the purity of <s>sarvajñatā</s>.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ātmaviśuddhito bhagavan na prāptirnābhisamayo bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, through the purity of self there is no attainment and no realization.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ātmāparyantatayā bhagavan rūpāparyantatā bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, because the self is without limit, form is without limit.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ātmāparyantatayā bhagavan vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskāravijñānāparyantatā bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, because the self is without limit, feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness are without limit.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha ya evamasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya bhagavan avabodhaḥ iyamasya prajñāpāramitā bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: He said, 'Blessed One, whatever is the awakening of this <s>bodhisattva</s>, this great being, that is his <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.' The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āyuṣmān subhūtirāha sā khalu punariyaṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitā nāpare tīre na pare tīre nāpyubhayamantareṇa viprakṛtā sthitā
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said, 'And yet, Blessed One, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> does not stand fixed on the near shore, nor on the far shore, nor in between both.'

children.text: bhagavānāha atyantaviśuddhatvātsubhūte ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Because of its absolute purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.' ||

children.text: āyuṣmān subhūtirāha evam api bhagavan saṃjñāsyate bodhisattvo mahāsattvo riñciṣyatīmāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ dūrīkariṣyatīmāṃ prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said, 'Even so, Blessed One, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, who conceives in this way will neglect this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; he will put this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> far away.'

children.text: bhagavānāha sādhu sādhu subhūte
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said, 'Good, good, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: evam etat subhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: 'So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.'

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ nāmato 'pi hi subhūte saṅgo nimittato 'pi saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For even by name, <s>Subhūti</s>, there is attachment; even by sign there is attachment.

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvadiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā svākhyātā sunirdiṣṭā supariniṣṭhitā yatra hi nāma bhagavatā ime 'pi saṅgā ākhyātāḥ
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Wonderful, Blessed One, how well this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been taught, well indicated, and well brought to completion, since the Blessed One has also declared even these attachments.'

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat katame te āyuṣman subhūte saṅgāḥ subhūtirāha rūpamāyuṣman śāriputra śūnyamiti saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'Which are those attachments, venerable <s>Subhūti</s>?' <s>Subhūti</s> said, 'Form is empty, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: this is attachment.'

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānamāyuṣman śāriputra śūnyamiti saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: 'Consciousness is empty, venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: this is attachment.'

children.text: atīteṣu dharmeṣvatītā dharmā iti saṃjānīte saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: If one cognizes past <s>dharmas</s> among past <s>dharmas</s> as 'past <s>dharmas</s>,' that is attachment.

children.text: anāgateṣu dharmeṣvanāgatā dharmā iti saṃjānīte saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: If one cognizes future <s>dharmas</s> among future <s>dharmas</s> as 'future <s>dharmas</s>,' that is attachment.

children.text: pratyutpanneṣu dharmeṣu pratyutpannā dharmā iti saṃjānīte saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: There is attachment if, with regard to present dharmas, one perceives, 'These are present dharmas.'

children.text: iyantaṃ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasūyate bodhisattvayānikaḥ pudgalaḥ prathamena cittotpādeneti saṃjānīte saṅgaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There is attachment if one perceives, 'A person of the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle produces this much mass of merit by the first production of thought.' ||

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat katamena ārya subhūte paryāyeṇa saṅgaḥ subhūtirāha sacetkauśika tadbodhicittaṃ saṃjānīte idaṃ tatprathamaṃ bodhicittamiti anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau pariṇāmayāmīti pariṇāmayati
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'By what mode, noble <s>Subhūti</s>, is there attachment?' <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'If, <s>Kauśika</s>, one perceives that <s>bodhicitta</s> as, "This is that first <s>bodhicitta</s>," and dedicates it, thinking, "I dedicate it to unsurpassed perfect awakening,"

children.text: na ca cittaprakṛtiḥ śakyā pariṇāmayituṃ tena kulaputreṇa vā kuladuhitrā vā mahāyānasamprasthitena
children.translated_text: yet the nature of mind cannot be dedicated by that son of good family or daughter of good family who has set out in the <s>Mahāyāna</s>.

children.text: tasmāttarhi kauśika paraṃ saṃdarśayatā samādāpayatā samuttejayatā saṃpraharṣayatā anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau bhūtānugamena saṃdarśayitavyaṃ samādāpayitavyaṃ samuttejayitavyaṃ saṃpraharṣayitavyam
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Kauśika</s>, when showing another, making another undertake it, stirring another up, and gladdening another in unsurpassed perfect awakening, one should show, make undertake, stir up, and gladden in accordance with reality.

children.text: evamātmānaṃ ca na kṣiṇoti buddhānujñātayā ca samādāpanayā paraṃ samādāpayati sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā
children.translated_text: In this way that son of good family or daughter of good family does not wear himself away, and by an exhortation permitted by the Buddha he exhorts another.

children.text: imāścāsya sarvāḥ saṅgakoṭyo vivarjitā bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: And all these extreme points of attachment are avoided by him. ||

children.text: atha khalu bhagavānāyuṣmate subhūtaye sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu subhūte yastvaṃ bodhisattvān mahāsattvānimāḥ saṅgakoṭīrbodhayasi
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One applauded the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'Good, good, <s>Subhūti</s>, that you make <s>bodhisattvas</s>, great beings, understand these extreme points of attachment.

children.text: tena hi subhūte anyān api sūkṣmatarān saṅgānākhyāsyāmi tān śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasi kuru
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Subhūti</s>, I shall explain still other, more subtle attachments. Listen to them, and attend well and properly.

children.text: bhāṣiṣye 'haṃ te
children.translated_text: I shall speak to you.'

children.text: sādhu bhagavan ityāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīt ||
children.translated_text: 'Good, Blessed One,' the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> replied to the Blessed One. ||

children.text: bhagavānetadavocat iha subhūte śrāddhaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ nimittato manasi karoti
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said this: 'Here, <s>Subhūti</s>, a faithful son of good family or daughter of good family attends to the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha, by way of a sign.

children.text: yāvanti khalu punaḥ subhūte nimittāni tāvantaḥ saṅgāḥ
children.translated_text: Now, <s>Subhūti</s>, as many as are the signs, so many are the attachments.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ nimittato hi subhūte saṅgaḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For attachment, <s>Subhūti</s>, is by way of a sign.

children.text: iti hi so 'tītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ ye anāsravā dharmāstānanumode ityanumodya anumodanāsahagataṃ kuśalamūlamanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau pariṇāmayāmīti pariṇāmayati
children.translated_text: Thus he rejoices in the stainless dharmas of the past, future, and present Buddhas, the Blessed Ones; and having rejoiced in them, he dedicates the root of good accompanied by rejoicing, thinking, "I dedicate it to unsurpassed perfect awakening."

children.text: yā khalu punaḥ subhūte dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā na sā atītā vā anāgatā vā pratyutpannā vā
children.translated_text: But, <s>Subhūti</s>, the dharma-nature of dharmas is not past, nor future, nor present.

children.text: yā nātītā nānāgatā na pratyutpannā sā tryadhvanirmuktā
children.translated_text: What is not past, not future, and not present is freed from the three times.

children.text: yā tryadhvanirmuktā na sā śakyā pariṇāmayituṃ na nimittīkartuṃ nārambaṇīkartum
children.translated_text: What is freed from the three times cannot be dedicated, cannot be made into a sign, and cannot be made into an object of support.

children.text: nāpi sā dṛṣṭaśrutamatavijñātā ||
children.translated_text: Nor is it seen, heard, thought, or cognized. ||

children.text: subhūtirāha gambhīrā bhagavan prakṛtirdharmāṇām
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Profound, Blessed One, is the nature of dharmas.'

children.text: bhagavānāha viviktatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Because of its seclusion, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: āha prakṛtigambhīrā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said: 'Naturally profound, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha prakṛtiviśuddhatvātsubhūte
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Because of its natural purity, <s>Subhūti</s>.'

children.text: prakṛtiviviktatvātprakṛtigambhīrā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because of its natural seclusion, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is naturally profound.

children.text: subhūtirāha prakṛtiviviktā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Naturally secluded, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: namaskaromi bhagavan prajñāpāramitāyai ||
children.translated_text: 'Blessed One, I bow to <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.' ||

children.text: bhagavānāha sarvadharmā api subhūte prakṛtiviviktāḥ
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'All dharmas too, <s>Subhūti</s>, are naturally secluded.

children.text: yā ca subhūte sarvadharmāṇāṃ prakṛtiviviktatā sā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: And, <s>Subhūti</s>, that natural seclusion of all dharmas is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi subhūte akṛtāḥ sarvadharmāstathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhenābhisaṃbuddhāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For in this way, <s>Subhūti</s>, all dharmas have been fully awakened to as unmade by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha.'

children.text: subhūtirāha tasmāttarhi bhagavan sarvadharmā anabhisaṃbuddhās tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena bhagavānāha tathāhi subhūte prakṛtyaiva na te dharmāḥ kiṃcit
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Therefore, Blessed One, all dharmas have not been fully awakened to by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha.' The Blessed One said: 'So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; by their very nature those dharmas are not anything at all.

children.text: yā ca prakṛtiḥ sā aprakṛtiḥ yā ca prakṛtiḥ sā prakṛtiḥ sarvadharmāṇāmekalakṣaṇatvādyaduta alakṣaṇatvāt
children.translated_text: And what is nature is non-nature; and what is nature is the nature of all dharmas, because they have a single characteristic, namely, characteristiclessness.

children.text: tasmāttarhi subhūte sarvadharmā anabhisaṃbuddhās tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena
children.translated_text: Therefore, <s>Subhūti</s>, all dharmas have not been fully awakened to by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ na hi subhūte dve dharmaprakṛtī
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Subhūti</s>, there are not two natures of dharmas.

children.text: ekaiva hi subhūte sarvadharmāṇāṃ prakṛtiḥ
children.translated_text: There is only one nature of all dharmas, <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: yā ca subhūte sarvadharmāṇāṃ prakṛtiḥ sā aprakṛtiḥ yā ca aprakṛtiḥ sā prakṛtiḥ
children.translated_text: And, <s>Subhūti</s>, what is the nature of all dharmas is non-nature; and what is non-nature is nature.

children.text: evametāḥ subhūte sarvāḥ saṅgakoṭyo vivarjitā bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: In this way, <s>Subhūti</s>, all these extreme points of attachment are avoided.' ||

children.text: subhūtirāha gambhīrā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Profound, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha ākāśagambhīratayā subhūte gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Because it is profound with the profundity of space, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is profound.'

children.text: subhūtirāha duranubodhā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Hard to awaken to, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha tathā hi subhūte na kaścidabhisaṃbudhyate
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>, for no one at all fully awakens to it.'

children.text: āha acintyā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said: 'Inconceivable, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha tathā hi subhūte prajñāpāramitā na cittena jñātavyā na cittagamanīyā
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is not to be known by mind and is not within the range of mind.'

children.text: āha akṛtā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: He said: 'Unmade, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: bhagavānāha kārakānupalabdhitaḥ subhūte akṛtā prajñāpāramitā ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Because no agent is apprehended, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unmade.' ||

children.text: āha tena hi bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvena prajñāpāramitāyāṃ kathaṃ caritavyam bhagavānāha sacetsubhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caranna rūpe carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: He said: 'Then, Blessed One, how should a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, practice in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?' The Blessed One said: 'If, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, while practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, does not practice in form, he practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: evaṃ sacenna vedanāyāṃ na saṃjñāyāṃ na saṃskāreṣu
children.translated_text: Thus, if he does not course in feeling, not in perception, not in formations,

children.text: sacenna vijñāne carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: and if he does not course in consciousness, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (perfection of wisdom).

children.text: sacedrūpamanityamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Form is impermanent,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: sacedvijñānamanityamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Consciousness is impermanent,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sacedrūpaṃ śūnyamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Form is empty,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: sacedvijñānaṃ śūnyamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Consciousness is empty,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sacedrūpam apratipūrṇaṃ pratipūrṇamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Form is incomplete or complete,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yā ca rūpasyāpratipūrṇatā pratipūrṇatā vā na tadrūpam
children.translated_text: And whatever is the incompleteness or completeness of form, that is not form.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: sacedvijñānam apratipūrṇaṃ pratipūrṇamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Consciousness is incomplete or complete,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yā ca vijñānasyāpratipūrṇatā pratipūrṇatā vā na tadvijñānam
children.translated_text: And whatever is the incompleteness or completeness of consciousness, that is not consciousness.

children.text: sacedevam api na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām ||
children.translated_text: If he does not course even in this way, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvadyadevaṃ bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ sasaṅgatā ca asaṅgatā ca khyātāḥ
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'It is wonderful, Blessed One, how for bodhisattvas, great beings, things are declared both with attachment and without attachment.'

children.text: bhagavānāha rūpaṃ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti subhūte na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: '<s>Subhūti</s>, if he does not course thinking, "Form is with attachment or without attachment," he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti subhūte na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, if he does not course thinking, "Consciousness is with attachment or without attachment," he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: cakṣuḥ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'The eye is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ yāvanmanaḥsaṃsparśajā vedanā sasaṅgāsaṅgeti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: So on up to: if he does not course thinking, 'Feeling born from contact with mind is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: pṛthivīdhātuḥ sasaṅgo 'saṅga iti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'The earth element is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yāvadvijñānadhātuḥ sasaṅgo 'saṅga iti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: Up to: if he does not course thinking, 'The consciousness element is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: dānapāramitā sasaṅgāsaṅgeti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'The perfection of giving is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ śīlapāramitā kṣāntipāramitā vīryapāramitā dhyānapāramitā
children.translated_text: So too the perfection of morality, the perfection of patience, the perfection of vigor, and the perfection of meditation.

children.text: prajñāpāramitā sasaṅgāsaṅgeti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'The perfection of wisdom is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ saptatriṃśadbodhipakṣā dharmā balāni vaiśāradyāni pratisaṃvido 'ṣṭādaśāveṇikā buddhadharmāḥ sasaṅgāsaṅgā iti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: So too, if he does not course thinking, 'The thirty-seven factors on the side of awakening, the powers, the fearlessnesses, the analytical knowledges, and the eighteen unique Buddha qualities are with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: srotaāpattiphalaṃ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'The fruit of stream-entry is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ sakṛdāgāmiphalamanāgāmiphalamarhattvaṃ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: So too, if he does not course thinking, 'The fruit of once-returning, the fruit of non-returning, and arhatship are with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: pratyekabuddhatvaṃ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Pratyekabuddhahood is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: buddhatvaṃ sasaṅgamasaṅgamiti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If he does not course thinking, 'Buddhahood is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sarvajñatāpi subhūte sasaṅgāsaṅgeti na carati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, if he does not course thinking, '<s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience) too is with attachment or without attachment,' he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ caran subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo na rūpe saṅgaṃ janayati na vedanāyāṃ na saṃjñāyāṃ na saṃskāreṣu
children.translated_text: Coursing thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a great being, does not produce attachment to form, nor to feeling, nor to perception, nor to formations.

children.text: na vijñāne saṅgaṃ janayati
children.translated_text: He does not produce attachment to consciousness.

children.text: na cakṣuṣi saṅgaṃ janayati
children.translated_text: He does not produce attachment to the eye.

children.text: yāvanna manaḥsaṃsparśajāyāṃ vedanāyāṃ saṅgaṃ janayati
children.translated_text: So on up to: he does not produce attachment to feeling born from contact with mind.

children.text: na pṛthivīdhātau saṅgaṃ janayati yāvanna vijñānadhātau saṅgaṃ janayati na dānapāramitāyāṃ saṅgaṃ janayati na śīlapāramitāyāṃ na kṣāntipāramitāyāṃ na vīryapāramitāyāṃ na dhyānapāramitāyāṃ na prajñāpāramitāyāṃ saṅgaṃ janayati na bodhipakṣeṣu dharmeṣu na baleṣu na vaiśāradyeṣu na pratisaṃvitsu nāṣṭādaśasvāveṇikeṣu buddhadharmeṣu saṅgaṃ janayati na srotaāpattiphale saṅgaṃ janayati na sakṛdāgāmiphale na anāgāmiphale na arhattve saṅgaṃ janayati na pratyekabuddhatve saṅgaṃ janayati na buddhatve saṅgaṃ janayati nāpi sarvajñatāyāṃ saṅgaṃ janayati
children.translated_text: He does not produce attachment to the earth element, up to the consciousness element; he does not produce attachment to the perfection of giving, to the perfection of morality, to the perfection of patience, to the perfection of vigor, to the perfection of meditation, or to the perfection of wisdom; he does not produce attachment to the factors on the side of awakening, to the powers, to the fearlessnesses, to the analytical knowledges, or to the eighteen unique Buddha qualities; he does not produce attachment to the fruit of stream-entry, to the fruit of once-returning, to the fruit of non-returning, to arhatship, to pratyekabuddhahood, to Buddhahood, or even to <s>sarvajñatā</s> (omniscience).

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ asaktā abaddhā amuktā asamatikrāntā hi subhūte sarvajñatā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For <s>sarvajñatā</s>, <s>Subhūti</s>, is unattached, unbound, unreleased, and not transcended.

children.text: evaṃ hi subhūte sarvasaṅgasamatikramāya bodhisattvairmahāsattvaiḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caritavyam ||
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, bodhisattvas, great beings, should course in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for the passing beyond of all attachment. ||

children.text: subhūtirāha āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvadgambhīro 'yaṃ bhagavan dharmaḥ prajñāpāramitā nāma
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'It is wonderful, Blessed One, how profound, Blessed One, is this <s>dharma</s> called <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yā deśyamānāpi na parihīyate adeśyamānāpi na parihīyate
children.translated_text: Even while it is being taught, it does not diminish; even while it is not being taught, it does not diminish.

children.text: deśyamānāpi na vardhate
children.translated_text: Even while it is being taught, it does not increase.

children.text: adeśyamānāpi na vardhate
children.translated_text: Even while it is not being taught, it does not increase.'

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat sādhu sādhu subhūte
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'Good, good, <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma subhūte tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho yāvajjīvaṃ tiṣṭhannākāśasya varṇaṃ bhāṣeta nākāśasya vṛddhirbhavet
children.translated_text: Just as, <s>Subhūti</s>, if the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the arhat, the perfectly awakened one, were to remain for his whole life and speak of the color of space, there would be no increase of space.

children.text: abhāṣyamāṇe 'pi varṇe naivākāśasya parihānirbhavet
children.translated_text: Even when the color is not spoken of, there would certainly be no diminution of space.'

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma subhūte māyāpuruṣo bhāṣyamāṇe 'pi varṇe nānunīyate na saṃkliśyate abhāṣyamāṇe 'pi varṇe na pratihanyate na saṃkliśyate
children.translated_text: Just as, <s>Subhūti</s>, a conjured person is not pleased and is not defiled when a syllable is spoken, and is not obstructed and not defiled when a syllable is not spoken,

children.text: evameva subhūte yā dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā sā deśyamānāpi tāvatyeva adeśyamānāpi tāvatyeva ||
children.translated_text: so too, <s>Subhūti</s>, the true nature of <s>dharmas</s> is just so much when it is being taught and just so much when it is not being taught. ||

children.text: sthaviraḥ subhūtirāha duṣkarakārako bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo yo gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāvayan na saṃsīdati notplavate
children.translated_text: The elder <s>Subhūti</s> said: Hard to do, Blessed One, is the work of the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who, while practicing in the profound <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and cultivating <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, neither sinks down nor rises up.

children.text: atra ca nāma yogamāpadyate na ca pratyudāvartate
children.translated_text: And here indeed he enters into disciplined practice and does not turn back.

children.text: ākāśabhāvanaiṣā bhagavan yaduta prajñāpāramitābhāvanā
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a cultivation of space, namely the cultivation of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: namaskartavyāste bhagavan bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ yairayaṃ saṃnāhaḥ saṃnaddhaḥ
children.translated_text: Those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s>, Blessed One, by whom this armor has been put on, are to be honored.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ ākāśena sārdhaṃ sa bhagavan saṃnaddhukāmo yaḥ sattvānāṃ kṛtaśaḥ saṃnāhaṃ badhnāti
children.translated_text: Why is that? Blessed One, one who puts on armor for the sake of beings wishes to put it on together with space.

children.text: mahāsaṃnāhasaṃnaddho bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, Blessed One, is armored in great armor.

children.text: śūro bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo ya ākāśasamānāṃ sattvānāṃ dharmadhātusamānāṃ sattvānāṃ kṛtaśaḥ saṃnāhaṃ saṃnaddhukāmo 'nuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃboddhukāmaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, Blessed One, is heroic: he wishes to put on armor for the sake of beings equal to space and beings equal to the <s>dharmadhātu</s> (realm of phenomena), and he wishes to awaken to unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: ākāśaṃ sa bhagavan parimocayitukāmaḥ
children.translated_text: He, Blessed One, wishes to liberate space.

children.text: ākāśaṃ sa bhagavan utkṣeptukāmaḥ
children.translated_text: He, Blessed One, wishes to lift up space.

children.text: mahāvīryapāramitāsaṃnāhaprāptaḥ sa bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattvo ya ākāśasamānāṃ dharmadhātusamānāṃ sattvānāṃ kṛtaśaḥ saṃnāhaṃ saṃnahyate ||
children.translated_text: That <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, Blessed One, who puts on armor for the sake of beings equal to space and beings equal to the <s>dharmadhātu</s> has reached the armor of the great perfection of vigor. ||

children.text: atha khalvanyatamo bhikṣuryena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantametadavocat namaskaromi bhagavan prajñāpāramitāyai
children.translated_text: Then a certain monk, having gone to where the Blessed One was and having bowed with joined palms toward the Blessed One, said this to him: Blessed One, I pay homage to <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tathā hi bhagavan prajñāpāramitā na kaṃciddharmamutpādayati na kaṃciddharmaṃ nirodhayati ||
children.translated_text: For in this way, Blessed One, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> does not produce any <s>dharma</s> and does not stop any <s>dharma</s>. ||

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindra āyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat ya ārya subhūte atra prajñāpāramitāyāmeva yogamāpatsyate kva sa yogamāpatsyate subhūtirāha ākāśe sa kauśika yogamāpatsyate yaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ yogamāpatsyate
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: Noble <s>Subhūti</s>, where will one enter into disciplined practice if one enters into disciplined practice here precisely in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? <s>Subhūti</s> said: <s>Kauśika</s>, one who enters into disciplined practice in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will enter into disciplined practice in space.

children.text: abhyavakāśe sa kauśika yogamāpatsyate yaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ śikṣitavyaṃ yogamāpattavyaṃ maṃsyate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kauśika</s>, one who thinks that one should train and enter into disciplined practice in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will enter into disciplined practice in open space. ||

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat ājñāpayatu bhagavān
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: Let the Blessed One give the command.

children.text: tasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhiturvā rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ karomi ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ dhārayati
children.translated_text: I will provide protection, shielding, and guarding for that son or daughter of good family who holds this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtiḥ śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat samanupaśyasi tvaṃ kauśika taṃ dharmaṃ yasya dharmasya rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyasi śakra āha no hīdamārya subhūte
children.translated_text: Then venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: Do you perceive, <s>Kauśika</s>, that <s>dharma</s> for which you will provide protection, shielding, and guarding? <s>Śakra</s> said: No indeed, noble <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: subhūtirāha evaṃ kauśika sacedbodhisattvo mahāsattvo yathānirdiṣṭāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ sthāsyati saiva tasya rakṣāvaraṇaguptirbhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: In this way, <s>Kauśika</s>, if a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> stands in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> as it has been taught, that itself will be his protection, shielding, and guarding.

children.text: atha virahito bhaviṣyati prajñāpāramitayā lapsyante 'sya avatāraprekṣiṇo 'vatāragaveṣiṇo manuṣyāś ca amanuṣyāś ca avatāram
children.translated_text: But if he is separated from <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, humans and non-humans who watch for an opening and seek an opening will find an opening in him.

children.text: api ca kauśika ākāśasya sa rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ saṃvidhātavyāṃ manyeta yo bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ saṃvidhātavyāṃ manyeta prajñāpāramitāyāṃ carataḥ
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Kauśika</s>, one who thinks that protection, shielding, and guarding should be arranged for a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> might as well think that protection, shielding, and guarding should be arranged for space.

children.text: tatkiṃ manyase kauśika pratibalastvaṃ pratiśrutkāyā rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ saṃvidhātum śakra āha na hyetadārya subhūte
children.translated_text: What do you think, <s>Kauśika</s>? Are you able to arrange protection, shielding, and guarding for an echo? <s>Śakra</s> said: This is not so, noble <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: subhūtirāha evameva kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran viharan pratiśrutkopamāḥ sarvadharmā iti parijānāti
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: In just the same way, <s>Kauśika</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, practicing and dwelling in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, understands that all <s>dharmas</s> are like echoes.

children.text: sa ca tānna manyate na samanupaśyati na jānāti na saṃjānīte
children.translated_text: And he does not conceive them, does not perceive them, does not know them, and does not cognize them.

children.text: te ca dharmā na vidyante na saṃdṛśyante na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante iti viharati
children.translated_text: He dwells thinking: Those <s>dharmas</s> do not exist, are not seen, are not found, and are not apprehended.

children.text: sacedevaṃ viharati carati prajñāpāramitāyām ||
children.translated_text: If in this way he dwells and practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>. ||

children.text: atha khalu buddhānubhāvena ye trisāhasramahāsāhasre lokadhātau catvāro mahārājānaḥ sarve ca śakrā devendrāḥ sarve ca mahābrahmāṇaḥ sahāpatiś ca mahābrahmā te sarve yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntāḥ
children.translated_text: Then, through the Buddha's power, all the four great kings in the three-thousand-great-thousand world system, all the <s>Śakras</s>, lords of the gods, all the <s>Mahābrahmās</s>, and <s>Sahāpati Mahābrahmā</s> approached the Blessed One.

children.text: upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya bhagavantaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ekānte 'tiṣṭhan
children.translated_text: Having approached, they bowed with their heads to the Blessed One's feet, circumambulated the Blessed One three times, and stood to one side.

children.text: ekānte sthitāś ca te mahārājānaḥ sarve ca śakrā devendrāḥ sarve ca brahmakāyikā devā mahābrahmāṇaśca sahāpatiś ca mahābrahmā buddhānubhāvena buddhādhiṣṭhānena buddhasahasraṃ samanvāharanti sma
children.translated_text: And while standing to one side, those great kings, all the <s>Śakras</s>, lords of the gods, all the gods of the <s>Brahmā</s> host, the <s>Mahābrahmās</s>, and <s>Sahāpati Mahābrahmā</s>, through the Buddha's power and the Buddha's sustaining force, brought to mind a thousand Buddhas.

children.text: ebhireva nāmabhirebhireva padairebhirevākṣaraiḥ subhūtināmadheyaireva bhikṣubhiriyameva prajñāpāramitopadiṣṭā ayameva prajñāpāramitāparivartaḥ
children.translated_text: With these very names, with these very words, with these very syllables, and by monks bearing the name <s>Subhūti</s>, this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> was taught, this very chapter on <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatrāpi śakrā eva devendrāḥ paripṛcchanti sma paripraśnayanti sma asmin eva pṛthivīpradeśe iyameva prajñāpāramitā bhāṣitā
children.translated_text: There too the <s>Śakras</s>, the lords of the gods, asked and questioned: "In this very region of the earth this same <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (perfection of wisdom) was spoken,

children.text: maitreyo 'pi bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhya asmin eva pṛthivīpradeśe enāmeva prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣiṣyate iti ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Maitreya</s> too, the bodhisattva, the great being, having awakened to unsurpassed perfect awakening, will speak this same <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> in this very region of the earth." ||

children.text: Chapter 9
atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat prajñāpāramiteti bhagavan nāmadheyamātram etat
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, '<s>prajñāpāramitā</s>' is merely a name.

children.text: tacca nāma idamiti nopalabhyate
children.translated_text: And that name is not apprehended as 'this.'

children.text: vāgvastveva nāmetyucyate
children.translated_text: Only a basis for speech is called a name.

children.text: sāpi prajñāpāramitā na vidyate nopalabhyate
children.translated_text: That <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> too does not exist and is not apprehended.

children.text: yathaiva nāma tathaiva prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Just as the name is, so is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: yathā prajñāpāramitā tathā nāma
children.translated_text: As <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is, so is the name.

children.text: dharmadvayametanna vidyate nopalabhyate
children.translated_text: These two <s>dharmas</s> are not found and are not apprehended.

children.text: kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhagavan maitreyo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhya ebhireva nāmabhiḥ ebhireva padaiḥ ebhirevākṣaraiḥ asmin eva pṛthivīpradeśe prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣiṣyate evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat tathā hi subhūte maitreyo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo na rūpaṃ nityaṃ nānityaṃ na rūpaṃ baddhaṃ na muktam atyantaviśuddhamityabhisaṃbhotsyate
children.translated_text: For what reason, Blessed One, will <s>Maitreya</s>, the bodhisattva, the great being, having awakened to unsurpassed perfect awakening, speak <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> in this very region of the earth with these same names, these same words, these same syllables?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "For, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>Maitreya</s>, the bodhisattva, the great being, will not fully awaken to form as permanent or impermanent, nor to form as bound or freed, or as completely pure.

children.text: evaṃ nā vedanāṃ na saṃjñāṃ na saṃskārān
children.translated_text: So too he will not fully awaken to feeling, perception, and formations in that way.

children.text: na vijñānaṃ nityaṃ nānityam na vijñānaṃ baddhaṃ na muktam atyantaviśuddham ityabhisaṃbhotsyate
children.translated_text: He will not fully awaken to consciousness as permanent or impermanent, nor to consciousness as bound or freed, or as completely pure.

children.text: anena subhūte kāraṇena maitreyo bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhya ebhireva nāmabhirebhireva padavyañjanairasmin eva pṛthivīpradeśe imāmeva prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣiṣyate ||
children.translated_text: For this reason, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>Maitreya</s>, the bodhisattva, the great being, having awakened to unsurpassed perfect awakening, will speak this same <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> in this very region of the earth with these same names and these same words and syllables. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat pariśuddhā bateyaṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitā bhagavānāha rūpaviśuddhitaḥ subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is indeed pure." The Blessed One said: "<s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because of the purity of form.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too because of the purity of feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaviśuddhitaḥ subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because of the purity of consciousness.

children.text: rūpānutpādānirodhāsaṃkleśāvyavadānaviśuddhitaḥ subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because form is pure in its non-arising, non-cessation, non-defilement, and non-purification.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānānutpādānirodhāsaṃkleśāvyavadānaviśuddhitaḥ subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because consciousness is pure in its non-arising, non-cessation, non-defilement, and non-purification.

children.text: ākāśaviśuddhitaḥ subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because of the purity of space.

children.text: rūpanirupalepāparigrahatayā subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because form is unstained and unappropriated.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānanirupalepāparigrahatayā subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because consciousness is unstained and unappropriated.

children.text: ākāśapratiśrutkāvacanīyapravyāhāranirupalepatayā subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because words and utterances, to be described as echoes in space, are unstained.

children.text: sarvopalepānulepadharmānupalepatayā subhūte pariśuddhā prajñāpāramitā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is pure because all <s>dharmas</s> involving stain and smearing are unstained. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat sulabdhā bata lābhāsteṣāṃ bhagavan kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca yeṣāmiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā śrotrāvabhāsamapyāgamiṣyati prāgeva ya udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, those sons of good family and daughters of good family will indeed have gained good gains, to whose range of hearing this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will come, still more those who will learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, and study it.

children.text: na teṣāṃ cakṣūrogo bhaviṣyati na śrotrarogo na ghrāṇarogo na jihvārogo na kāyarogo bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: They will have no disease of the eye, no disease of the ear, no disease of the nose, no disease of the tongue, and no disease of the body.

children.text: na dhandhāyitatā bhaviṣyati na te viṣamāparihāreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will not be dull or confused, and they will not die through an adverse mishap.

children.text: bahūni caiṣāṃ devatāsahasrāṇi pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nubaddhāni bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: Many thousands of deities will follow behind them, close behind.

children.text: aṣṭamīṃ caturdaśīṃ pañcadaśīṃ ca sa dharmabhāṇakaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā yatra yatra prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣiṣyate tatra tatra bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasaviṣyati
children.translated_text: On the eighth, fourteenth, and fifteenth days, wherever that son of good family or daughter of good family who is a preacher of the <s>dharma</s> speaks <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, there he or she will produce still more merit.

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: bahūni subhūte tasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhiturvā devatāsahasrāṇi pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nubaddhāni bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, many thousands of deities will follow behind that son of good family or daughter of good family, close behind.

children.text: bahūni ca devatāsahasrāṇi tatrāgamiṣyanti sarvāṇi dharmaśravaṇārthikāni
children.translated_text: And many thousands of deities will come there, all desirous of hearing the <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: tāni ca rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ saṃvidhāsyanti tasya dharmabhāṇakasya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣamāṇasya
children.translated_text: They will arrange protection, shelter, and guarding for that preacher of the <s>dharma</s> as he speaks this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sadevamānuṣāsurasya hi subhūte lokasya prajñāpāramitā anuttaraṃ ratnam
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is the unsurpassed jewel of the world with its gods, humans, and asuras.

children.text: ato 'pi subhūte kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasaviṣyati
children.translated_text: Therefore too, <s>Subhūti</s>, a son of good family or daughter of good family will, on that account, produce still more merit.

children.text: api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte bahavo 'ntarāyā bhaviṣyanti asyā gambhīrāyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyā likhyamānāyā udgṛhyamāṇāyā dhāryamāṇāyā vācyamānāyāḥ paryavāpyamānāyāḥ pravartyamānāyā upadiśyamānāyā uddiśyamānāyāḥ svādhyāyyamānāyāḥ
children.translated_text: But again, <s>Subhūti</s>, many obstacles will arise while this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being written, learned, retained, recited, mastered, set forth, instructed, proclaimed, and studied.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi subhūte bahupratyarthikāni mahāratnāni bhavanti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, great jewels have many adversaries.

children.text: yathāsāraṃ ca gurutarapratyarthikāni bhavanti
children.translated_text: And according to their value they have weightier adversaries.

children.text: anuttaraṃ cedaṃ subhūte mahāratnaṃ lokasya yaduta prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: And this, <s>Subhūti</s>, is the unsurpassed great jewel of the world, namely <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: hitāya sukhāya pratipannā lokasya
children.translated_text: It has been undertaken for the welfare and happiness of the world.

children.text: sarvadharmāṇām anutpādāyānirodhāyāsaṃkleśāyāvināśayogena pratyupasthitā
children.translated_text: It is present through connection with the non-production, non-cessation, non-defilement, and non-destruction of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: na ca subhūte prajñāpāramitā kaṃciddharmamālīyate na kaṃciddharmaṃ saṃkliśyate na kaṃciddharmaṃ parigṛhṇāti
children.translated_text: And, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is not attached to any <s>dharma</s>, does not defile any <s>dharma</s>, and does not grasp any <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi subhūte sarve te dharmā na saṃvidyante nopalabhyante
children.translated_text: Why is that? For thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, all those <s>dharmas</s> do not exist and are not apprehended.

children.text: anupalabdhitaḥ subhūte anupaliptā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Because it is not apprehended, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unstained.

children.text: anupalipteti subhūte iyaṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: 'Unstained,' <s>Subhūti</s>, is this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tathā hi subhūte rūpanirupalepatayā anupalipteyaṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: For thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, through the unstainedness of form, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unstained.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānanirupalepatayā subhūte anupalipteyaṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Through the unstainedness of consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is unstained.

children.text: sacedevam api subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvo na saṃjānīte carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: If, even in this way, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>, does not conceive, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sā khalu punariyaṃ subhūte prajñāpāramitā na kasyaciddharmasyāveśikā vā niveśikā vā saṃdarśikā vā nidarśikā vā āvāhikā vā nirvāhikā vā ||
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> does not make any <s>dharma</s> enter or settle, does not show or indicate it, and does not bring it in or carry it out. ||

children.text: atha khalu saṃbahulāni devaputrasahasrāṇi antarīkṣe kilakilāprakṣveḍitena cailavikṣepānakārṣuḥ dvitīyaṃ batedaṃ dharmacakrapravartanaṃ jambūdvīpe paśyāma iti cāvocan
children.translated_text: Then many thousands of sons of gods in the air made shouts of joy and waved their garments, saying, 'We behold this second turning of the <s>dharmacakra</s> in <s>Jambūdvīpa</s>.'

children.text: atha khalu bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtiṃ sthavirametadavocat nedaṃ subhūte dvitīyaṃ dharmacakrapravartanaṃ nāpi kasyaciddharmasya pravartanaṃ vā nivartanaṃ vā
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said this to the venerable elder <s>Subhūti</s>: 'This, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not a second turning of the <s>dharmacakra</s>, nor is it the turning or stopping of any <s>dharma</s>.'

children.text: evamiyaṃ subhūte bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya prajñāpāramitā ||
children.translated_text: Thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, is this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> of a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat mahāpāramiteyaṃ bhagavaṃstasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya yasyāsaṅgatā sarvadharmeṣu yo 'sāvanuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃboddhukāmo na ca kaṃciddharmamabhisaṃbudhyate dharmacakraṃ ca pravartayiṣyati na ca kaṃciddharmaṃ saṃdarśayiṣyati
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Great, Blessed One, is this perfection of that <s>bodhisattva</s>, that <s>mahāsattva</s>, whose relation to all <s>dharmas</s> is unattached, who wishes to awaken fully to unsurpassed perfect awakening, yet does not awaken to any <s>dharma</s>, and who will turn the <s>dharmacakra</s>, yet will not show any <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ na hi kaściddharmo ya upalabhyate yo vā dharmaḥ sūcyate
children.translated_text: Why is that? For there is no <s>dharma</s> that is apprehended, nor any <s>dharma</s> that is indicated.

children.text: nāpi kaściddharmaṃ pravartayiṣyati
children.translated_text: Nor will anyone turn any <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ atyantānabhinirvṛttā hi bhagavan sarvadharmāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For all <s>dharmas</s>, Blessed One, are absolutely unaccomplished.

children.text: nāpi kaṃciddharmaṃ nivartayiṣyati
children.translated_text: Nor will anyone stop any <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ ādyanabhinirvṛttā hi bhagavan sarvadharmāḥ prakṛtiviviktatvātsarvadharmāṇām ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For all <s>dharmas</s>, Blessed One, are unaccomplished from the beginning, because all <s>dharmas</s> are naturally separate.' ||

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat evametatsubhūte evam etat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: na hi subhūte śūnyatā pravartate vā nivartate vā
children.translated_text: For, <s>Subhūti</s>, emptiness neither turns nor stops.

children.text: nāpi subhūte animittaṃ pravartate vā nivartate vā
children.translated_text: Nor, <s>Subhūti</s>, does signlessness turn or stop.

children.text: nāpi subhūte apraṇihitaṃ pravartate vā nivartate vā
children.translated_text: Nor, <s>Subhūti</s>, does wishlessness turn or stop.

children.text: yā subhūte evaṃ deśanā iyaṃ sā sarvadharmāṇāṃ deśanā
children.translated_text: That teaching which is thus, <s>Subhūti</s>, is the teaching of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: naiva ca kenaciddeśitā nāpi kenacicchrutā nāpi kenacitpratīcchitā nāpi kenacitsākṣātkṛtā nāpi kenacitsākṣātkriyate nāpi kenacit sākṣātkariṣyate
children.translated_text: And it has not been taught by anyone, nor heard by anyone, nor accepted by anyone, nor realized by anyone; nor is it realized by anyone, nor will it be realized by anyone.

children.text: nāpyanayā dharmadeśanayā kaścitparinirvṛto nāpi parinirvāsyati nāpi parinirvāti
children.translated_text: Nor by this teaching of <s>dharma</s> has anyone attained final nirvāṇa, nor will anyone attain it, nor does anyone attain it.

children.text: nāpyanayā dharmadeśanayā kaściddakṣiṇīyaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Nor by this teaching of <s>dharma</s> has anyone been made worthy of offerings.' ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat asatpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan ākāśasattāmupādāya
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'This, Blessed One, is a perfection of non-being, taking as its basis the reality of space.

children.text: asamasamatāpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection of equalness to the unequaled, taking as its basis the non-apprehension of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: viviktapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan atyantaśūnyatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection of separateness, taking as its basis ultimate emptiness.

children.text: anavamṛdyapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is an unassailable perfection, taking as its basis the non-apprehension of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: apadapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan anāmāśarīratāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a footingless perfection, taking as its basis a body that cannot be touched.

children.text: asvabhāvapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan anāgatimagatimupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection without own-being, taking as its basis neither coming nor going.

children.text: avacanapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāvikalpatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is an unspeakable perfection, taking as its basis the non-conceptuality of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: anāmapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan skandhānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a nameless perfection, taking as its basis the non-apprehension of the aggregates.

children.text: agamanapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāgamanatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a non-going perfection, taking as its basis the non-going of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: asaṃhāryapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāgrāhyatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is an inalienable perfection, taking as its basis the ungraspability of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: akṣayapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan akṣayadharmayogatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is an inexhaustible perfection, taking as its basis its connection with inexhaustible <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: anutpattipāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānabhinirvṛttitām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection of non-arising, taking as its basis the unaccomplishedness of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: akārakapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan kārakānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is an agentless perfection, taking as its basis the non-apprehension of an agent.

children.text: ajānakapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāṇāmanātmatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a knowerless perfection, taking as its basis the selflessness of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: asaṃkrāntipāramiteyaṃ bhagavan cyutyupapattyanupattitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection of non-transference, taking as its basis the non-attainment of death and rebirth.

children.text: avinayapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan pūrvāntāparāntapratyutpannārthānupalabdhitām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection without guidance, taking as its basis the non-apprehension of past, future, and present objects.

children.text: svapnapratiśrutkāpratibhāsamarīcimāyāpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan anutpādavijñāpanatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is a perfection like a dream, an echo, an appearance, a mirage, and an illusion, taking as its basis the making known of non-production.'

children.text: asaṃkleśapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan rāgadveṣamohāsvabhāvatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of non-defilement, based on the absence of own-being in passion, hatred, and delusion.

children.text: avyavadānapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan āśrayānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of non-purification, based on the nonapprehension of any support.

children.text: anupalepapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan ākāśānupalepatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of non-smearing, based on the unstained nature of space.

children.text: aprapañcapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmamananasamatikramatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection beyond conceptual elaboration, based on transcending all mental construction about <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: amananapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan aniñjanatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of non-mentation, based on unstirringness.

children.text: acalitapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan dharmadhātusthititāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of immovability, based on the abidingness of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>.

children.text: virāgapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāvitathatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of dispassion, based on the unfalsified nature of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: asamutthānapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmanirvikalpatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of non-arising, based on the absence of conceptual discrimination with regard to all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: śāntapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmanimittānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of peace, based on the nonapprehension of the signs of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: nirdoṣapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan guṇapāramitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the faultless perfection, based on the perfection of qualities.

children.text: niḥkleśapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan parikalpāsattāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection free from affliction, based on the nonexistence of imagined construction.

children.text: niḥsattvapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan bhūtakoṭitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection without beings, based on the limit of reality.

children.text: apramāṇapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmasamutthānāsamutthānatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the immeasurable perfection, based on the arising and non-arising of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: antadvayānanugamapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānabhiniveśanatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection that does not follow the two extremes, based on non-clinging to all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: asaṃbhinnapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāsaṃbhedanatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the undivided perfection, based on the indivisibility of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: aparāmṛṣṭapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhabhūmyaspṛhaṇatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the untouched perfection, based on having no longing for the grounds of all <s>śrāvakas</s> and <s>pratyekabuddhas</s>.

children.text: avikalpapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan vikalpasamatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the non-conceptual perfection, based on the equality of conceptual discrimination.

children.text: aprameyapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan apramāṇadharmatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the unmeasurable perfection, based on the immeasurable nature of <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: asaṅgapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāsaṅgatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the unattached perfection, based on the unattached nature of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: anityapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāsaṃskṛtatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the impermanent perfection, based on the unconditioned nature of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: duḥkhapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan ākāśasamadharmatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the painful perfection, based on the fact that <s>dharmas</s> are equal to space.

children.text: śūnyapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the empty perfection, based on the nonapprehension of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: anātmapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānabhiniveśanatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the selfless perfection, based on non-clinging to all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: alakṣaṇapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmānabhinirvṛttitām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the signless perfection, based on the non-production of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: sarvaśūnyatāpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan anantāparyantatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of all emptiness, based on endlessness and boundlessness.

children.text: smṛtyupasthānādibodhipakṣadharmapāramiteyaṃ bhagavaṃsteṣāmanupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the <s>bodhipakṣa dharmas</s> beginning with the establishments of mindfulness, based on their nonapprehension.

children.text: śūnyatānimittāpraṇihitapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan trivimokṣamukhānupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of emptiness, signlessness, and wishlessness, based on the nonapprehension of the three gates of liberation.

children.text: aṣṭavimokṣapāramiteyaṃ bhagavaṃsteṣāmanupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the eight liberations, based on their nonapprehension.

children.text: navānupūrvavihārapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan prathamadhyānādīnām anupalabdhitām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the nine successive abidings, based on the nonapprehension of the first meditation and the rest.

children.text: catuḥsatyapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan duḥkhādīnāmanupalabdhitāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the four truths, based on the nonapprehension of suffering and the others.

children.text: daśapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan dānādīnām anupalabdhitām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the ten perfections, based on the nonapprehension of giving and the others.

children.text: balapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan anavamṛdyatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of powers, based on their being uncrushable.

children.text: vaiśāradyapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan atyantānavalīnatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of confidences, based on utter fearlessness.

children.text: pratisaṃvitpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvajñatāsaṅgāpratighātitām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of analytic knowledges, based on unobstructedness and non-impediment in omniscience.

children.text: sarvabuddhadharmāveṇikapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan gaṇanāsamatikramatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of all the special qualities of the Buddhas, based on transcending enumeration.

children.text: tathāgatatathatāpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāvitathatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the <s>Tathāgata</s>'s suchness, based on the unfalsified nature of all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: svayaṃbhūpāramiteyaṃ bhagavan sarvadharmāsvabhāvatām upādāya
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the self-existent one, based on the absence of own-being in all <s>dharmas</s>.

children.text: sarvajñajñānapāramiteyaṃ bhagavan yaduta prajñāpāramitā sarvadharmasvabhāvasarvākāraparijñānatām upādāyeti ||
children.translated_text: This, Blessed One, is the perfection of the knowledge of the all-knowing one, namely <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, based on the complete knowledge, in all modes, of the own-being of all <s>dharmas</s>. ||

children.text: Chapter 10

atha khalu śakrasya devānāmindrasyaitadabhūt pūrvajinakṛtādhikārāste kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca bhaviṣyanti bahubuddhāvaropitakuśalamūlāḥ kalyāṇamitraparigṛhītāśca bhaviṣyanti yeṣāmiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā śrotrāvabhāsamapyāgamiṣyati
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, thought this: Those sons of good family and daughters of good family to whose range of hearing this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will come will have made resolutions under former conquerors; they will have planted roots of merit under many Buddhas and will have been embraced by good friends.

children.text: kaḥ punarvādo ya enāmevaṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti
children.translated_text: How much more so those who will learn, retain, recite, master, set forth, teach, instruct, proclaim, and study this very deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: udgṛhya dhārayitvā vācayitvā paryavāpya pravartya deśayitvopadiśyoddiśya svādhyāyya tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: Having learned it, retained it, recited it, mastered it, set it forth, taught it, instructed it, proclaimed it, and studied it, they will train for suchness, practice for suchness, and apply themselves in yoga for suchness.

children.text: na te avaramātrakeṇa kuśalamūlena samanvāgatā bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will not be endowed with only a small root of merit.

children.text: bahubuddhaparyupāsitāste kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: Those sons of good family and daughters of good family will have attended upon many Buddhas.

children.text: paripṛṣṭāḥ paripraśnīkṛtāśca te buddhā bhagavanto bhaviṣyanti kulaputraiḥ kuladuhitṛbhiścaināmeva prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Those Buddhas, Blessed Ones, will have been questioned and thoroughly questioned by those sons of good family and daughters of good family concerning this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: śrutā ceyaṃ paurvakāṇāmapi tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāmantikāt ya enāṃ prajñāpāramitāmetarhyapi śroṣyanti
children.translated_text: And this has been heard even from the presence of former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, perfectly awakened Buddhas, by those who will hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> even now.

children.text: śrutvā codgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: And having heard it, they will learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, and study it; they will train for suchness, practice for suchness, and apply themselves in yoga for suchness.

children.text: bahubuddhāvaropitakuśalamūlāste kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca veditavyāḥ ya etasyāmeva gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyām uddiśyamānāyāṃ svādhyāyyamānāyāṃ nāvaleṣyante na saṃleṣyante na viṣatsyanti na viṣādamāpatsyante na vipṛṣṭhīkariṣyanti mānasam na bhagnapṛṣṭhīkariṣyanti nottrasiṣyanti na saṃtrasiṣyanti na saṃtrāsamāpatsyante ||
children.translated_text: Those sons of good family and daughters of good family who, when this very deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, explained, recited, and studied, will not cower, will not shrink, will not sink down, will not fall into despondency, will not turn their minds away, will not become broken in spirit, will not be terrified, will not tremble, and will not fall into fear, are to be understood as having planted roots of wholesome merit under many Buddhas.

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputraḥ śakrasya devānāmindrasya imamevaṃrūpaṃ cetasaiva cetaḥparivitarkamājñāya bhagavantametadavocat yo bhagavan ihaivaṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyāṃ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā abhiśraddadhadavakalpayannadhimucya prasannacitto bodhāya cittamutpādya enāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyaty upadekṣyaty uddekṣyati svādhyāsyati tathatvāya śikṣiṣyate tathatvāya pratipatsyate tathatvāya yogamāpatsyate yathāvinivartanīyo bodhisattvo mahāsattvastathā sa dhārayitavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>, knowing by his own mind this very kind of thought in the mind of <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: Blessed One, here, when this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, taught, explained, and recited, if a son of good family or daughter of good family, trusting, accepting, resolving upon it, with a serene mind, and having produced the mind directed to awakening, will take up this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, explain it, proclaim it, study it, train for suchness, proceed toward suchness, and enter into practice for suchness, that person should be regarded as an irreversible <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ gambhīrā bhagavan iyaṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Why is that? Blessed One, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is deep.

children.text: na hi bhagavan parīttakuśalamūlenāparipṛcchakajātīyena aśrutvā buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ saṃmukhībhāvataḥ pūrvam acaritavatā ihaiveyamevaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā adhimoktuṃ śakyā
children.translated_text: For, Blessed One, one with only slight wholesome roots, of a sort that has not asked questions, who has not formerly practiced after hearing from Buddhas, Blessed Ones, in their presence, is not able to resolve upon this very deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> here.

children.text: ye punar anadhimucya enām anavabudhyamānāḥ pratikṣeptavyāṃ maṃsyante pūrvāntato'pi bhagavaṃstaiḥ kulaputraiḥ kuladuhitṛbhiśceyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā bhāṣyamāṇā pratikṣiptā
children.translated_text: But those who, without resolving upon it and without understanding it, will think that it should be rejected: from the past too, Blessed One, this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been rejected by those sons of good family and daughters of good family.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yathāpi nāma parīttatvātkuśalamūlānām
children.translated_text: Why is that? It is, as it were, because of the slightness of their wholesome roots.

children.text: na hi bhagavan acaritavadbhiḥ pūrvāntata iyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā śakyā adhimoktum
children.translated_text: For, Blessed One, this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> cannot be resolved upon by those who have not practiced from the past onward.

children.text: ye'pi ca pratikṣepsyanti enāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣyamāṇām te'pyevaṃ veditavyāḥ pūrvāntato'pyebhiriyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā bhāṣyamāṇā pratikṣiptā
children.translated_text: And those who will reject this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> as it is being spoken should likewise be understood as people by whom this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> was rejected in the past as well.

children.text: tathā hyeṣāmasyāṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ nāsti śraddhāḥ nāsti kṣāntirnāsti rucirnāsti chando nāsti vīryaṃ nāstyapramādo nāstyadhimuktiḥ na caibhiḥ pūrvaṃ buddhā bhagavanto buddhaśrāvakā vā paripṛṣṭāḥ na ca paripraśnīkṛtā iti ||
children.translated_text: For indeed, when this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, they have no faith, no acceptance, no liking, no aspiration, no energy, no heedfulness, and no confident resolve; and formerly they did not ask or question Buddhas, Blessed Ones, or disciples of the Buddha.

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindra āyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat gambhīrā ārya śāriputra prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: Noble <s>Śāriputra</s>, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is deep.

children.text: kimatrāścaryaṃ syādyadasyāṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ pūrvam acaritāvī bodhisattvo mahāsattvo nādhimucyeta atha khalu śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat namaskaromi bhagavan prajñāpāramitāyai
children.translated_text: What wonder would there be if, when this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being spoken, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who has not practiced before should not resolve upon it? Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: Blessed One, I bow down to <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: sarvajñajñānasya sa bhagavannamaskāraṃ karoti yaḥ prajñāpāramitāyai namaskāraṃ karoti
children.translated_text: Blessed One, whoever bows down to <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> bows down to the knowledge of all-knowingness.

children.text: bhagavānāha evameva kauśika evametat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: Just so, <s>Kauśika</s>; it is just so.

children.text: sarvajñajñānasya sa kauśika namaskāraṃ karoti yaḥ prajñāpāramitāyai namaskāraṃ karoti
children.translated_text: <s>Kauśika</s>, whoever bows down to <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> bows down to the knowledge of all-knowingness.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ atonirjātā hi kauśika buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ sarvajñatā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For from this, <s>Kauśika</s>, arises the all-knowingness of the Buddhas, the Blessed Ones.

children.text: sarvajñajñānanirjātā ca punaḥ prajñāpāramitā prabhāvyate
children.translated_text: And again, <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is made manifest as arising from the knowledge of all-knowingness.

children.text: evamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caritavyam
children.translated_text: Thus one should practice in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ sthātavyam
children.translated_text: Thus one should stand in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ pratipattavyam
