children.translated_text: Thus one should proceed in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ yogamāpattavyam ||
children.translated_text: Thus one should enter into discipline in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindro bhagavantametadavocat kathaṃ bhagavan prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ sthito bhavati kathaṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran prajñāpāramitāyāṃ yogamāpadyate evamukte bhagavān śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat sādhu sādhu kauśika
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the Blessed One: Blessed One, how does a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, while practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, stand in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? How, while practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, does he enter into discipline in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>? When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: Good, good, <s>Kauśika</s>.

children.text: sādhu khalu punastvaṃ kauśika yastvaṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhamenamarthaṃ paripraṣṭavyaṃ paripraśnīkartavyaṃ manyase
children.translated_text: It is good indeed, <s>Kauśika</s>, that you think this matter should be asked and questioned of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened Buddha.

children.text: idamapi te kauśika buddhānubhāvena pratibhānamutpannam
children.translated_text: This inspiration too, <s>Kauśika</s>, has arisen in you through the Buddha's power.

children.text: iha kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran rūpe na tiṣṭhati rūpamiti na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Here, <s>Kauśika</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, while practicing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, does not stand in form; he does not stand thinking, 'form.'

children.text: yataḥ kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattvo rūpe na tiṣṭhati rūpamiti na tiṣṭhati evaṃ rūpe yogamāpadyate
children.translated_text: Insofar as, <s>Kauśika</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> does not stand in form and does not stand thinking, 'form,' in that way he enters into discipline with respect to form.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ saṃskāreṣu
children.translated_text: Thus too with respect to feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñāne na tiṣṭhati vijñānamiti na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: He does not stand in consciousness; he does not stand thinking, 'consciousness.'

children.text: yataḥ kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattvo vijñāne na tiṣṭhati vijñānamiti na tiṣṭhati evaṃ vijñāne yogamāpadyate
children.translated_text: For, <s>Kauśika</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> does not stand in consciousness; he does not stand thinking, "consciousness." In this way he applies himself to consciousness.

children.text: rūpamiti kauśika na yojayati yataḥ kauśika rūpamiti na yojayati evaṃ rūpamiti na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: <s>Kauśika</s>, he does not connect with form as "form"; since, <s>Kauśika</s>, he does not connect with it as "form," in this way he does not stand in it as "form."

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānamiti kauśika na yojayati yataḥ kauśika vijñānamiti na yojayati evaṃ vijñānamiti na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: <s>Kauśika</s>, he does not connect with consciousness as "consciousness"; since, <s>Kauśika</s>, he does not connect with it as "consciousness," in this way he does not stand in it as "consciousness."

children.text: evaṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ sthito bhavati
children.translated_text: In this way he stands in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ yogamāpadyate ||
children.translated_text: In this way he enters into practice. ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat gambhīrā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Deep, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: duravagāhā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Hard to fathom, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: durudgrahā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Hard to grasp, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: apramāṇā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Immeasurable, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>."

children.text: bhagavānāha evametacchāriputra evametat
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: rūpaṃ gambhīramiti śāriputra na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not stand in form as "deep."

children.text: yataḥ śāriputra rūpaṃ gambhīramiti na tiṣṭhati evaṃ rūpe yogamāpadyate
children.translated_text: Since, <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not stand in form as "deep," in this way he applies himself to form.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ śāriputra gambhīramiti na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not stand in consciousness as "deep."

children.text: yataḥ śāriputra vijñānaṃ gambhīramiti na tiṣṭhati evaṃ vijñāne yogamāpadyate
children.translated_text: Since, <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not stand in consciousness as "deep," in this way he applies himself to consciousness.

children.text: rūpaṃ śāriputra gambhīramiti na yogamāpadyate
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not apply himself to form as "deep."

children.text: yataḥ śāriputra rūpaṃ gambhīramiti na yogamāpadyate evaṃ rūpaṃ gambhīramiti na tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Since, <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not apply himself to form as "deep," in this way he does not stand in form as "deep."

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too with feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ śāriputra gambhīramiti na yogamāpadyate
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not apply himself to consciousness as "deep."

children.text: yataḥ śāriputra vijñānaṃ gambhīramiti na yogamāpadyate evaṃ vijñānaṃ gambhīramiti na tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: Since, <s>Śāriputra</s>, he does not apply himself to consciousness as "deep," in this way he does not stand in consciousness as "deep." ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat gambhīrā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā avinivartanīyasya vyākṛtasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya purato bhāṣitavyā
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Deep, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>; it should be spoken before an irreversible <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who has received a prediction.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ sa hi bhagavan na kāṅkṣiṣyati na vicikitsiṣyati na dhandhāyiṣyati na vivadiṣyati ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, Blessed One, he will not be uncertain, will not doubt, will not be confused, and will not dispute." ||

children.text: atha khalu śakro devānāmindra āyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat sacetpunarārya śāriputra avyākṛtasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya purata iyaṃ prajñāpāramitā bhāṣyeta ko doṣo bhavet evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputraḥ śakraṃ devānāmindrametadavocat dūrataḥ sa kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattva āgato veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "But if, noble <s>Śāriputra</s>, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> were spoken before a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who has not received a prediction, what fault would there be?" When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods: "That <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>, should be understood as one who has come from afar.

children.text: cirayānasamprasthitaḥ paripakvakuśalamūlaḥ sa kauśika bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ yo'vyākṛta imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ lapsyate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya
children.translated_text: That <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>, should be understood as long set out on the vehicle and as one whose wholesome roots are mature, if, though unpredicted, he obtains this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, venerating, attending upon, and hearing.

children.text: śrutvā ca nottrasiṣyati na saṃtrasiṣyati na saṃtrāsamāpatsyate
children.translated_text: And, having heard it, he will not be terrified, will not be frightened, and will not fall into fear.

children.text: na cedānīmasau cireṇa vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsyate'nuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheḥ
children.translated_text: And now it will not be long before he receives the prediction of unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: āsannaṃ tasya vyākaraṇaṃ veditavyam
children.translated_text: His prediction should be understood as near.

children.text: sa bodhisattvo mahāsattvo naikaṃ vā dvau vā trīn vā tathāgatānarhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhānatikramiṣyati tato vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsyate'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau
children.translated_text: That <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> will not pass beyond one, or two, or three <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas; after that he will receive the prediction of unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: api tu tān ārāgayiṣyati ārāgayitvā tāṃstathāgatānarhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhānna virāgayiṣyati
children.translated_text: Rather, he will please those <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, and having pleased them, he will not alienate them.

children.text: tathāgatadarśanaṃ ca vyākaraṇenāvandhyaṃ kariṣyati tathāgatadarśanācca tato vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsyate'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau
children.translated_text: And through a prediction he will make the sight of a <s>Tathāgata</s> not fruitless; and from the sight of a <s>Tathāgata</s> he will then receive the prediction of unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: yāvacca vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsyate'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau tāvadavandhyaṃ kariṣyati tathāgatadarśanavandanaparyupāsanopasthānaṃ yāvannānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbuddha iti ||
children.translated_text: And until he receives the prediction of unsurpassed perfect awakening, up to the point when he fully awakens to unsurpassed perfect awakening, he will make the seeing, venerating, attending upon, and serving of <s>Tathāgatas</s> not fruitless." ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat dūrataḥ sa bhagavan bodhisattvo mahāsattva āgato bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, that <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> will have come from afar.

children.text: cirayānasamprasthitaḥ
children.translated_text: He will have long set out on the vehicle.

children.text: paripakvakuśalamūlo hi bhagavan sa bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ ya imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ lapsyate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya
children.translated_text: For, Blessed One, that <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> should be understood as one whose wholesome roots are mature, if he obtains this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, venerating, attending upon, and hearing.

children.text: kaḥ punarvādo'tra yaḥ śrutvā codgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati ||
children.translated_text: How much more so one who, having heard it, will learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, and study it." ||

children.text: atha khalu bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat evametacchāriputra evametat
children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: dūrataḥ sa śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattva āgato veditavyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s>, that <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> should be understood as one who has come from afar.

children.text: cirayānasamprasthitaḥ
children.translated_text: He has long set out on the vehicle.

children.text: paripakvakuśalamūlo hi sa śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhaviṣyati ya imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ lapsyate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya
children.translated_text: For, <s>Śāriputra</s>, that <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> will be one whose wholesome roots are mature, if he obtains this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, venerating, attending upon, and hearing.

children.text: kaḥ punarvādo'tra yaḥ śrutvā codgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati ||
children.translated_text: How much more so one who, having heard it, will learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, and study it." ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat pratibhāti me bhagavan pratibhāti me sugata aupamyodāharaṇam
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'It occurs to me, Blessed One; it occurs to me, <s>Sugata</s>, to give an illustrative simile.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan yo'yaṃ bodhisattvayānikaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā svapnāntaragato'pi bodhimaṇḍe niṣīdet veditavyametadbhagavan ayaṃ bodhisattvo mahāsattva āsanno'nuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodher abhisaṃbodhāyeti
children.translated_text: Just as, Blessed One, if a son of good family or daughter of good family belonging to the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle were, even while in a dream, to sit at the seat of awakening, it should be known, Blessed One, that this <s>bodhisattva</s>, this <s>mahāsattva</s>, is near to fully awakening to unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: evameva bhagavan yaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ lapsyate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya kaḥ punarvādaḥ śrutvā codgrahītuṃ dhārayituṃ vācayituṃ paryavāptuṃ pravartayituṃ deśayituṃ upadeṣṭuṃ uddeṣṭuṃ svādhyāpanāya
children.translated_text: So too, Blessed One, if a son of good family or daughter of good family obtains this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, honoring, attending upon, and hearing, how much more if, after hearing it, one takes it up, retains it, recites it, masters it, sets it forth, teaches it, instructs it, proclaims it, and studies it.

children.text: veditavyametadbhagavan dūrato'yaṃ bodhisattvayānikaḥ pudgala āgataścirayānasamprasthitaḥ
children.translated_text: It should be known, Blessed One, that this person belonging to the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle has come from afar and has long set out upon the vehicle.

children.text: āsanno'yaṃ bodhisattvayānikaḥ pudgalo vyākaraṇasya
children.translated_text: This person belonging to the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle is near to receiving the prediction.

children.text: vyākariṣyantyenaṃ buddhā bhagavanto bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvamanuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodherabhisaṃbodhāyeti
children.translated_text: The buddhas, the blessed ones, will predict of this <s>bodhisattva</s>, this <s>mahāsattva</s>, that he will fully awaken to unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: cirayānasamprasthitaḥ paripakvakuśalamūlo hi sa bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ yasyeyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā upapatsyate'ntaśaḥ śravaṇāyāpi
children.translated_text: For that <s>bodhisattva</s>, that <s>mahāsattva</s>, to whom this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> becomes available even merely for hearing, should be known to have long set out upon the vehicle and to have matured roots of merit.

children.text: kaḥ punarvādo'tra bhagavan yaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā enāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati deśayiṣyatyupadekṣyatyuddekṣyati svādhyāsyati
children.translated_text: How much more, Blessed One, a son of good family or daughter of good family who will take up, retain, recite, master, set forth, teach, instruct, proclaim, and study this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ bhūyastvena hi bhagavan dharmavyasanasaṃvartanīyaiḥ sattvāḥ karmopacayairavihitāḥ teṣāṃ bhūyastvena asyāṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ cittāni pratikūlāni bhaviṣyanti cittāni parivellayiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, Blessed One, beings for the most part are disposed by accumulations of karma that lead to the ruin of the <s>dharma</s>; for the most part their minds will be hostile toward this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, and their minds will turn away.

children.text: na hyanupacitakuśalamūlāḥ sattvā asyāṃ bhūyastvena bhūtakoṭyāṃ praskandanti prasīdanti
children.translated_text: For beings whose roots of merit have not been accumulated do not, for the most part, enter into this <s>bhūtakoṭi</s> (limit of reality) or become clear and trusting in it.

children.text: upacitakuśalamūlāḥ khalu punaste bhagavan sūpacitakuśalamūlāḥ kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca veditavyāḥ yeṣāmasyāṃ bhūtakoṭyāṃ cittaṃ praskandati prasīdati
children.translated_text: But those sons of good family and daughters of good family, Blessed One, whose minds enter into this <s>bhūtakoṭi</s> and become clear and trusting in it should be known to have accumulated roots of merit, indeed to have well accumulated roots of merit.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan puruṣo yojanaśatikādaṭavīkāntārād dviyojanaśatikādvā triyojanaśatikādvā caturyojanaśatikādvā pañcayojanaśatikādvā daśayojanaśatikādvā aṭavīkāntārānniṣkrāmet
children.translated_text: Just as, Blessed One, a man might emerge from a wilderness forest of a hundred <s>yojanas</s>, or of two hundred, three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, or a thousand <s>yojanas</s>.

children.text: sa niṣkramya paśyetpūrvanimittāni gopālakān vā paśupālakān vā sīmā vā ārāmasaṃpado vā vanasaṃpado vā tato'nyāpi vā nimittāni yairnimittairgrāmo vā nagaraṃ vā nigamo vā sūcyeta
children.translated_text: Having emerged, he might see preliminary signs: cowherds or herdsmen, boundaries, well-kept parks or groves, or still other signs by which a village, a city, or a market-town would be indicated.

children.text: tasya tāni pūrvanimittāni dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhavati yathemāni pūrvanimittāni dṛśyante tathā āsanno me grāmo vā nagaraṃ vā nigamo vā iti
children.translated_text: On seeing those preliminary signs, it would occur to him, 'Since these preliminary signs are visible, a village, a city, or a market-town is near me.'

children.text: sa āśvāsaprāpto bhavati
children.translated_text: He becomes reassured.

children.text: nāsya bhūyaścoramanasikāro bhavati
children.translated_text: He no longer has any further thought of robbers.

children.text: evameva bhagavan yasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasyeyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā upavartate veditavyaṃ tena bhagavan abhyāsanno'smyanuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheḥ nacireṇa vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsye'nuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheriti
children.translated_text: So too, Blessed One, for the <s>bodhisattva</s>, the <s>mahāsattva</s>, to whom this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> comes near, it should be known by him, Blessed One, 'I am very near unsurpassed perfect awakening; before long I shall obtain the prediction to unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

children.text: nāpi tenottrasitavyaṃ na saṃtrasitavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ śrāvakabhūmervā pratyekabuddhabhūmervā
children.translated_text: Nor should he be terrified, alarmed, or afraid of the ground of a <s>śrāvaka</s> or the ground of a <s>pratyekabuddha</s>.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi asyemāni pūrvanimittāni saṃdṛśyante yadutemāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ labhate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya
children.translated_text: Why is that? For these preliminary signs are seen by him, namely, that he obtains this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, honoring, attending upon, and hearing.

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat evametacchāriputra evametat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: 'So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: pratibhātu te śāriputra punarapyetatsthānam yathāpi nāmaitadbuddhānubhāvena vyāharasi vyāhariṣyasi ca ||
children.translated_text: May this topic occur to you again, <s>Śāriputra</s>, since, just as you speak by the Buddha's power, so you will speak.' ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan iha kaścideva puruṣo mahāsamudraṃ draṣṭukāmo bhavet
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Just as, Blessed One, here some man might wish to see the great ocean.

children.text: sa gacchenmahāsamudraṃ darśanāya
children.translated_text: He would go in order to see the great ocean.

children.text: yathā yathā ca sa gacchenmahāsamudraṃ darśanāya tathā tathā sacetpaśyetstambaṃ vā stambanimittaṃ vā parvataṃ vā parvatanimittaṃ vā tenaivaṃ veditavyaṃ dūre tāvadito mahāsamudra iti
children.translated_text: And as he went to see the great ocean, if he saw a tree stump or a sign of a tree stump, a mountain or a sign of a mountain, then by that he should know, 'The great ocean is still far from here.'

children.text: sacenna bhūyaḥ paśyetstambaṃ vā stambanimittaṃ vā parvataṃ vā parvatanimittaṃ vā tenaivaṃ veditavyam abhyāsanna ito mahāsamudra iti
children.translated_text: But if he no longer saw a tree stump or a sign of a tree stump, a mountain or a sign of a mountain, then by that he should know, 'The great ocean is very near from here.'

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ anupūrvanimno hi mahāsamudraḥ na mahāsamudrasyābhyantare kaścitstambo vā stambanimittaṃ vā parvato vā parvatanimittaṃ veti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For the great ocean slopes down gradually; within the great ocean there is no tree stump or sign of a tree stump, no mountain or sign of a mountain.'

children.text: kiṃcāpi sa na mahāsamudraṃ sākṣātpaśyati cakṣuṣā atha ca punaḥ sa niṣṭhāṃ gacchati abhyāsanno'smi mahāsamudrasya neto bhūyo dūre mahāsamudra iti
children.translated_text: And although he does not see the great ocean directly with his eye, nevertheless he comes to the conclusion: 'I am near the great ocean; from here the great ocean is no longer far away.'

children.text: evameva bhagavan bodhisattvena mahāsattvenemāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śṛṇvatā veditavyam kiṃcāpyahaṃ taistathāgatairarhadbhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhairna saṃmukhaṃ vyākṛtaḥ atha ca punarabhyāsanno'smyanuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodhervyākaraṇasya
children.translated_text: Just so, Blessed One, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>, hearing this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, should understand: 'Although I have not been predicted face to face by those <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened ones, nevertheless I am near the prophecy of unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hyenāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ labhate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāyeti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For he obtains this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, honoring, attending upon, and hearing.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan vasante pratyupasthite śīrṇaparṇapalāśeṣu nānāvṛkṣeṣu nānāpallavāḥ prādurbhavanti
children.translated_text: Just as, Blessed One, when spring has arrived, various shoots appear on various trees whose leaves and foliage have fallen.

children.text: pallaveṣu prādurbhūteṣvāttamanaskā bhavanti jāmbūdvīpakā manuṣyāḥ tāni pūrvanimittāni vaneṣu dṛṣṭvā nacirādvanapuṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca prādurbhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: When the shoots have appeared, the people of <s>Jambūdvīpa</s> become delighted. Seeing those preliminary signs in the forests, they know that before long forest flowers and fruits will appear.

children.text: tatkasya hetos tathā hi imāni pūrvanimittāni stambeṣu dṛśyanta iti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For these preliminary signs are seen on the trunks.

children.text: evameva bhagavan yadā bodhisattvo mahāsattvo labhate imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya upavartate tasyeyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Just so, Blessed One, when a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>, obtains this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> for seeing, honoring, attending upon, and hearing, then this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> approaches him.

children.text: tadā paripakvakuśalaḥ sa bodhisattvo mahāsattvo veditavyaḥ tenaiva pūrvakeṇa kuśalamūlenopanāmiteyaṃ tasmai gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Then that <s>bodhisattva</s>, that <s>mahāsattva</s>, should be known to have wholesome qualities matured; by that former root of merit this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> has been brought near to him.

children.text: tatra yā devatāḥ pūrvabuddhadarśinyaḥ tāḥ pramuditā bhavanti prītisaumanasyajātāḥ paurvakāṇāmapi bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāmimānyeva pūrvanimittānyabhūvannanuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodhervyākaraṇāya
children.translated_text: There the deities who have seen former Buddhas become delighted, filled with joy and gladness: 'For former <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, these very preliminary signs also occurred for the prophecy of unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

children.text: nacireṇa batāyaṃ bodhisattvo mahāsattvo vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsyate'nuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheriti
children.translated_text: 'Before long indeed this <s>bodhisattva</s>, this <s>mahāsattva</s>, will receive the prophecy of unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan strī gurviṇī gurugarbhā
children.translated_text: Just as, Blessed One, a woman is pregnant, heavy with child.

children.text: tasyā yadā kāyo veṣṭate adhimātraṃ vā kāyaklamatho jāyate na ca sā caṃkramaṇaśīlā bhavati
children.translated_text: When her body is distressed, or excessive bodily weariness arises, and she is not inclined to walk about,

children.text: alpāhārā ca bhavati
children.translated_text: and she eats little,

children.text: alpastyānamiddhā ca bhavati
children.translated_text: and she has little sluggishness and drowsiness,

children.text: alpabhāṣyā ca bhavati
children.translated_text: and she speaks little,

children.text: alpasthāmā ca bhavati
children.translated_text: and she has little strength,

children.text: vedanābahulā ca bhavati
children.translated_text: and she has many pains,

children.text: krandantī ca bahulaṃ viharati
children.translated_text: and she often lives crying,

children.text: na ca saṃvāsaśīlā bhavati
children.translated_text: and she is not inclined to sexual intercourse,

children.text: paurvakeṇāyoniśo manasikāreṇāsevitena niṣevitena bhāvitena bahulīkṛtena imāmevaṃrūpāṃ kāyena vedanāṃ pratyanubhavāmīti tadā veditavyamidaṃ bhagavan yathāsyāḥ pūrvanimittāni saṃdṛśyante tathā nacireṇa bateyaṃ strī prasoṣyate iti
children.translated_text: thinking, 'Because of previous unwise attention that was cultivated, practiced, developed, and made much of, I am experiencing this sort of bodily feeling,' then, Blessed One, this should be known: just as these preliminary signs are seen in her, so before long this woman will give birth.

children.text: evameva bhagavan yadā bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasyeyaṃ gambhīrā prajñāpāramitā upavartate darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya śravaṇāya śṛṇvataścaināṃ ramate cittamasyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyām arthikatayā cotpadyate tadā veditavyamidaṃ bhagavan nacireṇa batāyaṃ bodhisattvo mahāsattvo vyākaraṇaṃ pratilapsyate'nuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheriti ||
children.translated_text: Just so, Blessed One, when this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> approaches a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>, for seeing, honoring, attending upon, and hearing, and as he hears it his mind delights in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and longing for it arises, then, Blessed One, this should be known: before long indeed this <s>bodhisattva</s>, this <s>mahāsattva</s>, will receive the prophecy of unsurpassed perfect awakening. ||

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat sādhu sādhu śāriputra
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: 'Good, good, <s>Śāriputra</s>.'

children.text: idamapi te śāriputra buddhānubhāvena pratibhāti
children.translated_text: 'This too, <s>Śāriputra</s>, has occurred to you through the power of the Buddhas.'

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvatsuparigṛhītāśca suparīttāśca suparīnditāśca ime bodhisattvā mahāsattvāstathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'It is wonderful, Blessed One, how well taken hold of, well protected, and well commended these <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, are by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened one.'

children.text: bhagavānāha tathā hi te subhūte bodhisattvā mahāsattvā bahujanahitāya pratipannā bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāyai mahato janakāyasyārthāya hitāya sukhāya devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>. For those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, have set out for the welfare of many people, for the happiness of many people, out of compassion for the world, for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of the great body of people, of gods and human beings.'

children.text: anukampakā anukampāmupādāya anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃboddhukāmāḥ
children.translated_text: 'They are compassionate, and because of compassion they wish to fully awaken to unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

children.text: anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimabhisaṃbudhyānuttaraṃ dharmaṃ deśayitukāmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'Having fully awakened to unsurpassed perfect awakening, they wish to teach the unsurpassed <s>dharma</s>.' ||

children.text: subhūtirāha iha bhagavan bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya prajñāpāramitāyāṃ carataḥ kathaṃ prajñāpāramitābhāvanā paripūriṃ gacchati bhagavānāha yadi subhūte bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caran na rūpasya vṛddhiṃ samanupaśyati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Here, Blessed One, for a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>, who courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, how does the cultivation of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> go to completion?' The Blessed One said: 'If, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s>, a <s>mahāsattva</s>, coursing in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> without seeing an increase of form,'

children.text: evaṃ na vedanāyā na saṃjñāyā na saṃskārāṇām
children.translated_text: 'so too without seeing an increase of feeling, perception, or formations,'

children.text: na vijñānasya vṛddhiṃ samanupaśyati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: 'and without seeing an increase of consciousness, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: na rūpasya parihāṇiṃ samanupaśyati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: 'Without seeing a decrease of form, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: evaṃ na vedanāyā na saṃjñāyā na saṃskārāṇām
children.translated_text: 'So too without seeing a decrease of feeling, perception, or formations,'

children.text: na vijñānasya parihāṇiṃ samanupaśyati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: 'and without seeing a decrease of consciousness, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: dharmaṃ na samanupaśyati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: 'Without seeing any <s>dharma</s>, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: adharmamapi na samanupaśyati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: 'Without seeing even non-<s>dharma</s>, he courses in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.'

children.text: evamasya prajñāpāramitābhāvanā paripūriṃ gacchati ||
children.translated_text: Thus his cultivation of <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> goes to completion. ||

children.text: subhūtirāha acintyamidaṃ bhagavan deśyate
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: "Blessed One, what is being taught is inconceivable."

children.text: bhagavānāha rūpaṃ hi subhūte acintyam
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "For form, <s>Subhūti</s>, is inconceivable.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling, perception, and formations.

children.text: vijñānaṃ hi subhūte acintyam
children.translated_text: Consciousness, <s>Subhūti</s>, is indeed inconceivable.

children.text: rūpamacintyamityapi subhūte na saṃjānīte carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, he does not perceive even that form is inconceivable; he practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ vedanāsaṃskārāḥ
children.translated_text: So too feeling and formations.

children.text: vijñānamacintyamityapi subhūte na saṃjānīte carati prajñāpāramitāyām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, he does not perceive even that consciousness is inconceivable; he practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>. ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat ko'tra bhagavan adhimokṣayiṣyati evaṃ gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyām bhagavānāha yaḥ śāriputra caritāvī bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhaviṣyati prajñāpāramitāyām so'tra prajñāpāramitāyāmadhimokṣayiṣyati
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, who here will believe in such a deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>?" The Blessed One said: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who has practiced in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will believe in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: āyuṣmān śāriputra āha kathaṃ bhagavan caritāvī bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhaviṣyati kathaṃ caritāvīti nāmadheyaṃ labhate bhagavānāha iha śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo balāni na kalpayati vaiśāradyāni na kalpayati buddhadharmānapi na kalpayati sarvajñatāmapi na kalpayati
children.translated_text: The venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said: "Blessed One, how will a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> be one who has practiced? How does he receive the designation 'one who has practiced'?" The Blessed One said: "Here, <s>Śāriputra</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> does not construct the powers, does not construct the fearlessnesses, does not construct even the qualities of a Buddha, and does not construct even omniscience.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ balāni hi śāriputra acintyāni vaiśāradyānyapyacintyāni buddhadharmā apyacintyāḥ sarvajñatāpyacintyā sarvadharmā apyacintyāḥ
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Śāriputra</s>, the powers are inconceivable, the fearlessnesses too are inconceivable, the qualities of a Buddha too are inconceivable, omniscience too is inconceivable, and all dharmas too are inconceivable.

children.text: evaṃ caritāvī śāriputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvo na kvaciccarati carati prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: In this way, <s>Śāriputra</s>, a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who has practiced does not practice anywhere; he practices in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: evaṃ sa caritāvītyucyate caritāvīti nāmadheyaṃ labhate ||
children.translated_text: Thus he is called one who has practiced; he receives the designation 'one who has practiced.'" ||

children.text: atha khalu āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat gambhīrā bhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Deep, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: ratnarāśirbhagavan prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: A heap of jewels, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: śuddharāśirbhagavan prajñāpāramitā ākāśaśuddhatāmupādāya
children.translated_text: A heap of purity, Blessed One, is <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, because of the purity of space.

children.text: āścaryaṃ bhagavan syādyadenāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgṛhṇatāṃ dhārayatāṃ vācayatāṃ paryavāpnuvatāṃ pravartayatāṃ deśayatāmupadiśatāmuddiśatāṃ svādhyāyatāṃ likhatāṃ ca kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca bahavo'ntarāyā utpadyeran
children.translated_text: It would be a wonder, Blessed One, if many obstacles did not arise for sons of good family and daughters of good family who take up this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it."

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat evametatsubhūte evametat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: "So it is, <s>Subhūti</s>; so it is.

children.text: bahavaḥ subhūte antarāyā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgṛhṇatāṃ dhārayatāṃ vācayatāṃ paryavāpnuvatāṃ pravartayatāṃ deśayatāmupadiśatāmuddiśatāṃ svādhyāyatāṃ likhatāṃ ca kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, many obstacles will arise for sons of good family and daughters of good family who take up this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi subhūte imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgṛhṇatāṃ dhārayatāṃ vācayatāṃ paryavāpnuvatāṃ pravartayatāṃ deśayatāmupadiśatāmuddiśatāṃ svādhyāyatāṃ likhatāṃ ca kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca māraḥ pāpīyānautsukyamāpatsyate'ntarāyaṃ kartum
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>Māra Pāpīyān</s> will become eager to create an obstacle for sons of good family and daughters of good family who take up this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it.

children.text: tatra śīghraṃ likhatā sacenmāsena vā māsadvayena vā māsatrayeṇa vā likhyeta likhitavyaiva bhavet
children.translated_text: In that matter, if one is writing quickly, if it can be written in one month, or in two months, or in three months, it should indeed be written.

children.text: sacetsaṃvatsareṇa tato vāpareṇa likhitā bhavet tathāpi likhitavyaiva khalu punaḥ subhūte bhavati tena kulaputreṇa kuladuhitrā vā iyaṃ prajñāpāramitā
children.translated_text: If it is written in a year or even later than that, then even so, <s>Subhūti</s>, this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> should indeed be written by that son of good family or daughter of good family.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ evaṃ hyetatsubhūte bhavati yanmahāratnānāṃ bahavo'ntarāyā utpadyante ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? For so it is, <s>Subhūti</s>: many obstacles arise for great jewels." ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat iha bhagavan prajñāpāramitāyām udgṛhyamāṇāyāṃ dhāryamāṇāyāṃ vācyamānāyāṃ paryavāpyamānāyāṃ pravartyamānāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyām uddiśyamānāyāṃ svādhyāyyamānāyāṃ likhyamānāyāṃ ca māraḥ pāpīyān bahuprakāramautsukyamāpatsyate antarāyakarmaṇa udyogaṃ ca kariṣyati
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Here, Blessed One, while the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being taken up, retained, recited, mastered, set forth, taught, instructed, proclaimed, studied, and written, <s>Māra Pāpīyān</s> will become eager in many ways and will make an effort to perform acts of obstruction."

children.text: bhagavānāha kiṃcāpi subhūte māraḥ pāpīyānudyogamāpatsyate antarāyakarmaṇaḥ asyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyām udgṛhyamāṇāyāṃ dhāryamāṇāyāṃ vācyamānāyāṃ paryavāpyamānāyāṃ pravartyamānāyāṃ deśyamānāyām upadiśyamānāyām uddiśyamānāyāṃ svādhyāyyamānāyāṃ likhyamānāyāṃ ca atha ca punarna prasahiṣyate'cchidrasamādānasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasyāntarāyaṃ kartum ||
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: "Although, <s>Subhūti</s>, <s>Māra Pāpīyān</s> will make an effort at acts of obstruction while this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being taken up, retained, recited, mastered, set forth, taught, instructed, proclaimed, studied, and written, nevertheless he will not be able to create an obstacle for a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> whose undertaking is without a break." ||

children.text: atha khalvāyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat yadā bhagavan imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgṛhṇatāṃ dhārayatāṃ vācayatāṃ paryavāpnuvatāṃ pravartayatāṃ deśayatāmupadiśatāmuddiśatāṃ svādhyāyatāṃ likhatāṃ ca kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca māraḥ pāpīyānautsukyamāpatsyate antarāyakaraṇāya tadā kathametarhi bhagavan kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca kasya cānubhāvena bhagavaṃste kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat buddhānāṃ śāriputra bhagavatāṃ tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāmanubhāvena te kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, when <s>Māra Pāpīyān</s> becomes eager to create an obstacle for the sons and daughters of good family who learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it, then how now, Blessed One, will those sons and daughters of good family learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it? And by whose power, Blessed One, will those sons and daughters of good family learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it?" When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "<s>Śāriputra</s>, by the power of the blessed Buddhas, the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened Buddhas, those sons and daughters of good family will learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it; they will train for suchness, proceed toward suchness, and apply themselves to suchness.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ eṣā hi śāriputra dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā ye te'prameyeṣvasaṃkhyeyeṣu lokadhātuṣu buddhā bhagavantastiṣṭhanti dhriyante yāpayanti te imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ samanvāhariṣyanti parigrahīṣyanti bhāṣyamāṇāmudgṛhyamāṇāṃ dhāryamāṇāṃ vācyamānāṃ paryavāpyamānāṃ pravartyamānāṃ deśyamānām upadiśyamānām uddiśyamānāṃ svādhyāyyamānāṃ likhyamānāṃ ca
children.translated_text: Why is that? For this, <s>Śāriputra</s>, is the <s>dharmatā</s> (nature) of dharmas: those blessed Buddhas who remain, abide, and sustain themselves in immeasurable, incalculable world systems will attend to this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and take it under their protection as it is being explained, learned, retained, recited, mastered, set forth, taught, instructed, proclaimed, studied, and written.

children.text: ye caināṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraścodgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti ca tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante tāṃśca te buddhā bhagavantaḥ samanvāhariṣyanti parigrahīṣyanti ca
children.translated_text: And those sons and daughters of good family who will learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, and study it, and who will train for suchness, proceed toward suchness, and apply themselves to suchness, those blessed Buddhas will attend to them and take them under their protection.

children.text: na hi śāriputra buddhasamanvāhṛtānāṃ buddhaparigṛhītānāṃ ca kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca śakyamantarāyaṃ kartum ||
children.translated_text: For, <s>Śāriputra</s>, it is not possible to create an obstacle for sons and daughters of good family who have been attended to by the Buddhas and taken under the Buddhas' protection. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat ye'pi te bhagavan bodhisattvā mahāsattvā imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante sarve te bhagavan buddhānubhāvena buddhādhiṣṭhānena buddhaparigraheṇa ca imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca tathatvāya ca śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante evaṃ ca saṃpādayiṣyanti ||
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: "Blessed One, those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> too who will hear this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it, and who will train for suchness, proceed toward suchness, and apply themselves to suchness, all of them, Blessed One, by the Buddha's power, by the Buddha's sustaining presence, and by the Buddha's protection, will hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it; and they will train for suchness, proceed toward suchness, apply themselves to suchness, and so bring it to accomplishment." ||

children.text: evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat evametacchāriputra evametat
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: "So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: sarve te śāriputra bodhisattvā mahāsattvā buddhānubhāvena buddhādhiṣṭhānena buddhaparigraheṇa ca imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante
children.translated_text: All those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s>, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the Buddha's power, by the Buddha's sustaining presence, and by the Buddha's protection, will hear this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, and write it; they will train for suchness, proceed toward suchness, and apply themselves to suchness.

children.text: jñātāste śāriputra tathāgatena
children.translated_text: They are known, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: adhiṣṭhitāste śāriputra tathāgatena
children.translated_text: They are sustained, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭāste śāriputra tathāgatena
children.translated_text: They are seen, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: vyavalokitāste śāriputra tathāgatena buddhacakṣuṣā
children.translated_text: They are beheld, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s> with the Buddha-eye.

children.text: ye te bodhisattvā mahāsattvā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca tathatvāya ca śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante śrutvodgṛhya dhārayitvā vācayitvā paryavāpya pravartya deśayitvopadiśyoddiśya svādhyāyya likhitvā tathatvāya śikṣamāṇāstathatvāya pratipadyamānāstathatvāya yogamāpadyamānā āsannībhaviṣyantyanuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheḥ tathatvāya sthāsyantyanuttarāyai samyaksaṃbodhaye
children.translated_text: Those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> who will hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it in motion, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, and write it, and who will train for suchness, practice for suchness, and apply themselves to suchness, having heard, learned, retained, recited, mastered, set forth, taught, instructed, proclaimed, studied, and written it, while training for suchness, practicing for suchness, and applying themselves to suchness, will draw near to unsurpassed perfect awakening; they will stand in suchness for unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: ye'pi śāriputra enāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ likhitvā dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti na ca tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante na ca tathatvāya pratipatsyante na ca tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante te na tathatvāya śikṣamāṇā na tathatvāya pratipadyamānā na tathatvāya yogamāpadyamānā na tathatāyāṃ sthāsyantyanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau te'pi śāriputra tathāgatena jñātāḥ
children.translated_text: And those too, <s>Śāriputra</s>, who, after writing this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, will retain it, recite it, master it, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, and write it, but will not train for suchness, will not practice for suchness, and will not apply themselves to suchness: since they do not train for suchness, do not practice for suchness, and do not apply themselves to suchness, they will not stand in suchness, in unsurpassed perfect awakening. Yet they too, <s>Śāriputra</s>, are known by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: te'pi tathāgatenādhiṣṭhitāḥ
children.translated_text: They too are sustained by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: te'pi tathāgatena dṛṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: They too are seen by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: te'pi tathāgatena vyavalokitā buddhacakṣuṣā
children.translated_text: They too are watched over by the <s>Tathāgata</s> with the Buddha-eye.

children.text: teṣāmapi śāriputra mahārthiko mahānuśaṃso mahāphalo mahāvipākaśca sa pariśramaḥ parispandaśca bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: For them too, <s>Śāriputra</s>, that toil and exertion will be of great worth, with great benefit, great fruit, and great result.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi prajñāpāramitā paramārthopasaṃhitā sarvadharmāṇāṃ yathābhūtaprativedhāya pratyupasthitā sarvasattvānām
children.translated_text: Why is that? For the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, being connected with the highest meaning, is present for all beings for the realization of all dharmas as they really are.

children.text: ime khalu punaḥ śāriputra ṣaṭpāramitāpratisaṃyuktāḥ sūtrāntāstathāgatasyātyayena dakṣiṇāpathe pracariṣyanti dakṣiṇāpathātpunareva vartanyāṃ pracariṣyanti vartanyāḥ punaruttarapathe pracariṣyanti
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Śāriputra</s>, these sūtras connected with the six perfections will circulate in the southern region after the passing of the <s>Tathāgata</s>; from the southern region they will again circulate in Vartanī, and from Vartanī they will circulate in the northern region.

children.text: navamaṇḍaprāpte dharmavinaye saddharmasyāntardhānakālasamaye samanvāhṛtāste śāriputra tathāgatena kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca
children.translated_text: When the Dharma and Vinaya have reached their ninth circle, at the time when the true Dharma is disappearing, those sons and daughters of good family, <s>Śāriputra</s>, have been attended to by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: tasmin kāle ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti antaśo likhitvā pustakagatāmapi kṛtvā dhārayiṣyanti jñātāste śāriputra tathāgatena
children.translated_text: At that time, those who will learn this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it in motion, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, and at least, after writing it and making it into a book, will preserve it, are known, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: adhiṣṭhitāste śāriputra tathāgatena
children.translated_text: They are sustained, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭāste śāriputra tathāgatena
children.translated_text: They are seen, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

children.text: vyavalokitāste śāriputra tathāgatena buddhacakṣuṣā ||
children.translated_text: They are watched over, <s>Śāriputra</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s> with the Buddha-eye. ||

children.text: śāriputra āha iyamapi bhagavan prajñāpāramitā evaṃ gambhīrā paścime kāle paścime samaye vaistārikī bhaviṣyatyuttarasyāṃ diśi uttare digbhāge bhagavānāha ye tatra śāriputra uttarasyāṃ diśyuttare digbhāge imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śrutvā atra prajñāpāramitāyāṃ yogamāpatsyante te vaistārikīṃ kariṣyati
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said: Blessed One, will this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, so deep as it is, become widespread in the later age, in the later time, in the northern direction, in the northern quarter? The Blessed One said: <s>Śāriputra</s>, those there in the northern direction, in the northern quarter, who, after hearing this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, will apply themselves here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, will make it widespread.

children.text: cirayānasamprasthitāste śāriputra bodhisattvā mahāsattvā veditavyāḥ ya imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti likhiṣyanti udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyantyupadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante ||
children.translated_text: Those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s>, <s>Śāriputra</s>, should be understood as long set out on the vehicle: those who will hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, write it, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it in motion, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, train for suchness, practice for suchness, and apply themselves to suchness. ||

children.text: śāriputra āha kiyantaste bhagavan bodhisattvā mahāsattvā bhaviṣyanti uttarasyāṃ diśi uttare digbhāge bahava utāho alpakāḥ ya imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti likhiṣyanti udgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyanti upadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante bhagavānāha bahavaste śāriputra subahavaḥ uttarāpathe uttarasyāṃ diśyuttare digbhāge bodhisattvā mahāsattvā bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said: Blessed One, how many will those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> be in the northern direction, in the northern quarter? Will they be many or few, those who will hear this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, write it, learn it, retain it, recite it, master it, set it in motion, teach it, instruct in it, proclaim it, study it, train for suchness, practice for suchness, and apply themselves to suchness? The Blessed One said: They will be many, <s>Śāriputra</s>, very many; in the northern region, in the northern direction, in the northern quarter there will be <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s>.

children.text: kiṃcāpi śāriputra bahavaste tebhyo'pi bahubhyo'lpakāste bodhisattvā mahāsattvā bhaviṣyanti ya imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ śroṣyanti likhiṣyantyudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyanti upadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti tathatvāya śikṣiṣyante tathatvāya pratipatsyante tathatvāya yogamāpatsyante prajñāpāramitāyāṃ ca bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ nāvaleṣyante na saṃleṣyante na viṣatsyanti na viṣādamāpatsyante na vipṛṣṭhīkariṣyanti mānasam na bhagnapṛṣṭhīkariṣyanti nottrasiṣyanti na saṃtrasiṣyanti na saṃtrāsamāpatsyante cirayānasamprasthitāste bodhisattvā mahāsattvā veditavyāḥ
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Śāriputra</s>, although those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, will be many, they will be few even among the many: those who will hear this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> (perfection of wisdom), write it down, take it up, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, instruct it, proclaim it, study it, train in suchness, practice for suchness, and enter into yoga for suchness; and when <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is being taught, they will not be dispirited, will not shrink back, will not become stuck, will not fall into despondency, will not turn their minds away, will not break their resolve, will not be terrified, alarmed, frightened, or fall into fear. Those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, should be known as having long since set out in the vehicle.

children.text: anubaddhāstaiḥ paurvakāstathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāḥ paripṛṣṭāḥ paripṛcchitāḥ paripraśnīkṛtāḥ
children.translated_text: They have followed former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened ones, and have asked them, questioned them, and thoroughly inquired of them.

children.text: pūjitāśca taiḥ paurvakāstathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāḥ kulaputraiḥ kuladuhitṛbhiśca bodhisattvayānikaiḥ pudgalaiḥ
children.translated_text: And those former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened ones, have been honored by those sons and daughters of good family, persons belonging to the <s>bodhisattva</s>-vehicle.

children.text: śīleṣu ca te paripūrṇakāriṇo bhaviṣyanti bahujanasya ca te'rthaṃ kariṣyanti yaduta imāmevānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimārabhya
children.translated_text: They will be perfect in the moral precepts, and they will work for the welfare of many people, namely with regard to this very unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca mayaiva sarvajñatāpratisaṃyuktaiva kathā kṛtā
children.translated_text: Why is that? For to those sons and daughters of good family I myself have given discourse connected only with all-knowledge.

children.text: teṣāṃ jātivyativṛttānāmapi eta eva sarvajñatāpratisaṃyuktāḥ prajñāpāramitāpratisaṃyuktāḥ samudācārā bhaviṣyanti
children.translated_text: Even after they have passed beyond this birth, these same practices connected with all-knowledge and connected with <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will occur for them.

children.text: enāmeva ca te kathāṃ kariṣyanti enāmeva ca kathāmabhinandiṣyanti yaduta anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimārabhya
children.translated_text: And they will give this very discourse, and they will rejoice in this very discourse, namely with regard to unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: teṣu ca susthitāḥ samāhitāśca bhaviṣyanti asyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyām
children.translated_text: And they will be well established and concentrated in this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: māreṇāpi te na śakyā bhedayitum kutaḥ punaranyaiḥ sattvaiḥ yaduta chandato vā mantrato vā
children.translated_text: They cannot be split apart even by <s>Māra</s>, much less by other beings, whether by persuasion or by spell.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ yathāpi nāma taddṛḍhasthāmatvādanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because of the firmness of their strength in unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: te ca kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca śrutvā enāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudāraṃ prītiprāmodyaprasādaṃ pratilapsyante
children.translated_text: And when those sons and daughters of good family hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, they will obtain lofty joy, gladness, and faith.

children.text: bahujanasya ca te kuśalamūlānyavaropayiṣyanti yadutānuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau
children.translated_text: And they will plant roots of merit for many people, namely in unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ evaṃ hi taiḥ kulaputraiḥ kuladuhitṛbhiśca mamāntike saṃmukhaṃ vāgbhāṣitā bahūni prāṇiśatāni bahūni prāṇisahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇiśatasahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīśatāni bahūni prāṇikoṭīsahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīśatasahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīniyutaśatasahasrāṇi bodhisattvacaryāṃ caranto vayamanuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau prasthāpayiṣyāmaḥ saṃdarśayiṣyāmaḥ samādāpayiṣyāmaḥ samuttejayiṣyāmaḥ saṃpraharṣayiṣyāmaḥ saṃprabhāvayiṣyāmaḥ saṃbodhaye pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyāma iti avinivartanīyān kariṣyāma iti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For in this way, in my presence, those sons and daughters of good family spoke these words: 'While practicing the conduct of a <s>bodhisattva</s>, we shall set many hundreds of living beings, many thousands of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of living beings, many hundreds of crores of living beings, many thousands of crores of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of crores of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of crores of niyutas of living beings, on the path to unsurpassed perfect awakening; we shall show it to them, cause them to undertake it, inspire them, gladden them, strengthen them, establish them in awakening, and make them irreversible.'

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ anumoditaṃ hi śāriputra mayā teṣāṃ bodhisattvayānikānāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca cittena cittaṃ vyavalokya yairiyaṃ vāgbhāṣitā bodhāya caranto vayaṃ bahūni prāṇiśatāni bahūni prāṇisahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇiśatasahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīśatāni bahūni prāṇikoṭīsahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīśatasahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīniyutaśatasahasrāṇi anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau prasthāpayiṣyāmaḥ saṃdarśayiṣyāmaḥ samādāpayiṣyāmaḥ samuttejayiṣyāmaḥ saṃpraharṣayiṣyāmaḥ saṃprabhāvayiṣyāmaḥ saṃbodhaye pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyāma iti avinivartanīyān kariṣyāma iti
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Śāriputra</s>, having looked into their minds with my mind, I approved the thought of those sons and daughters of good family belonging to the <s>bodhisattva</s>-vehicle, by whom these words were spoken: 'While we are practicing for awakening, we shall set many hundreds of living beings, many thousands of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of living beings, many hundreds of crores of living beings, many thousands of crores of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of crores of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of crores of niyutas of living beings on the path to unsurpassed perfect awakening; we shall show it to them, cause them to undertake it, inspire them, gladden them, strengthen them, establish them in awakening, and make them irreversible.'

children.text: evaṃ ca te kulaputrāḥ kuladuhitaraśca udārādhimuktikā bhaviṣyanti yadanyānyapi te buddhakṣetrāṇyadhyālambitavyāni maṃsyante
children.translated_text: And those sons and daughters of good family will have lofty resolution, so that they will think that still other Buddha-fields too should be resorted to.

children.text: yatra saṃmukhībhūtāstathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhā dharmaṃ deśayiṣyanti tatra saṃmukhībhūtānāṃ tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānām antikātpunarevaināṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ vistareṇa śroṣyanti
children.translated_text: Where <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened ones, are present face to face and teach the <s>dharma</s>, there, from the presence of those <s>Tathāgatas</s>, Arhats, perfectly awakened ones who are face to face, they will again hear this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> in full detail.

children.text: teṣvapi te buddhakṣetreṣu bahūni prāṇiśatāni bahūni prāṇisahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇiśatasahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīśatāni bahūni prāṇikoṭīsahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīśatasahasrāṇi bahūni prāṇikoṭīniyutaśatasahasrāṇi anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau prasthāpayiṣyanti saṃdarśayiṣyanti samādāpayiṣyanti samuttejayiṣyanti saṃpraharṣayiṣyanti saṃprabhāvayiṣyanti saṃbodhaye pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyanti avinivartanīyān kariṣyanti ||
children.translated_text: And in those Buddha-fields too they will set many hundreds of living beings, many thousands of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of living beings, many hundreds of crores of living beings, many thousands of crores of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of crores of living beings, many hundreds of thousands of crores of niyutas of living beings on the path to unsurpassed perfect awakening; they will show it to them, cause them to undertake it, inspire them, gladden them, strengthen them, establish them in awakening, and make them irreversible. ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvadidaṃ tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena atītānāgatapratyutpanneṣu dharmeṣu nāsti kiṃcidadṛṣṭaṃ vā aśrutaṃ vā aviditaṃ vā avijñātaṃ vā
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'It is wonderful, Blessed One, how for the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the Arhat, the perfectly awakened one, among dharmas past, future, and present, there is nothing at all that has not been seen, or heard, or known, or understood.

children.text: na sa kaściddharmo yo na jñāto na sā kāciccaryā sattvānāṃ yā na vijñātā yatra hi nāma anāgatānāmapi bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ caryā jñātā bodhicchandikānām adhyāśayasampannānām ārabdhavīryāṇām
children.translated_text: There is no <s>dharma</s> that is not known, no conduct of beings that is not understood; for indeed even the future conduct of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, who desire awakening, who are endowed with resolve, and who have begun their vigor, is known.

children.text: ye tasmin kāle imāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitāmudgrahīṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti paryavāpsyanti pravartayiṣyanti deśayiṣyanti upadekṣyantyuddekṣyanti svādhyāsyanti likhiṣyanti ca ye ca tasmin kāle āsāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pāramitānāṃ kṛtaśaḥ sarvasattvānāmarthāya udyogamāpadya anveṣiṣyante paryeṣiṣyante gaveṣiṣyante teṣāṃ ca kulaputrānāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca anveṣamāṇānāṃ paryeṣamāṇānāṃ kecidgaveṣamāṇā bodhisattvā lapsyante kecinna lapsyante kecid agaveṣayanto 'pi lapsyante enāṃ gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: Those who at that time will learn this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, retain it, recite it, master it, set it forth, teach it, explain it, repeat it, study it, and write it down, and those who at that time, for the welfare of all beings, will undertake exertion concerning these six perfections in full and will seek, search for, and look for them: among those sons of good family and daughters of good family who are seeking and searching, some <s>bodhisattvas</s> who look for it will obtain this deep <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, some will not obtain it, and some will obtain it even though they do not look for it.

children.text: kimatra bhagavan kāraṇam evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat evametacchāriputra evametat
children.translated_text: What, Blessed One, is the reason for this?' When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s>: 'So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>; so it is.

children.text: nāsti kiṃcittathāgatasya atītānāgatapratyutpanneṣu dharmeṣvadṛṣṭaṃ vā aśrutaṃ vā aviditaṃ vā avijñātaṃ vā
children.translated_text: For the <s>Tathāgata</s>, among dharmas past, future, and present, there is nothing at all that has not been seen, or heard, or known, or understood.

children.text: tasmin khalu punaḥ śāriputra kāle tasmin samaye kecidbodhisattvā mārgayamāṇāḥ paryeṣamāṇā gaveṣamāṇā api lapsyante imāṃ prajñāpāramitām
children.translated_text: And again, <s>Śāriputra</s>, at that time, on that occasion, some <s>bodhisattvas</s>, though they are looking, searching, and seeking, will obtain this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: kecidbodhisattvā amārgayamāṇā aparyeṣamāṇā agaveṣayanto 'pi lapsyante
children.translated_text: Some <s>bodhisattvas</s> will obtain it even though they are not looking, not searching, and not seeking.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ tathā hi tairbodhisattvairmahāsattvairiyaṃ prajñāpāramitā pūrvāntato'pi anikṣiptadhurair mārgitā ca paryanviṣṭā ca
children.translated_text: Why is that? Because those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, not having laid down the burden, have already from the past sought and investigated this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: te tenaiva pūrvakeṇa kuśalamūlacchandena enāṃ prajñāpāramitām amārgayanto'pi aparyeṣamāṇā api agaveṣayanto'pi lapsyante
children.translated_text: By that very former aspiration rooted in wholesome qualities, they will obtain this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> even though they are not looking, not searching, and not seeking.

children.text: yānyapi ca tato'nyānyapi sūtrāṇi enāmeva prajñāpāramitāmabhivadanti tāni caiṣāṃ svayamevopagamiṣyanti upapatsyante upanaṃsyante ca
children.translated_text: And whatever other sūtras also proclaim this very <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, those too will come to them of themselves, will occur to them, and will present themselves.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ evametacchāriputra bhavati ya enāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bodhisattvo mahāsattvo'nikṣiptadhuro mārgayati ca paryeṣate ca sa jātivyativṛtto'pi janmāntaravyativṛtto'pi enāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ lapsyate
children.translated_text: Why is that? So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>: the <s>bodhisattva</s>, the <s>mahāsattva</s>, who seeks this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> and searches for it without laying down the burden, even after passing beyond one birth and passing into another birth, will obtain this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: tato'nyāni ca sūtrāṇi prajñāpāramitāpratisaṃyuktāni tasya svayamevopagamiṣyanti upapatsyante upanaṃsyante ceti ||
children.translated_text: And other sūtras connected with the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> will come to him of themselves, will occur to him, and will present themselves.' ||

children.text: evamukte āyuṣmān śāriputro bhagavantametadavocat ime eva kevalaṃ bhagavaṃsteṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca ṣaṭpāramitāpratisaṃyuktāḥ sūtrāntā upapatsyante upanaṃsyante nānye bhagavānāha ye cānye'pi śāriputra gambhīrā gambhīrāḥ sūtrāntā bhaviṣyanti te'pi teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca svayamevopapatsyante svayamevopanaṃsyante ca
children.translated_text: When this had been said, the venerable <s>Śāriputra</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Blessed One, will only these sūtras connected with the six perfections occur and present themselves to those sons of good family and daughters of good family, and no others?' The Blessed One said: 'And whatever other deep, very deep sūtras there will be, <s>Śāriputra</s>, they too will of themselves occur and of themselves present themselves to those sons of good family and daughters of good family.

children.text: tatkasya hetoḥ evaṃ hyetacchāriputra bhavati ye bodhisattvā mahāsattvā anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau prasthāpayiṣyanti saṃdarśayiṣyanti samādāpayiṣyanti samuttejayiṣyanti saṃpraharṣayiṣyanti prabhāvayiṣyanti saṃbodhaye pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyanti avinivartanīyān kariṣyanti svayaṃ ca tatra śikṣiṣyante teṣāṃ śāriputra jātivyativṛttānāmapi ime gambhīrā gambhīrā anupalambhapratisaṃyuktāḥ śūnyatāpratisaṃyuktāḥ ṣaṭpāramitāpratisaṃyuktāśca sūtrāntāḥ svayamevopagamiṣyanti svayamevopapatsyante svayamevopanaṃsyante ceti ||
children.translated_text: Why is that? So it is, <s>Śāriputra</s>: those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, who will set beings forth toward unsurpassed perfect awakening, show it to them, cause them to undertake it, encourage them, gladden them, empower them, establish them in awakening, and make them irreversible, and who will themselves train in it: to them, <s>Śāriputra</s>, even after they have passed beyond one birth, these deep, very deep sūtras connected with nonapprehension, connected with emptiness, and connected with the six perfections will come of themselves, occur of themselves, and present themselves of themselves.' ||

children.text: Chapter 11
atha khalu āyuṣmān subhūtirbhagavantametadavocat guṇā ime bhagavaṃsteṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṝṇāṃ ca bhagavatā parikīrtitāḥ
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> said this to the Blessed One: 'Blessed One, these qualities of those sons of good family and daughters of good family have been praised by the Blessed One.

children.text: kecitpunarbhagavaṃsteṣāmantarāyā utpatsyante evamukte bhagavānāyuṣmantaṃ subhūtimetadavocat bahūni subhūte teṣāṃ mārakarmāṇyantarāyakarāṇy utpatsyante
children.translated_text: But will some obstacles arise for them, Blessed One?' When this had been said, the Blessed One said this to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'Many obstructive works of <s>Māra</s> will arise for them, <s>Subhūti</s>.

children.text: subhūtirāha kiyadrūpāṇi bhagavaṃsteṣāṃ bahūni mārakarmāṇy antarāyakarāṇyutpatsyante bhagavānāha teṣāṃ subhūte bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ bhāṣamāṇānāṃ cireṇa pratibhānamutpatsyate
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'Of what sort, Blessed One, will the many obstructive works of <s>Māra</s> arise for them?' The Blessed One said: 'For those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>mahāsattvas</s>, while they are teaching the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, eloquence will arise only after a long time.

children.text: idaṃ subhūte prathamaṃ mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be known as the first work of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: tad api ca pratibhānaṃ jāyamānameva vikṣepsyate
children.translated_text: And that very eloquence, just as it is arising, will be distracted.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be known as a work of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: te vijṛmbhamāṇā hasanta uccagghayanto likhiṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will write while yawning, laughing, and guffawing loudly.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: vikṣiptacittāḥ paryavāpsyanti
children.translated_text: They will complete it with distracted minds.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: anyonyavijñānasamaṅgino likhiṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will write while their awareness is bound up with one another.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: smṛtiṃ na pratilapsyante
children.translated_text: They will not recover mindfulness.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: parasparamupahasanto likhiṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will write while mocking one another.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: parasparamuccagghayamānā likhiṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will write while laughing loudly at one another.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: vikṣiptacakṣuṣo likhiṣyanti
children.translated_text: They will write with distracted eyes.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: likhatāmanyonyaṃ visāmagrī bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: Among those who are writing, there will be mutual discord.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: na vayamatra gādhaṃ nāsvādaṃ labhāmahe ityutthāyāsanāt prakramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Saying, "We find no depth here and no savor," they will rise from their seats and go away.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: na vayamatra vyākṛtāḥ prajñāpāramitāyām ityaprasannacittā utthāyāsanāt prakramiṣyanti
children.translated_text: Saying, "We have not been predicted here in the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>," they will rise from their seats with displeased minds and go away.

children.text: idam api subhūte mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s>.

children.text: na no 'tra grāmasya vā nagarasya vā nigamasya vā nāmadheyaṃ parigṛhītaṃ yatra no janma na no 'tra nāma gotraṃ vā gṛhītam na mātāpitrornāma gotraṃ vā gṛhītam nāpi kulasya yatra no janmeti te prajñāpāramitāṃ na śrotavyāṃ maṃsyante tato 'pakramitavyaṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: They will think, "Here neither the name of our village, town, or market-town where we were born has been included; nor has our name or clan been mentioned here; nor have the names or clans of our mother and father been mentioned; nor even the family in which we were born." Thus they will think that the <s>prajñāpāramitā</s> is not to be heard, and that they should depart from it.

children.text: yathā yathā ca apakramiṣyanti tairyāvadbhiścittotpādaistathā tathā tāvataḥ kalpān saṃsārasya punaḥ punaḥ parigrahīṣyanti yatra taiḥ punareva yogamāpattavyaṃ bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: And in proportion as they depart, by just so many productions of thought they will again and again take up <s>saṃsāra</s> for that many kalpas, where they will have to apply themselves again.

children.text: tatkasmāt imāṃ hi subhūte prajñāpāramitāmaśṛṇvanto bodhisattvā mahāsattvā laukikalokottareṣu dharmeṣu na nirjāyante
children.translated_text: Why is that? For, <s>Subhūti</s>, when they do not hear this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> do not come to fulfillment in worldly and supramundane dharmas.

children.text: idam api subhūte teṣāṃ mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s> on their part.

children.text: punaraparaṃ subhūte bodhisattvayānikāḥ pudgalā imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ sarvajñajñānasyāhārikāṃ vivarjya utsṛjya ye te sūtrāntā naiva sarvajñajñānasyāhārikāstān paryeṣitavyān maṃsyante
children.translated_text: Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, persons of the bodhisattva vehicle will abandon and cast aside this <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, which nourishes omniscient knowledge, and will think that those sūtras which do not nourish omniscient knowledge should be sought out.

children.text: idam api subhūte teṣāṃ mārakarma veditavyam
children.translated_text: This too, <s>Subhūti</s>, should be understood as an act of <s>Māra</s> on their part.

children.text: yathā khalu punaḥ subhūte na laukikalokottareṣu śikṣitukāmā na laukikalokottareṣu dharmeṣu niryātukāmā iha prajñāpāramitāyāṃ na śikṣante
children.translated_text: For example, <s>Subhūti</s>, those who do not wish to train in worldly and supramundane matters, and who do not wish to proceed in worldly and supramundane dharmas, do not train here in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>.

children.text: prajñāpāramitāyām aśikṣamāṇā na laukikalokottareṣu dharmeṣu niryānti
children.translated_text: Not training in <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, they do not proceed in worldly and supramundane dharmas.

children.text: evaṃ te parīttabuddhayo laukikalokottarāṇāṃ yathābhūtaparijñāyā mūlaṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ vivarjya utsṛjya praśākhāmadhyālambitavyāṃ maṃsyante
children.translated_text: Thus those of little intelligence will abandon and cast aside <s>prajñāpāramitā</s>, the root of the true comprehension of worldly and supramundane dharmas, and will think that a branch should be grasped instead.

children.text: tadyathāpi nāma subhūte kukkuraḥ svāmino 'ntikātpiṇḍāṃśchorayitvā karmakarasyāntikātkavalaṃ paryeṣitavyaṃ manyeta evameva subhūte bhaviṣyantyanāgate 'dhvani eke bodhisattvayānikāḥ pudgalāḥ ye imāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ sarvajñajñānasya mūlaṃ chorayitvā śākhāpatrapalālabhūte śrāvakapratyekabuddhayāne sāraṃ vṛddhatvaṃ paryeṣitavyaṃ maṃsyante
